Experiments across multiple open-source MLLMs show that MMAligner raises the average refusal rate on unsafe multimodal inputs to 99% with less than 2% utility degradation and minimal training data, substantially improving the safety-utility trade-off over existing baselines. (*Due to the notification from arXiv, "The Abstract field cannot be longer than 1,920 characters", the Abstract that appeared is shortened.)

</details>


### [196] [A Note on the Influence of a Zero Length Nonce on GCM and GMAC](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.06061)
*Yaobin Shen*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种针对GCM和GMAC的简单攻击，利用零长度nonce恢复哈希密钥，从而允许攻击者伪造任意密文或消息。该攻击仅适用于ISO/IEC版本的GCM/GMAC（允许非零长度nonce），不适用于NIST版本（要求nonce至少为1比特长度）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GCM和GMAC是广泛使用的认证加密模式，其安全性依赖于哈希密钥的保密性。本研究旨在揭示ISO/IEC版本规范中允许零长度nonce所带来的安全漏洞，表明不同标准化版本之间的细微差异可能导致严重的安全后果。

Method: 作者展示了一种简单的攻击方法：利用零长度nonce的情况来恢复GCM和GMAC的哈希密钥。通过分析该特定条件下认证标签的计算过程，攻击者可以提取出哈希密钥，进而伪造任意密文或消息。

Result: 攻击成功恢复哈希密钥，使得攻击者能够完全伪造任意密文或消息。该攻击对ISO/IEC版本有效（因其允许零长度nonce），但对NIST版本无效（因其要求nonce至少为1比特）。

Conclusion: 不同标准化机构对GCM/GMAC中nonce长度的规范差异引入了安全性不对称性：ISO/IEC版本因允许零长度nonce而存在可被利用的漏洞，而NIST版本通过明确的最小长度要求规避了此风险。这一发现强调了标准化规范中每细节的重要性。

Abstract: In this note, we show a simple attack that can recover the hash key of GCM and GMAC by using a zero length nonce. After recovering the hash key, the adversary can forge an arbitrary ciphertext or message as she wants. We note that the ISO/IEC version of GCM and GMAC allows the nonce to be a zero length string, while the NIST version of GCM and GMAC explicitly requires the nonce to be at least one bit. Hence, our attack works for the ISO/IEC version and cannot work for the NIST version.

</details>


### [197] [dfence: Fine-Grained Speculation Barriers for Efficient and Effective Hardware-Software Protection in the Spectre Era (Extended Version)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.06124)
*Davide Davoli,Marton Bognar,Lesly-Ann Daniel,Benjamin Grégoire,Frank Piessens,Tamara Rezk*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出dfence，一种新的CPU指令，通过泛化软件级Speculative Load Hardening（SLH）方法，以最小硬件支持同时缓解Spectre-PHT和Spectre-STL两类投机执行攻击，在Proteus CPU上实现平均性能开销低于1%，并设计了类型系统静态验证dfence指令的正确放置。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 软硬件层面的投机执行攻击（如Spectre-PHT和Spectre-STL）仍是现代处理器的关键安全威胁。现有的软件缓解方案（如SLH）仅针对Spectre-PHT，且依赖软件管理的投机掩码，容易出错且开销高；针对Spectre-STL的防御（如SSBD位）则带来额外性能开销且缺乏细粒度控制。需要一种统一的、硬件支持的、高性能的解决方案。

Method: 提出dfence新CPU指令，推广SLH思想以同时缓解Spectre-PHT和Spectre-STL。开发者通过dfence注释敏感寄存器，硬件确保这些值不会在瞬态执行中泄漏。将dfence实现于Proteus CPU中，并设计了一个类型系统，用于静态验证代码中dfence指令的放置位置是否正确，确保安全采用。

Result: 在Proteus CPU上实现dfence，评估结果显示基准测试平均性能开销低于1%，证明了该方案在安全性和性能之间取得了良好平衡。类型系统能够静态验证dfence指令的合法放置，便于安全易用地部署。

Conclusion: dfence通过单条硬件指令统一缓解Spectre-PHT和Spectre-STL两类主要投机执行攻击，以极低的性能开销和静态可验证性提供了实用且安全的防护方案，是对现有软件与硬件防御机制的有效补充与推广。

Abstract: Speculative execution attacks such as Spectre-PHT and Spectre-STL remain a critical security concern in modern processors. While software-based mitigations like Speculative Load Hardening (SLH) offer effective protection against Spectre-PHT, they are limited in scope and require software-managed speculative masks, which can be error-prone and costly. Defenses against Spectre-STL, such as the Speculative Store Bypass Disable bit (SSBD), incur additional performance overhead and lack fine-grained control. In this work, we introduce dfence, a new CPU instruction that generalizes SLH to mitigate both Spectre-PHT and Spectre-STL with minimal hardware support. dfence enables developers to annotate sensitive registers, with the hardware ensuring that these values do not leak transiently. We implement dfence in the Proteus CPU and evaluate its security and performance, demonstrating less than 1% average performance overhead for our benchmarks. In addition, to support easy and secure adoption, we design a type system that statically verifies the correct placement of dfence instructions in code.

</details>


### [198] [Hardware Keystores for AI Agent Signing Workflows: A Zero-Trust MCP Enforcement Architecture](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.06130)
*Leo Sambrook,Sampo Sovio*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出用硬件密钥存储（HSM/TPM/智能卡）替换软件驻留密钥，通过PKCS#11接口和五层零信任栈（会话身份、作用域边界、语义验证、污点追踪、硬件执行边界）同时实现密钥保密性和内容感知授权，在12种注入攻击场景下将攻击成功率从19.3%降至0%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI代理执行密码学操作时将私钥存储在软件可访问位置（明文文件、环境变量、容器内存），任何具有足够读权限的进程都能窃取原始密钥材料。已发生真实生产事故：私钥在五分钟内被通过邮件注入方式从广泛部署的框架中窃取。作者旨在同时强制实现密钥保密性和对密钥使用的内容感知授权。

Method: 将软件驻留密钥替换为通过厂商中立PKCS#11接口访问的硬件受限密钥。硬件密钥库（HSM、TPM、智能卡）在设备上执行密码学操作，主机仅通过不透明句柄接收结果。硬件限制是主要贡献，由五层零信任强制栈支撑：会话身份（SAGA）、作用域边界（Smax）、语义验证（RAV）、污点追踪和硬件执行边界。

Result: 基于AgentDojo的ImportantInstructionsAttack模板构建12种注入场景，测试4个LLM模型（gpt-oss-120b、Qwen2.5-72B、DeepSeek-V4-Flash，n=192组合）。基线攻击成功率19.3%（95% CI [14.3%, 25.4%]），受保护后攻击成功率为0%（Wilson 95% CI上限2.0%）。四个良性任务场景中零误报。

Conclusion: 硬件密钥限制与五层零信任栈相结合，可有效防御针对AI代理密钥使用的注入攻击，在实现100%防御率的同时保持零误报，验证了该方法在真实场景中的可行性和有效性。

Abstract: AI agents performing cryptographic operations (signing Git commits, authenticating API calls, issuing certificates) currently store private keys in software-accessible locations: plaintext files, environment variables, or container memory. Any process with sufficient read privileges can extract the raw key material. A recent production incident demonstrated the practical severity: private keys were exfiltrated from a widely deployed framework via email injection in under five minutes. We aim to enforce both key confidentiality and content-aware authorisation for key use. To that end, we replace software-resident keys with hardware-confined keys accessible through a vendor-neutral PKCS#11 interface. A hardware keystore (HSM, TPM, smart card) executes cryptographic operations on-device; the host receives only the result via opaque handles. Hardware confinement is the primary contribution; it is enabled by a surrounding five-layer Zero-Trust enforcement stack comprising session identity (SAGA), scope bounds (Smax), semantic validation (RAV), taint tracking, and the hardware execution boundary. We evaluate against 12 injection scenarios derived from AgentDojo's ImportantInstructionsAttack template (Debenedetti et al., arXiv:2406.13352). We run four LLM models; three follow injections in baseline mode (gpt-oss-120b, Qwen2.5-72B, DeepSeek-V4-Flash, n=192 combined). Baseline Attack Success Rate (ASR): 19.3% [14.3%, 25.4%]; protected ASR: 0% (Wilson 95% CI upper bound 2.0%). Zero false positives across four benign task scenarios.

</details>


### [199] [Reversible Unlearnable Examples: Towards the Copyright Protection in Deep Learning Era](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.06211)
*Binze Wang,Jinyu Tian,Xingrun Wang,Xiaochen Yuan,Jianqing Li*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种全新的图片版权保护机制，用于同时应对深度学习中的两大威胁：非法模型训练和恶意数据泄露。该方法通过最小化模型输入与输出的互信息生成不可学习扰动，使模型无法从被保护图像中学到有效特征；同时设计了双提取策略（使用两个不同的水印提取器）来消除不可学习扰动对水印提取的负面影响。在ImageNet、CIFAR10和Pets三个数据集上的实验证明了该方法的综合版权保护效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度学习的进步依赖大规模数据集，因此数据版权保护至关重要。现有方法存在两大威胁：非法模型训练（通过不可学习例子防护）和恶意数据泄露（通过水印技术防护）。作者发现简单地组合现有的可用性攻击和水印技术无法同时解决这两个问题，因为二者存在负面交互效应，因此需要设计一种统一的版权保护机制。

Method: 1) 生成不可学习扰动：通过最小化模型输入与输出的互信息，使模型学习输入图像中不相关的特征，从而阻止未经授权的模型训练，且该扰动具备良好的泛化能力。2) 双提取策略：设计两个不同的水印提取器，以消除不可学习扰动对水印提取的副作用，确保版权水印能够被可靠提取。

Result: 在ImageNet、CIFAR10和Pets三个图像数据集上的广泛实验表明，所提出的方法能够为图像提供全面的版权保护，同时有效抵御非法模型训练和恶意数据泄露两大威胁。

Conclusion: 本文提出了一种可逆的不可学习示例方法，将可用性攻击与数字水印技术统一到一个版权保护框架中，解决了两者单独使用或直接组合时的不足，为深度学习中的数据版权保护提供了一种综合性的解决方案。

Abstract: Significant advancements in deep learning have been made possible by the utilization of large datasets, underscoring the critical importance of copyright protection. Adding meticulously designed perturbations to examples, making them unlearnable has become a crucial approach for safeguarding data copyright. Existing methods for creating unlearnable examples overlook the risk of data leakage, which can threaten data ownership. Thus, copyright protection in deep learning faces two main threats: illegal model training and malicious data leakage. We investigate that these two threats cannot be solved by straightforwardly combining existing availability attacks and watermarking techniques as their negative interaction effects. Therefore, in this paper, we propose a novel copyright protection mechanism for the aforementioned security concerns. Considering that the prevention of unauthorized model training requires powerful generalizability of unlearnable perturbations, we generate perturbations to induce the model to learn uncorrelated features of input images. It works by minimizing the mutual information of the input and output of the model. On the other hand, to eliminate the side impact of unlearnable perturbations on the watermark extraction, we design a dual extraction strategy by using two distinct watermark extractors. Extensive experiments on the image datasets {ImageNet, CIFAR10, and Pets} show that our proposed method could provide comprehensive copyright protection to images. The code is available at {https://github.com/Yeah21/ReversibleUnlearnableExamples}.

</details>


### [200] [Game Hopping in Lean](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.06261)
*Stefan Dziembowski,Grzegorz Fabiański,Daniele Micciancio,Rafał Stefański*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 提出了HOPSCOTCH，一个基于Lean 4的形式化框架，用于机械化、计算可靠的基于游戏（game-based）的密码学证明。安全定义表示为有状态概率神谕之间的不可区分性，证明遵循标准游戏跳跃范式，采用浅嵌入方式使得神谕和归约都是普通Lean定义，并与Mathlib深度集成。框架证明了通用计算健全性定理，并已应用于若干经典密码学安全证明（包括IND-CCA、ElGamal、GGM PRF等）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于游戏的密码学证明在密码学中广泛使用，但手写证明容易出错且难以验证。此前已有机械化密码学证明框架（如EasyCrypt等深层嵌入），但存在与通用数学库集成困难或表达能力受限等问题。作者希望通过构建一个基于Lean 4的浅嵌入框架，利用Mathlib强大的数学基础，使游戏跳跃式密码学证明能够被机器可靠地验证，并直接受益于Lean生态系统中已有的数学理论。

Method: HOPSCOTCH采用浅嵌入方式，将安全定义表达为有状态概率神谕之间的不可区分性；游戏跳跃证明被表示为显式的形式化对象，其构造子对应标准游戏跳跃论证步骤。框架证明了通用计算健全性定理，通过构造针对所使用假设的归约来阐释这些证明对象，并推导出任何区分者优势的具体界限。神谕间的观察等价性通过状态抽象方法论（state-abstraction methodology）建立，支持添加/遗忘状态、用惰性采样替代急切采样等变换。证明在Lean 4中形式化，并深度集成Mathlib的有限群理论等一般数学理论。

Result: 框架成功形式化了多个经典密码学安全证明，包括：encrypt-then-MAC的IND-CCA安全性、基于DDH假设的ElGamal加密安全性、一次性保密到公钥IND-CPA安全的蕴涵关系，以及GGM伪随机函数构造。其中GGM证明是非恒定深度下的首个机械化证明。

Conclusion: HOPSCOTCH证明了浅嵌入方法在机械化密码学证明中的可行性和优势：通过显式形式化游戏跳跃证明对象并结合状态抽象方法论，框架既能保持证明的清晰可自动化，又能充分利用Lean 4及其Mathlib的丰富数学基础设施。GGM非恒定深度机械化证明的完成，展示了该框架足以处理复杂且深度依赖的密码学构造。

Abstract: We present HOPSCOTCH, a Lean 4 framework for mechanizing computationally sound, game-based cryptographic proofs. Security definitions are expressed as indistinguishability between stateful probabilistic oracles, and proofs follow the standard game-hopping paradigm. HOPSCOTCH uses a shallow embedding: oracles and reductions are ordinary Lean definitions, enabling direct integration with the full Lean ecosystem, including general mathematical theories from Mathlib, such as finite-group theory. A game-hopping proof in HOPSCOTCH is represented as an explicit formal object whose constructors correspond to the standard steps of a game-hopping argument, making proofs easier to construct, automate, and inspect. We prove a general computational soundness theorem that interprets these proof objects by constructing reductions against the assumptions they use and deriving a concrete bound on the advantage of any distinguisher. Observational equivalence between oracles is established using a state-abstraction methodology: a simple yet powerful approach that supports transformations such as adding or forgetting state and replacing eager sampling with lazy sampling. We illustrate the framework with formalized proofs of the IND-CCA security of encrypt-then-MAC, the security of ElGamal encryption from DDH, the implication from one-time secrecy to public-key IND-CPA security, and the GGM pseudorandom-function construction. To the best of our knowledge, the last is the first mechanized proof of GGM for non-constant depth.

</details>


### [201] [A Sound Translation from Tamarin to ProVerif: Enabling Comparative Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.06315)
*Kevin Morio,Yavor Ivanov,Robert Künnemann*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出了从Tamarin到ProVerif的可靠翻译方法，在121个Tamarin模型上覆盖了566个lemma任务中的562个，非XOR任务中246/247的结果一致，且ProVerif在92.3%的任务中速度更快。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Tamarin和ProVerif是安全协议形式化验证的两大主流工具，但它们在底层形式主义（multiset rewrite规则 vs. applied-pi演算扩展）和验证技术（完备 vs. 快速但可能不完备）上差异显著，缺乏系统性的比较方法，因此需要一种可靠的翻译机制来实现两工具的严格对比。

Method: 提出从Tamarin到ProVerif的可靠翻译，引入新颖的公式重写、multiset rewrite语义编码和并发事件处理技术；支持Tamarin的multiset rewrite规则、lemmas和restrictions等广泛特性，同时精确定义无法忠实翻译的边界情况；提供形式化证明，在忠实子集内保证soundness（ProVerif验证的属性在Tamarin模型中也成立）和completeness（不涉及攻击者知识的exists-trace属性被保留）；XOR等best-effort编码单独报告且不在此保证范围内。

Result: 在121个Tamarin模型上评估：翻译覆盖566个lemma任务中的562个；非XOR任务中247个有确定结果的任务中246个一致，唯一不一致被明确标记为使用了不完备模型；362个两工具均完成的任务中，ProVerif在334个（92.3%）任务中更快，中位数运行时间比和峰值内存比分别为6.74x和6.24x。

Conclusion: 所提出的翻译方案使得Tamarin和ProVerif可以进行严格比较，在绝大多数场景下两工具结果一致，且ProVerif在性能和资源效率上具有显著优势，为安全协议验证工具的选择提供了实用依据。

Abstract: Tamarin and ProVerif are two prominent tools for the formal verification of security protocols. They share the same high-level goal but differ significantly in their underlying formalisms and verification techniques, making a systematic comparison challenging: Tamarin uses multiset rewrite rules with sound and complete verification, whereas ProVerif employs an extension of the applied-pi calculus that provides fast but potentially incomplete results.
  We present a sound translation from Tamarin to ProVerif that enables a rigorous comparison of the two tools. It introduces novel techniques for formula rewriting, encoding multiset rewrite semantics, and handling simultaneous events, supporting an extensive subset of Tamarin's features, including multiset rewrite rules, lemmas, and restrictions, while precisely characterizing the cases where faithful translation is not possible. We provide formal proofs: within the faithful fragment, soundness ensures that any property verified in ProVerif also holds in the original Tamarin model, and completeness ensures that exists-trace properties not involving attacker knowledge are preserved. Best-effort encodings, in particular XOR, are reported separately and are outside these guarantees.
  Finally, we evaluate our translation on 121 Tamarin models. The translation covers 562 of 566 lemma tasks. Among non-XOR tasks with definitive results from both tools, 246 of 247 agree, with the remaining verdict explicitly flagged as using an incomplete model. Among the 362 tasks for which Tamarin returns a Boolean result and ProVerif completes with a logical result, ProVerif is faster in 334 cases (92.3%), with median per-task runtime and peak-memory ratios of 6.74x and 6.24x, respectively.

</details>


<div id='q-bio.NC'></div>

# q-bio.NC [[Back]](#toc)

### [202] [The ethics of artificial intelligence in the life sciences: Universality, cultural diversity and an architecture of care](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.05436)
*Jean-Pierre Changeux,Gustavo Deco,Morten L. Kringelbach*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 本文认为生命科学与健康领域中AI引发伦理问题虽然真实但并非独特。人类大脑凭借全局神经元工作空间和"想要—喜欢—满足"循环的奖励机制，具有比机器更廉价的运算架构。若以类似人类的原则构建AI，其治理问题将从"限制"转变为"培育"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着AI在生命科学和健康研究中的应用日益广泛，产生了一系列伦理担忧。但作者认为这些担忧被过度特殊化，主张应回归人类大脑的本质运作方式来理解并治理AI伦理问题。

Method: 论文从认知神经科学与伦理学交叉视角出发，论证人类大脑的"全局神经元工作空间"架构与"想要-喜欢-满足"奖励循环，说明其计算成本远低于当前AI的奖励最大化范式；进而指出这一架构天然蕴含伦理判断的普遍性与道德内容多样性之间的张力，并提出若按此原理构建机器的制度性设想。

Result: 论文提出核心论断：AI伦理问题本质上与人类伦理问题同源，应基于人类大脑的神经架构来理解；当AI按人类奖励循环而非奖励最大化原则构建时，治理范式应从"约束(restraint)"转向"培育(upbringing)"，并勾勒了所需制度框架与待解问题。

Conclusion: AI伦理不应被孤立审视，而应纳入人类大脑架构所确立的普遍伦理框架中。未来AI治理的关键在于从外部限制转向类似人类教育与社会化的"培育"过程，这既是方向也是开放的研究课题。

Abstract: The life sciences and health research have started to benefit from artificial intelligence, which raises ethical concerns that are real but, we argue, not special. Any science should be governed by values that rest on how the human brain is built and socialised rather than anything distinct to artificial intelligence. Importantly, the human brain has a different, much less costly computational architecture than these machines. This is achieved through the orchestration of a global neuronal workspace, and through reward best described not as a quantity to be maximised but as a continuous cycle of wanting, liking and satiety. As such, this creates the deep tension running through the ethics of the human person, between the universality of ethical judgement and the diversity of morals. The brain networks of the global workspace and emotion are universally shared, but the diversity of content is shaped by epigenetic appropriation of the particulars of the physical, social and cultural world, which makes every person unique. Still, if we were to build machines on these principles rather than the present unaffordable reward maximisers, the question of their governance would change from restraint to upbringing. We set out the institutions such a future would require, together with the questions that remain open.

</details>


### [203] [Effective pruning of task-trained recurrent neural networks using noisy fluctuations and connection rescaling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.05464)
*Sanjith Senthil,Rishidev Chaudhuri*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 本文验证了noise-prune这一生物可信的局部剪枝规则在任务训练过的循环神经网络中能保留任务性能，优于仅基于连接强度的策略，与使用二阶信息的非局部策略相当或更好，并发现采样和缩放是性能的关键，但最优缩放程度低于理论预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经网络连接剪枝对大脑功能至关重要，但缺乏既具生物合理性又有良好性能的剪枝规则。noise-prune此前仅在无特定计算功能的随机网络上测试过，其有效性尚未在具有计算任务的网络中验证。

Method: 在任务训练过的循环神经网络（RNN）上评估noise-prune剪枝规则，对比基于连接强度的剪枝策略和非局部二阶信息策略。noise-prune通过噪声波动确定连接重要性，以概率采样的方式保留连接而非确定性删除阈值以下的连接，并对保留的连接进行强度缩放以维持平均突触强度。通过消融实验验证采样和缩放的必要性，并系统探索最优缩放程度。

Result: noise-prune在任务训练过的RNN中保持任务性能，大幅优于仅使用连接强度的策略，与使用二阶信息的非局部策略持平或更好。采样和缩放机制对性能至关重要，但经验测得的最优缩放程度低于原始理论论证的预测值。

Conclusion: 该工作验证了noise-prune作为功能循环网络架构上一种生物合理的剪枝规则的有效性，并刻画了其最优参数设置。

Abstract: The pruning of network connections is key to brain function but, despite its importance, there exist few biologically-plausible pruning rules with demonstrated good performance. In this work we evaluate noise-prune, a recently introduced unsupervised local pruning rule for recurrent networks that uses noisy fluctuations to determine the importance of connections. Noise-prune has previously only been empirically tested on random networks without a specific computational function. We show that noise-prune preserves task-performance in task-trained recurrent neural networks, greatly outperforming a strategy that only uses the magnitude of connections and performing on par with or exceeding a non-local strategy that uses second-order information. Rather than deterministically removing connections that fall below a certain threshold importance, noise-prune samples connections to preserve based on their importance and strengthens retained connections to preserve average synaptic strength. We show that this sampling and rescaling is essential to good performance, but that the optimal empirical degree of rescaling is lower than that predicted by the original theoretical argument. Our work thus validates noise-prune as a biologically-plausible pruning rule for functional recurrent network architectures and characterizes its optimal parameter settings.

</details>


### [204] [From Local Learning to Global Prediction Through Layered Surprise Cascades](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.05481)
*Andrew L. Smith,Linxing Preston Jiang,Jason K. Eshraghian,Matthew S. Bull,Stefano Recanatesi*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 本文提出一个生物可塑的预测编码框架，基于局部对比学习和简单活动消除机制，采用带有反向目标的循环前馈-前馈（FF）算法，使预测编码的功能目标从简单的局部学习规则中涌现，并捕捉到皮层计算的特征如自上而下调制和惊喜信号。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 层级预测编码是大脑计算的重要假说，但大多数现有模型依赖于误差编码神经元或生成建模，其生物合理性存疑。研究者希望找到一种更简单、更符合生物学的局部学习规则来实现预测编码的功能。

Method: 提出一种循环变体的前馈-前馈（Forward-Forward）算法，采用反向目标来增加负样本数据的活动，通过局部对比学习和活动消除构建跨层级的预测性表征。

Result: 该框架能够产生跨层的预测表征，并捕捉到皮层计算的关键特征，包括自上而下的调控和惊喜信号传递。

Conclusion: 预测编码的关键原则可以从简单、局部的学习规则中自然涌现，为神经科学和机器学习之间提供了新的桥梁。

Abstract: Hierarchical predictive coding proposes a compelling hypothesis of brain computation, suggesting that the cortex builds layered predictions to minimize surprise. Yet most models rely on error-coding neurons or generative modeling of unclear biological plausibility. Here, we examine a biologically plausible framework in which the functional goals of predictive coding emerge from local contrastive learning and simple activity cancellation. Building on recent machine learning advances, we present a recurrent variant of the Forward-Forward (FF) algorithm with an inverted objective that increases activity for negative data. This setup yields predictive representations across layers, capturing hallmark features of cortical computation such as top-down modulation and surprise signaling. Our results suggest that key principles of predictive coding can emerge from simple, local learning rules, offering a new bridge between neuroscience and machine learning.

</details>


### [205] [Transcutaneous Spinal Cord Stimulation Disrupts Conscious Ankle Proprioception and Produces a More Constrained Locomotor Pattern in Unimpaired Adults](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.05635)
*Christopher A. Johnson,Andria J. Farrens,Parastoo Ali Pour,Arjan Gillan,Hui Zhong,David J. Reinkensmeyer,Alexandra S. Voloshina*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 该研究首次系统考察经皮脊髓电刺激（tSCS）对无损伤成年人踝关节本体感觉与步态的急性及训练相关影响，发现tSCS急性期会损害意识性本体感觉（踝关节定位误差增加）但保留肌力，并使步态趋向更受限模式（步宽和内侧质心偏移减小）；经过持续训练，tSCS组本体感觉误差改善且呈进行性提升，步态呈方向依赖性重组（矢状面恢复甚至超越基线，内外侧保持受限），表明神经系统可通过训练适应改变的传入输入。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 既往tSCS研究主要关注运动表现和脊髓兴奋性，但tSCS如何影响意识性本体感觉感知，以及这种影响与运动控制变化的平行程度尚不明确。该研究旨在填补这一空白，探究tSCS对完整感觉运动控制回路的全方位影响。

Method: 招募14名无损伤成年受试者接受tSCS干预，另设14名独立对照组仅接受完全相同的本体感觉训练而不给予电刺激。采用双侧机器人动态踝关节定位能力评估（Crisscross）量化本体感觉；以最大跖屈/背屈力量衡量粗大运动输出；在平地和串联跑步机行走中采集时空参数、躯干摆动及内外侧质心偏移等步态指标。

Result: 急性tSCS使踝关节本体感觉误差显著增加（p<0.001），背屈力量无显著变化（p=0.30）；步态呈现更受限的模式，步宽和内外侧质心偏移减小（p<0.05）。持续训练后，tSCS组本体感觉误差下降且呈渐进式改善，并在刺激停止后仍持续，优于对照组；矢状面步态指标恢复甚至超过基线，而内外侧指标保持受限，呈方向依赖性重组。

Conclusion: tSCS影响感觉运动控制回路的多个环节：急性期干扰意识性本体感觉并重塑步态行为；持续训练可使神经系统适应改变的传入输入，实现本体感觉的改善和步态的适应。该研究揭示了tSCS在完整感觉运动回路中的多重调控作用，并支持训练可塑性适应假说。

Abstract: Transcutaneous spinal cord stimulation (tSCS) modulates spinal sensorimotor circuits primarily through activation of afferent networks. While prior work has emphasized locomotor performance and spinal excitability, how tSCS affects conscious proprioceptive perception and the extent to which such effects parallel changes in locomotor control remain unclear. We investigated the acute and training-related effects of tSCS on ankle proprioception and gait in unimpaired adults (n = 14), with an independent control group (n = 14) completing identical proprioceptive training without stimulation. Proprioception was quantified using a bilateral robotic assessment of dynamic ankle localization ability (Crisscross), gross motor output using maximum dorsiflexion strength, and gait during normal and tandem treadmill walking using spatiotemporal, trunk-sway, and mediolateral center-of-mass (CoM) excursion measures. Acute tSCS increased ankle proprioceptive error (p < 0.001) while dorsiflexion strength was unchanged (p = 0.30). Gait shifted toward a modestly more constrained locomotor pattern, characterized by reduced step width and ML CoM excursion (p < 0.05). With continued training under stimulation, proprioceptive error decreased and, unlike the control group, the tSCS group showed progressive improvement that persisted after stimulation ended. Sagittal-plane gait measures recovered toward or beyond baseline, whereas mediolateral measures remained constrained, revealing a direction-dependent reorganization of locomotor control. Together, these findings show that tSCS influences multiple aspects of the sensorimotor control loop, disrupting conscious proprioception while reshaping locomotor behavior, and that the nervous system can adapt to altered afferent input through training.

</details>


### [206] [Complexity and Stability of Neural Activity Across Aging and Neurodegenerative Disease](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.05882)
*Junjie Yu,Jianyu Zhang,Zian Pei,Xue Shi,Yumei Liu,Xin Jiang,Quanying Liu,Yi Guo*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 本文提出基于Wasserstein距离和内在维度的分布级框架，量化EEG神经表征的时间稳定性与表征复杂度，揭示二者在不同任务、衰老和疾病中的规律性关联，并可作为认知衰老与神经退行性疾病的敏感生物标志物。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: EEG信号在固定认知状态下仍持续波动，但大脑是否随时间复现相似的活动模式来表征信息仍是一个悬而未决的问题。作者希望通过系统性的量化方法回答这一问题。

Method: 将EEG建模为窗口化活动模式的分布，使用Wasserstein距离量化时间稳定性，通过内在维度刻画表征复杂度；在多任务、生命周期和临床EEG数据集上进行验证。

Result: 神经表征呈现受约束、条件特异性的稳定性而非无约束漂移；内在维度越高则稳定性越低；两种测量具有可复现的空间组织（后部区域维度更高、稳定性更低）；健康衰老伴随维度增加和稳定性降低，而轻度认知障碍和阿尔茨海默病则表现为二者同时坍缩。

Conclusion: 该分布级框架为理解跨认知、衰老和疾病的神经稳定性提供了统一视角，为临床中追踪认知衰老和神经退行性病变提供了原理性的量化手段。

Abstract: Objective: EEG signals fluctuate continuously even within a fixed cognitive state, but an important question is whether the brain still reuses similar activity patterns to represent information over time. Methods: To address this, we model EEG as distributions of windowed activity patterns and quantify their temporal stability using Wasserstein distance, while intrinsic dimensionality captures representational complexity. Results: Across multi-task, lifespan, and clinical EEG datasets, we find that neural representations show constrained, condition-specific stability rather than unconstrained drift. Higher intrinsic dimensionality is consistently associated with lower stability, suggesting that richer representational spaces are less reproducible over time. Both measures exhibit reproducible spatial organization, with posterior regions showing higher dimensionality and lower stability than frontal regions. Healthy aging is characterized by increased dimensionality and reduced stability, whereas mild cognitive impairment and Alzheimer's disease show a joint collapse of both. Conclusions: These findings provide a distribution-level framework for understanding neural stability across cognition, aging, and disease. Significance: This framework offers a principled approach to quantifying neural representational stability, with potential utility as a sensitive biomarker for tracking cognitive aging and neurodegeneration in clinical settings.

</details>


### [207] [Convergent Evolution in Algorithmic Space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.05985)
*Patrick Krauss,Achim Schilling,Andreas Maier,Thomas Kinfe,Henri Stübner,Niklas Römmelt,Claus Metzner*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个基于匹配的框架，用于在结构权重空间中比较不同随机初始化训练的多层感知机（MLP），发现训练于同一任务上的网络在结构空间中更接近彼此，表明任务驱动网络收敛到不同的结构吸引子；此外还发现早期训练阶段功能快速提升但结构变化微小，暗示早期学习通过细微的分布式调整实现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 类比进化生物学中的趋同演化，作者想知道神经网络训练是否也存在类似的趋同现象：不同随机初始化的网络在相同任务上训练后，是否会在内部权重结构上趋同。但由于隐藏神经元可任意置换而不改变函数表示，直接比较权重矩阵会产生误导，因此需要一个能够对齐神经元并公平比较网络结构的框架。

Method: 提出一个匹配基元的比较框架：首先利用置换不变特征对隐藏神经元进行粗略对齐，然后通过迭代匈牙利匹配进行精细对齐；对齐后使用专门设计用于突出任务相关权重模式的结构距离度量来比较网络。在MNIST、Fashion-MNIST和KMNIST上训练小型MLP集成。

Result: 训练于同一任务的网络在结构空间中彼此更接近，而非与训练于不同任务的网络接近；分类准确率在结构距离尚未展现任务特异性分离之前就快速上升，且全局权重分布几乎不变，但单个权重条目已开始协调漂移。

Conclusion: 任务特定训练会将随机初始化的网络引导至结构网络空间中不同的吸引子区域，体现了一种类似生物趋同演化的训练趋同现象。早期学习可能通过细微、分布式的权重调整来强烈影响功能，而网络粗粒度形态几乎不变，这为后续更深入的动力学研究提供了初步见解。

Abstract: In evolutionary biology, unrelated organisms can independently evolve similar structures when exposed to similar functional demands. Here we ask whether an analogous form of convergent evolution occurs during neural network training: do networks with different random initializations develop similar internal weight structures when trained on the same task? This question is technically nontrivial because hidden neurons can be arbitrarily permuted without changing the represented function, making direct matrix comparisons misleading. We introduce a matching-based framework for comparing multilayer perceptrons in structural weight space. Hidden neurons are first coarsely aligned using permutation-invariant features and then refined by iterative Hungarian matching. After alignment, networks are compared with structural distance metrics designed to emphasize task-relevant weight patterns. Applying this approach to ensembles of small MLPs trained on MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, and KMNIST, we find that networks trained on the same task remain closer to one another than to networks trained on different tasks. Thus, task-specific training appears to guide initially random networks toward distinct regions, or attractors, in structural network space. The earliest phase of training reveals an additional and unexpected phenomenon. Classification accuracy rises rapidly before the matched structural distances show strong task-specific separation, and before the global weight distribution visibly changes. Nevertheless, individual weight entries already begin to drift in a coordinated manner. This suggests that early learning may first operate through subtle, distributed adjustments that strongly affect function while leaving coarse network morphology almost unchanged. We treat this early morphogenesis as a first glimpse of a richer dynamical process that will be investigated in future work.

</details>


### [208] [Convergent Evolution in Neural Representation Space: Emergent Order in Deep Belief Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.05996)
*Patrick Krauss,Achim Schilling,Andreas Maier,Thomas Kinfe,Claus Metzner*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 该论文研究了深度信念网络（DBN）在无监督训练下，其内部表示是否自发地按未知数据类别进行组织。通过多种分析工具（GDV、监督探针、重建距离、有效维度、自由样本生成）对MNIST、Fashion-MNIST和KMNIST数据集上的DBN进行逐层分析，发现类特异性聚类随网络深度增加而增强，且这一效应依赖于学习到的特征结构，不能由随机变换等因素解释。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 核心动机在于探究纯无监督的深度生成模型（DBN）是否会在未接收任何类别标签的情况下，自发地在内部表示中形成与数据真实类别相关的组织结构。这涉及一个根本性问题：无监督分层生成学习能否自然发现并放大数据中的类结构。

Method: 研究方法包括：(1) 使用广义判别值（GDV）度量类特异性聚类；(2) 训练后应用监督探针（线性与非线性）评估类别可及性；(3) 基于重建的抽象距离度量；(4) 有效维度分析；(5) 自由样本生成。同时对网络宽度、深度进行系统性扫描，并设计对照组实验（随机变换、权重边缘分布、降维、sigmoid饱和）排除混淆因素。

Result: 实验结果显示：类特异性聚类普遍随深度增加而增强，且独立于数据集和网络宽度；该效应依赖于学习的特征结构；第一隐层常使类别身份对线性/非线性探针更易访问；深层表示变得更紧凑和原型化。同时发现GDV与探针准确率揭示互补信息——平均聚类改善可与少数困难类对的访问性下降共存。

Conclusion: 逐层生成式学习能够在无标签条件下自发发现并逐步放大数据中的类别相关结构，表明无监督深度表示学习具有内在的类别组织能力，为理解深度无监督学习的表征形成机制提供了新视角。

Abstract: Deep Belief Networks (DBNs) learn hierarchical generative models without class supervision. Here, we ask whether this purely unsupervised process nevertheless organizes internal representations according to the unknown data classes. We analyze successive layers of DBNs trained on MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, and KMNIST using the Generalized Discrimination Value (GDV), supervised probes applied only after training, a reconstruction-based measure of abstraction distance, effective dimensionality, and free sample generation. Remarkably, class-specific clustering generally increases with depth across datasets and network widths, although no label information is available during DBN training. Control experiments show that this effect depends on the learned feature structure and cannot be explained by random transformations, weight marginals, dimensionality reduction, or sigmoid saturation. The first hidden layers also frequently make class identity more accessible to linear and nonlinear probes. With greater depth, representations become increasingly compact and prototype-like as neurons acquire correlated feature directions. At the same time, GDV and probe accuracy reveal complementary aspects of class structure: improved average clustering can coexist with reduced accessibility for a few difficult class pairs. These findings demonstrate that layer-wise generative learning can spontaneously uncover and progressively amplify class-related structure in unlabeled data.

</details>


### [209] [Errorless Irrationality: A unified computational account of the inverse base-rate effect across predictive, observational, and unsupervised procedures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.06149)
*Lenard Dome,Andy J. Wills*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 该论文发现逆向基准率效应（inverse base-rate effect）并非依赖监督学习或预测误差信号，在观察学习和无监督（无类别标签）条件下仍然存在。作者提出OSCAR模型，整合了已验证模型的核心计算原理，通过类似模式补全的自生成反馈运作，能够统一解释监督、观察和无监督三种程序下的效应及个体差异，还能解释其他模型无法解释的眼动数据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 逆向基准率效应是一种稳健的认知偏差，但现有主流理论将其归因于预测误差（prediction error）。作者希望通过逐步移除监督学习设计中的误差信号元素（先改为观察学习，再改为无监督程序），检验该偏差是否真的依赖于监督学习和预测误差，从而挑战现有理论解释。

Method: 设计两项实验逐步消除预测误差信号：实验一从传统的监督学习转为观察学习；实验二采用无类别标签的无监督程序。基于实验结果提出新理论OSCAR，该模型整合了最受验证模型的核心计算原理，依靠类似模式补全（pattern completion）的自生成反馈运行。在大型既有监督数据集和两个新实验数据上进行评估，并与替代模型进行对比。

Result: 逆向基准率效应在观察学习和无监督条件下仍然持续存在，表明该偏差独立于监督学习程序。OSCAR模型在与替代模型的竞争中表现具有竞争力，并且是首个能在监督、观察和无监督三种程序下复现人类个体差异模式的模型。此外，OSCAR还成功解释了此前无法解释的眼动追踪数据。

Conclusion: 逆向基准率效应并非由监督学习中的预测误差驱动，是一种更基本的、独立于学习范式的认知偏差。OSCAR模型通过自生成的模式补全式反馈，将这一响应偏差的学习动力学统一扩展到观察性和无监督性程序，为理解该效应的认知机制提供了更全面的理论框架。

Abstract: The inverse base-rate effect is a robust bias in how people resolve ambiguity between competing categories, and the most prominent theories explain it through prediction error. Across two experiments we progressively removed the elements of the predictive-learning design that supply such error signals: first by moving to observational learning, then to an unsupervised procedure in which category labels were not presented. The effect persisted--the irrational bias is independent of supervised learning procedures. We propose a new theory, OSCAR, that integrates core computational principles of the best-validated models and operates on self-generated feedback akin to pattern completion. OSCAR extends the learning dynamics underlying the response bias to observational and unsupervised procedures. Evaluated on a large preexisting supervised dataset in addition to the two new experiments reported here, OSCAR performs competitively against alternatives, and is the first model that reproduces the pattern of individual differences seen in humans across all three procedures. The model provides an explanation of hitherto unexplained eye-tracking data, something none of the alternative accounts provide.

</details>


<div id='cs.RO'></div>

# cs.RO [[Back]](#toc)

### [210] [VLAff: Vision-Language-Affordance Model for Unified Actionable Affordances](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.05215)
*Jihoon Oh,Kento Kawaharazuka,Kei Okada*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提出VLAff框架，利用第一人称人类视频提取可执行的操作可供性（视觉、抓取、轨迹），构建了包含204K片段的大规模EgoAffordance数据集，并训练统一的基础模型实现跨模态学习，可直接应用于真实机器人操作任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从人类视频学习机器人操作技能具有规模化潜力，但人与机器人之间的形态差异（embodiment mismatch）构成了核心挑战。现有方法难以有效解决这一差异问题，亟需一种与具体执行器无关（embodiment-agnostic）的可供性学习方案。

Method: 提出VLAff框架：1）利用第一人称人类视频，结合3D Structure-from-Motion和手部网格重建技术，提取视觉可供性（在哪里交互）、抓取可供性（如何抓取）和轨迹可供性（如何移动）；2）构建EgoAffordance大规模数据集（204K片段，5.6M视觉可供性和11.6M抓取/轨迹可供性）；3）基于大视觉-语言模型训练统一的VLAff基础模型，学习所有可供性间的跨模态关联，输入视觉观察和指令后生成热力图、抓取位姿和轨迹，并利用3D场景信息转化为可直接执行的动作。

Result: 实验表明VLAff在视觉可供性预测上达到最先进水平（SOTA），并能有效应用于真实机器人场景，包括零样本操作和可供性引导的机器人学习。

Conclusion: 通过提取对象中心的、与执行器无关的可执行可供性，结合大规模数据和统一基础模型，VLAff有效弥合了人类与机器人之间的形态差异，为从人类视频进行可扩展的机器人学习提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Learning manipulation skills from human videos is promising for scalable robot learning. However, the embodiment mismatch between humans and robots makes this challenging. One promising solution is to learn object-centric actionable affordances that are embodiment-agnostic. In this work, we propose a framework that leverages egocentric human videos with state-of-the-art 3D Structure-from-Motion and hand mesh reconstruction to extract actionable affordances such as visual, grasp, and trajectory affordances that explicitly encode where to interact, how to grasp, and how to move. We construct EgoAffordance, a large-scale dataset comprising 204K episodes with 5.6M visual affordances and 11.6M grasp and trajectory affordances. Building on this, we introduce VLAff, a large vision-language model-based unified foundation model that learns cross-modal correlations across all actionable affordances. Given a visual observation and instruction, VLAff generates visual affordance heatmaps, grasp poses, and trajectories, which are then converted into directly executable actions by utilizing 3D scene information. Through extensive experiments, we demonstrate that VLAff not only achieves state-of-the-art performance on visual affordance prediction, but can also be effectively applied to real robot applications such as zero-shot manipulation and affordance-guided robot learning.

</details>


### [211] [A System for Train Condition Monitoring and Structural Health Assessment of Rail Vehicles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.05221)
*Maximilian Posner,Martin Dazer,Daniela Lauer,Robert Winkler-Höhn,Mathilde Laporte,Tobias Herrmann,Martin Köppel*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一种将结构传感技术与基于AI的数据分析相结合的新型实时车辆状态监测和冲击检测框架，用于解决干线铁路在更高自动化等级（GoA4）运行中的关键安全挑战，涵盖冲击/碰撞/碾压事件检测、基于状态维护和长期数据分析三大应用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 铁路系统的数字化和AI应用正在改变轨道车辆的设计、运营和维护方式。虽然GoA4全自动化运行已在城市地铁系统中成熟应用，但由于严格的安全要求和开放运营环境的复杂性，干线铁路尚未实现同等程度的自动化。现有基于摄像头、雷达和激光雷达的感知系统虽能有效检测物体，但在可靠识别冲击、碰撞和碾压事件方面能力有限，这严重阻碍了干线铁路向更高自动化等级过渡。

Method: 论文提出一种集成结构传感器技术与基于AI的数据分析的新型实时车辆状态监测和冲击检测方法框架。该框架通过结构传感器采集车辆运行过程中的物理状态数据，结合AI算法进行实时数据分析和事件识别，实现三大核心应用：（1）自动检测冲击、结构损伤和碾压事件；（2）通过连续监测实现基于状态的维护；（3）利用长期数据分析支持车辆设计优化。

Result: 实验结果表明该方法的可行性，证明了其在增强运营安全、实现预测性维护策略以及支持干线铁路向全自动化运行过渡方面的潜力。

Conclusion: 该研究通过结构传感与AI的融合，为干线铁路实现全自动化运行（GoA4）所面临的冲击检测和车辆状态监测这一关键瓶颈问题提供了可行的解决方案，为干线铁路系统的智能化升级和预测性维护转型奠定了基础。

Abstract: The ongoing digitalization of rail systems and the increasing use of artificial intelligence (AI) are fundamentally transforming the design, operation, and maintenance of rail vehicles. While fully automated operation at Grade of Automation 4 (GoA4) is well established in metro systems, its deployment in mainline rail remains limited. This is primarily due to stringent safety requirements and the complexity of open operational environments. Current perception systems based on cameras, radar, and lidar are effective in detecting objects but provide limited capability for reliably identifying impacts, collisions, and driving-over events. This paper presents a novel approach for real-time vehicle condition monitoring and impact detection that integrates structural sensor technologies with AI-based data analysis. The proposed framework addresses three key applications: (1) automated detection of impacts, structural damage, and driving-over events, (2) condition-based maintenance enabled by continuous monitoring, and (3) long-term data analytics to support vehicle design optimization. The results demonstrate the feasibility of the proposed approach and highlight its potential to enhance operational safety, enable predictive maintenance strategies, and support the transition toward fully automated operation in mainline rail systems

</details>


### [212] [Failing Gracefully: Mitigating Impact of Inevitable Robot Failures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.05313)
*Duc M. Nguyen,Saad A. Ghani,Andrew Marshall,Allison Andreyev,Gregory J. Stein,Xuesu Xiao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种新颖的安全公式，用于评估服务机器人在家庭环境中发生故障时与周围实体（人类、宠物、物体）发生影响性交互的概率及其后果严重程度，并配套推出FailBench仿真框架以系统化研究各种故障模式下的机器人-环境交互。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 服务机器人在家庭环境中不可避免地会发生诸如软件崩溃、硬件退化或不可预测交互等故障，而现有研究缺乏系统化的方法在规划层面量化故障对周围实体的影响，难以在安全性和任务效率之间做出权衡。

Method: 提出一个安全公式，同时评估故障期间机器人与周围实体之间高影响交互的概率和后果严重程度；基于此量化不同实体的影响，指导规划决策在安全与效率间取得平衡。同时构建了基于MuJoCo的FailBench仿真框架，支持传感问题和执行器故障等多种故障模式的机器人-环境交互研究。

Result: 安全公式与FailBench相结合，为在真实家庭环境中开发更安全、更鲁棒的机器人运动规划和学习策略提供了基础支撑。

Conclusion: 该工作为服务机器人故障条件下的安全部署提供了系统化的评估工具和量化框架，有助于推动更安全可靠的机器人应用。

Abstract: Service robots operate in household environments shared with humans, pets, and everyday objects, where they are highly susceptible to failures such as software crashes, hardware degradation, or unpredictable interactions. While roboticists strive to minimize failures, some remain inevitable, making it critical to mitigate their potential consequences for safe and reliable deployment. This paper introduces a novel safety formulation that evaluates both the probability of impactful interactions between robots and surrounding entities during failures, and the severity of their outcomes. By quantifying the impact of failures on different entities, our approach enables robots to make informed planning decisions that balance safety with task efficiency. To support systematic evaluation, we also present FailBench, a MuJoCo-based simulation framework for studying robot-environment interactions under diverse failure modes, including sensing issues and actuator malfunctions. Together, our safety formulation and FailBench provide a foundation for developing safer and more robust motion plans and learned policies in real-world household environments.

</details>


### [213] [Unified Planning-Learning Framework for Robust UUV Navigation Under Partial Observability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.05365)
*Md Ether Deowan,Eleni Kelasidi*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种面向动态水下环境的无人潜航器（UUV）纯观测自主导航框架，融合持久占用地图构建、全局间隙感知规划与风险感知局部控制；通过行为树蒸馏、不确定性校准及强化学习策略实现部分可观测条件下的鲁棒安全导航，并在NVIDIA Isaac Sim高保真仿真中通过多种子评估协议验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动态水下环境中UUV面临部分可观测性、复杂障碍动态及安全导航等挑战，现有方法缺乏将长期全局规划与短期反应式避障统一整合的框架，且缺乏可复现的评估协议以验证鲁棒性与安全性。

Method: 该框架包含三个核心组件：(1)从声呐和深度图像构建持久占用地图；(2)采用间隙约束的全局规划器提供长时域结构；(3)强化学习策略处理短距离跟踪与反应式避障。此外，引入行为树蒸馏与分阶段监督提升安全性与训练稳定性，通过不确定性校准蒸馏机制利用在线潜变量模型不确定性对教师指导进行重加权，同时在规划与局部策略特征中显式保留时间到碰撞（TTC）和间隙线索。

Result: 在高保真GPU加速仿真（NVIDIA Isaac Sim）中建立可复现的多种子评估协议，与仅BT及标准RL基线对比，结果表明该框架在动态条件下展现出更优的鲁棒性与安全性。

Conclusion: 该工作提供了一个统一的混合规划学习架构及可复现的评估方法，为部分可观测条件下鲁棒的UUV自主导航提供了通用流程。

Abstract: This paper presents an observation-only autonomy framework for Unmanned Underwater Vehicles (UUVs) navigation in dynamic underwater environments that integrates persistent occupancy mapping, global clearance-aware planning, and risk-aware local control. The proposed pipeline constructs occupancy maps solely from onboard sonar and depth image observations, adapts a clearance-constrained global planner (GP) to provide long-horizon structure, and integrates a reinforcement learning (RL) policy to handle short-range tracking and reactive avoidance. To further support decision-making under partial observability, the system learns a compact latent state representation from onboard sensor data, encoding environmental structure, obstacle dynamics, and uncertainty. Behavior tree (BT) distillation with staged supervision is introduced to improve safety and training stability, while an uncertainty-calibrated distillation mechanism reweights teacher guidance using online latent-model uncertainty, emphasizing uncertain regimes during learning, with time-to-collision (TTC) and clearance cues remaining explicit in planning and local policy features. To demonstrate the efficacy of the framework, a reproducible multi-seed evaluation protocol is established in high-fidelity GPU-accelerated simulation using NVIDIA Isaac Sim, and performance is benchmarked against BT-only and standard RL baselines. The results obtained demonstrate improved robustness and safety under dynamic conditions, thus providing a general pipeline with a unified hybrid planning learning architecture and a reproducible methodology for robust UUV autonomy under partial observability.

</details>


### [214] [World-to-Wrist: Task-Conditioned Future Wrist Modeling for Fine-Grained Robot Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.05369)
*Yuhao Pan,Haosong Peng,Zhengshen Zhang,Zhengyang Yan,Yalun Dai,Fushuo Huo,Chujie Wang,Tianyu Qi,Xiucheng Wang,Nan Cheng,Wenchao Xu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出W2-VLA，一种面向精细机器人操作的视觉-语言-动作模型，通过任务条件下的未来腕部建模来利用主视图与腕部视图的不同角色，提升接触敏感和细粒度操作性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLA模型将主视图和腕部视图视为并行视觉输入，忽略了它们在机器人操作中的不同作用。精细操作需要利用全局任务上下文预测腕部局部交互的演变，而现有方法缺少这种时间维度的前瞻能力。

Method: W2-VLA引入一组潜在建模token作为视觉语言模型与腕部预测器之间的紧凑接口；条件于该接口和观测到的腕部历史，预测器预测未来腕部潜在表示，并转换为未来感知上下文用于动作预测。同时提出W2-CoT合成管道，生成描述操作进展、物理转换线索和腕部局部证据的结构化标注，作为辅助监督信号塑造任务条件潜在接口。

Result: 在LIBERO、RoboTwin 2.0和真实世界操作任务上的实验表明，W2-VLA在单臂和双臂设置下均提升了细粒度和接触敏感操作的性能，同时保持80 Hz以上的动作生成速率。

Conclusion: 通过显式建模腕部未来的演变过程并将其融入动作预测，W2-VLA有效利用了多视角观察的互补角色，实现了更高的操作精度和控制频率，为精细机器人操作提供了一种新的VLA架构范式。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models often treat main-view and wrist-view observations as parallel visual inputs, overlooking their distinct roles in robot manipulation. Fine-grained manipulation, however, benefits from anticipating how wrist-local interactions may evolve under the global task context. To address this limitation, we present World-to-Wrist VLA (W2-VLA), a VLA model for fine-grained robot manipulation with task-conditioned future wrist modeling. Given current multi-view observations and a task instruction, W2-VLA contextualizes a set of latent modeling tokens as a compact interface between the vision-language model and the wrist predictor. Conditioned on this interface and the observed wrist history, the predictor forecasts future wrist latents, which are transformed into future-aware context for action prediction. In addition, we introduce W2-CoT, a synthesis pipeline that produces structured annotations describing manipulation progress, physical transition cues, and wrist-local evidence. These annotations provide auxiliary supervision that shapes the task-conditioned latent interface. Experiments on LIBERO, RoboTwin 2.0, and real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate improved fine-grained and contact-sensitive manipulation across both single-arm and bimanual settings, while maintaining action-generation rates above 80 Hz.

</details>


### [215] [Sliding Sensors: Configurable Confidence in State Estimation for Continuum Robots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.05410)
*Ella Walsh,Spencer Teetaert,Eric Diller,Timothy D. Barfoot,Jessica Burgner-Kahrs*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种机械可重构传感方案，通过在连续体机器人内纵向滑动传感器来调控状态估计的不确定性分布，相比固定尖端传感器可降低全身形变估计误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 连续体机器人在不确定环境中运行，状态估计的不确定性在空间上非均匀分布，且全局估计精度并非总是最高优先级，关键在于任务相关位置达到足够置信度。现有固定传感器位置无法灵活应对这种空间可变的估计需求。

Method: 提出机械可重构传感概念，通过传感器在连续体机器人内部的纵向平移来动态调整测量位置，从而实现状态估计不确定性的空间整形。设计了概念硬件原型验证可行性，并通过对比滑动传感器与固定尖端传感器的估计性能进行评估。

Result: 证明了状态估计置信度可通过改变传感器位置进行重构，且随时间来回滑动传感器相比单一固定尖端传感器，可降低全身体型估计误差。

Conclusion: 机械可重构传感为连续体机器人在任务相关位置实现所需估计置信度提供了新的可行路径，具有更好的空间不确定性与控制能力。

Abstract: Continuum robots often operate in uncertain environments, where accurate state estimation is essential for safe interactions. Estimate uncertainty is inherently spatially non-uniform: confidence varies depending on where measurements are available. Global estimation accuracy is not always the top priority, but rather achieving sufficient confidence at task-relevant locations along the robot. This extended abstract introduces mechanically reconfigurable sensing enabling uncertainty-shaping in state estimation for continuum robots. We present a concept hardware design demonstrating the feasibility of longitudinal translation of a sensor within a continuum robot. We demonstrate that state estimation confidence can be reconfigured by varying the sensor location, and show a reduction of full-body shape estimation errors when sliding the sensor back and forth over time, compared to a single fixed tip sensor.

</details>


### [216] [ARGUS: Aligning Robot Scene Geometry Under Shifting Views with Large 3D Vision Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.05579)
*Rishik Sathua,Haonan Chen,Katherine Driggs-Campbell*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出ARGUS，一种观测预处理管线，利用大规模3D视觉模型将来自任意相机视角的图像观测对齐到规范视角，再传给下游视觉运动策略，从而解决策略将场景几何与视角纠缠的问题，实现从多视角多样化数据集（如DROID、BridgeV2）中更高效地学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有大规模视觉运动策略虽然性能优异，但往往将场景几何与对应视角纠缠在一起，学的是图像中物体的位置而非任务空间中的位置。这种纠缠限制了策略从视角多样的数据集（如DROID、BridgeV2）中学习，也难以泛化到训练数据中未覆盖的视角。

Method: ARGUS是一个观测预处理管线，利用大规模3D视觉模型将来自任意相机视角的图像观测对齐到一个规范视角（canonical viewpoint），然后再将对齐后的观测传递给下游视觉运动策略。通过这种方式，简化了策略的观测空间，降低了学习负担。

Result: 在从固定多相机配置到高度多样化相机布局等多层次视角多样性的训练数据集上，ARGUS在有限视角和视角多样训练机制下均一致优于先前方法。在效率对比中，ARGUS通过利用简化的观测空间，收敛到高成功率的速度比先前方法快4-6倍。

Conclusion: 利用大规模3D视觉模型可以减少视觉运动策略的学习负担，使其能够从大规模、视角多样的机器人数据集中更高效地学习。

Abstract: Large-scale visuomotor policies have demonstrated impressive performance across a wide range of robot manipulation tasks. However, despite this success, manipulation polices often entangle scene geometry with the corresponding viewpoint, learning where objects lie in an image rather than where it lies in the task space. This entanglement inherently limits the corresponding policy's ability to learn from viewpoint-diverse datasets (ex. DROID, BridgeV2) and generalize beyond the viewpoints captured in their training data. In this work, we present ARGUS, an observation pre-processing pipeline that uses large-scale 3D vision models to align image observations from arbitrary camera viewpoints into a canonical viewpoint before passing it to downstream visuomotor policies. Experiments across training datasets with varying levels of viewpoint diversity, from fixed multi-view camera configurations to highly varied camera placements, show that our method consistently outperforms prior approaches across both limited-view and view-diverse training regimes. In efficiency comparisons, ARGUS demonstrates an ability to learn from view-diverse data, converging to high success rates 4-6x faster than previous methods by leveraging a simplified observation space. Overall, our findings show that leveraging large-scale 3D vision models reduces the learning burden on visuomotor policies, enabling more efficient learning from large-scale, viewpoint-diverse robot datasets.

</details>


### [217] [PathCover: A Fast Convex Decomposition along a Path via Randomized Iterative Space Partitioning (RISP) on Point Clouds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.05586)
*Kunal S. Narkhede,Abhijeet M. Kulkarni,Guoquan Huang,Ioannis Poulakakis*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出PathCover框架，核心是一个名为RISP的随机化算法，直接从原始点云数据中构造凸多面体走廊，期望线性时间内完成，用于自动驾驶/自主机器人导航中的实时轨迹规划。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自主机器人导航需要快速生成无障碍区域以供轨迹规划使用，但现有的走廊生成器难以满足实时、传感速率的计算约束，成为规划管道的瓶颈。

Method: 提出PathCover框架，其核心为RISP（一种新颖的随机化算法），在温和的概率消除条件下以期望线性时间直接从原始点云构造凸多面体；生成重叠且无障碍的多面体序列，用于约束下游MPC和轨迹优化。

Result: 在合成和真实LiDAR数据集上相比最先进方法实现一个数量级的加速，同时保持相当的走廊体积；通过高保真四旋翼仿真和四足机器人实时LiDAR物理部署验证了完整流程。

Conclusion: PathCover/RISP有效解决了走廊生成的实时计算瓶颈，兼具理论保证（有限步终止、沿无障碍参考路径持续推进）和工程实用性，适用于自主机器人导航场景。

Abstract: Autonomous robot navigation requires the rapid generation of obstacle-free regions for trajectory planning. However, existing corridor generators struggle to meet real-time, sensor-rate computational constraints. To resolve this bottleneck, we introduce PathCover, a framework driven by RISP; a novel randomized algorithm that constructs convex polytopes directly from raw point cloud data in expected linear time under a mild probabilistic elimination condition. PathCover generates sequences of overlapping, obstacle-free polytopes that safely constrain downstream MPC and trajectory optimization. We mathematically guarantee that the algorithm terminates in finite steps while ensuring continuous progress along any obstacle-free reference path. Extensive benchmarks on synthetic and real-world LiDAR datasets demonstrate an order-of-magnitude speedup over state-of-the-art methods while maintaining comparable corridor volumes. The complete pipeline is validated via high-fidelity quadrotor simulations and physical deployment on a quadrupedal robot navigating constrained environments using live LiDAR perception.

</details>


### [218] [Search-Aided Joint Agent-Environment Reinforcement Learning for Robust Lifelong Multi-Agent Path Finding with Rotations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.05588)
*He Jiang,Jingtian Yan,Yulun Zhang,Yimin Tang,Tanishq Duhan,Rishi Veerapaneni,Guillaume Sartoretti,Jiaoyang Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出SJRL方法，将因果PIBT搜索规划器与联合强化学习相结合，解决具有鲁棒安全约束和原地旋转约束的终身多智能体路径规划（LMAPF-R2）问题，并在高密度地图和混合现实仓库环境中验证了有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LMAPF学习方法大多使用过度简化的运动学假设，忽略了真实世界中关键的动力学约束（如安全约束和原地旋转约束）。这些约束在真实自动仓库系统中至关重要，但在现有方法中被忽视，导致学习到的策略难以在真实环境部署。

Method: 提出搜索辅助联合强化学习（SJRL）框架，包含两个关键组件：(1) 将神经策略与Causal PIBT（单步搜索规划器）结合，用于解决智能体冲突并传播意图；(2) 引入统一的RL公式，联合优化智能体策略和环境策略，其中环境策略学习图边代价，通过向后Dijkstra搜索提供全局移动引导。

Result: 在多个高密度地图上，SJRL相比强大的搜索基线Causal-PIBT取得了显著的性能提升；并在包含8个物理机器人和248个虚拟机器人的挑战性混合现实仓库环境中得到验证。

Conclusion: SJRL通过将搜索规划与强化学习结合，在引入真实运动约束的LMAPF场景中实现了超越纯搜索方法的效果，证明了神经搜索混合方法在复杂约束下的LMAPF问题中的有效性。

Abstract: Lifelong Multi-Agent Path Finding (LMAPF) requires repeatedly planning collision-free paths for agents that continuously receive new goals upon reaching their current ones. While many learning-based planners have been proposed for LMAPF, most rely on oversimplified kinematic assumptions that may overlook motion constraints critical to real-world performance. In this work, we study a more realistic LMAPF model derived from many real-world automated warehouse systems, termed LMAPF-R2, which incorporates robust safety constraints and in-place rotation constraints. These constraints substantially increase coordination difficulty, particularly in highly constrained spaces. To address these challenges, we propose Search-Aided Joint Reinforcement Learning (SJRL). We first augment neural policies with Causal PIBT, a single-step search-based planner that resolves agents' collisions and propagates their intentions. We then introduce a unified RL formulation that jointly optimizes agent and environment policies, where the environment policy learns graph edge costs to provide global movement guidance via backward Dijkstra search. Experiments demonstrate that SJRL achieves significant improvements over the strong search-based planner, Causal-PIBT, across multiple high-density maps. We further validate SJRL in a challenging mixed-reality warehouse environment with 8 physical robots and 248 virtual robots.

</details>


### [219] [KILVO: Kinematic-Inertial-LiDAR-Visual Odometry with Robust Multimodal Adaptation for Humanoid Robots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.05647)
*Jixin Gao,Fucheng Liu,Teng Zhang,Fusheng Zha*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出KILVO，一种面向人形机器人的运动学-惯性-LiDAR-视觉里程计融合框架，通过异步-顺序混合误差状态迭代卡尔曼滤波器（ESIKF）融合关节编码器、IMU、LiDAR和相机数据，在多模态自适应机制下具备传感器故障鲁棒性，并在公开数据集和多种真实人形机器人上验证了高精度、高效率和强鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 面向人形机器人的自主定位需要充分利用平台上已配备的多源传感器，而现有融合方法未能针对人形机器人平台特征（如腿部运动学）和传感器异构特性进行专门设计，且在传感器退化或失效场景下鲁棒性不足。

Method: 提出KILVO框架，采用异步-顺序混合ESIKF架构：惯性数据做预测；腿部关节编码器以高频率异步处理，提供本体感知约束；外感受数据按顺序更新——先通过LiDAR点云配准获取几何先验，再通过光度误差更新视觉分量。同时设计多模态自适应机制以增强对传感器故障的韧性，并开发了无需额外传感器的紧凑接触估计模块。

Result: 在公开数据集和多个真实人形机器人、多种步态模式和场景下的广泛实验表明，KILVO在精度、效率和输出频率方面具有高度竞争力，并且对传感器退化与故障表现出强鲁棒性，优于现有的最先进融合方法。

Conclusion: KILVO充分利用人形机器人常见传感器并针对平台特性定制融合策略，在精度、效率和鲁棒性上均具有优势，比现有SOTA融合方法更适合人形机器人应用；代码和数据集已开源。

Abstract: This article presents a kinematic-inertial-LiDAR-visual odometry for humanoid robots, called KILVO. Tailored to the platform features, requirements, and real-world complexity, it fully utilizes the sensors commonly equipped on humanoid robots, including joint encoders, IMU, LiDAR, and camera, within an asynchronous-sequential hybrid error-state iterated Kalman filter (ESIKF). Specifically, inertial data are used for prediction, leg kinematics are processed asynchronously at a high rate and provide proprioceptive constraints, while exteroception is updated sequentially, first by registering LiDAR points for geometric priors and then by updating the visual component via photometric errors. Moreover, the framework is elaborately designed with multimodal adaptation for resilience to sensor failures. A compact contact estimation module is also developed, sharing information with state estimation without additional sensors. Extensive experiments on public datasets and in the real world across multiple humanoid robots, gait patterns, and scenarios demonstrate that KILVO achieves highly competitive accuracy, efficiency, and output rates, with strong robustness against sensor degradation and failures, making it more suitable for humanoid robots than state-of-the-art fusion methods. Our code and datasets are released on GitHub.

</details>


### [220] [JoyAI-RA 0.5: Scaling Robot Manipulation Learning via Dual Action Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.05674)
*JoyAI-RA Team*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: JoyAI-RA 0.5是一个通用视觉-语言-世界-动作(VLWA)框架，通过双重动作对齐（隐式动作对齐与显式动作对齐）将人类第一视角视频、仿真和真实机器人等异构数据统一用于操作技能的规模化学习，并在真实AgiBot基准上展现出随人类数据量增加而持续提升的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人数据稀缺，通用策略需要从异构数据源（人类第一视角视频、仿真、真实机器人）中学习，但这些数据在监督信号和具身形态上存在差异，动作标签缺失或互不兼容。人类第一视角数据规模最大但与机器人数据分布差距最大，简单的数据混合会导致负迁移而非知识共享，因此需要新方法实现跨数据源的知识融合与迁移。

Method: 提出JoyAI-RA 0.5框架：将物理世界动力学先验与视觉语义耦合，通过双重动作对齐跨越异构数据。隐式动作对齐从视觉转换中推断潜在动作，使无动作标签的人类、仿真和机器人数据引导潜在动作条件下的世界模型学习物理动力学；显式动作对齐通过规范动作表示和相机帧块相对末端执行器动作，将可靠的人类与机器人轨迹统一到物理动作空间。随后采用内外双环强化阶段，结合高效任务适配与基础策略改进。

Result: 在真实AgiBot基准上，JoyAI-RA在已见任务和未见变体上均表现优异。任务分数随人类第一视角预训练数据量增加而持续提升，且在本实验最大规模下未见平台期，表明丰富但弱标注的人类经验可转化为可迁移的训练信号。

Conclusion: 人类视频不仅是弱辅助数据源，而是可以作为驱动操作能力规模化扩展的主要维度的关键结论。该工作表明弱标注的人类经验可以转化为可迁移的训练信号，为实现以人类数据为主轴的操作技能规模化学习提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Robot data is scarce, so generalist policies need to learn from heterogeneous sources, including human egocentric video, simulation, and real robots, which differ in supervision and embodiment, with action labels missing or mutually incompatible. Human egocentric data scale best but sit farthest from robot data, and naive pooling causes negative transfer rather than knowledge sharing. We propose JoyAI-RA 0.5, a generalist Vision-Language-World-Action (VLWA) framework that couples physical world-dynamics priors with visual semantics and scales manipulation learning across such data via dual action alignment. Implicit action alignment infers latent actions from visual transitions, enabling action-free human, simulation, and robot data to guide a latent-action-conditioned world model in learning physical dynamics. Explicit alignment grounds reliable human and robot trajectories in a unified physical action space through a canonical action representation and camera-frame chunk-relative end-effector actions. An inner-outer-loop reinforcement stage then pairs efficient task adaptation with foundation-policy improvement. On a real-world AgiBot benchmark, JoyAI-RA performs strongly on both seen tasks and unseen variations. The task score improves consistently as the volume of human egocentric pretraining data increases and shows no sign of plateauing at our largest scale. This suggests that abundant but weakly labeled human experience can be converted into a transferable training signal, making human video not merely a weak auxiliary source but a primary axis along which manipulation capability can be scaled. Project page can be found at https://joyai-ra-05.github.io/.

</details>


### [221] [Nonvisual Classification of Ground-Condition by Artificial Proprioception in an Amoeba-Inspired Autonomous Walking Robot](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.05684)
*Hyoto Yamaguchi,Zenji Yatabe,Seiya Kasai*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于多模态感知的触觉式地面条件分类方法，利用三轴加速度计、八个足部压力传感器和储层计算（RC）实现非视觉地面分类，应用于受变形虫启发的四足自主行走机器人，并实现了根据地面条件在线切换行走步态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自主行走机器人需要感知地面条件以调整步态，但传统基于视觉的感知方法计算开销大且依赖图像处理。本文旨在探索无需图像感知与处理的非视觉多模态感知方法，实现对地面条件（平坦或粗糙）的高精度分类。

Method: 采用人工本体感觉（artificial proprioception）方案，集成三轴加速度计和八个足部压力传感器，通过储层计算（Reservoir Computing, RC）对多模态传感器数据进行处理与分类。系统无需图像传感，直接利用行走过程中由机器人动态运动引起的传感器大幅度波动信号进行地面条件识别。

Result: 即使四足机器人在行走过程中存在大幅度的传感器输出波动，该系统仍能高精度地区分平坦与粗糙地面条件。此外，实现了机器人根据地面条件在线切换行走步态，并分析了各传感器对地面分类的贡献。

Conclusion: 多模态感知结合储层计算为非视觉地面分类提供了一种有效途径，能够在动态行走条件下实现高精度地面识别，并支持机器人步态的自主适应调整。

Abstract: Nonvisual classification of ground condition based on a multimodal sensing approach was investigated for an amoeba-inspired autonomous walking robot. To classify ground condition without image sensing and processing, we implemented artificial proprioception by integrating a three-axis accelerometer, eight foot pressure sensors, and reservoir computing (RC). Even when large fluctuations in the sensor outputs are caused by dynamic motions of a four-legged robot in walking, our system can classify the ground condition, flat or rough, with high accuracy. We demonstrate on-site switching of walking gait depending on ground condition in the robot. We also discuss the contribution of each sensor to ground condition classification.

</details>


### [222] [Hijacking Robots with a Piece of Paper: A Systematic Study of Physical Prompt Injection in VLM-Controlled Robots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.05715)
*S. M . Bhagya P. Samarakoon,M. A. Viraj J. Muthugala,W. K. R. Sachinthana,Mohan Rajesh Elara*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了针对VLM控制的分拣机器人系统的物理提示注入攻击，提出了四分类法（间接标识、任务重定义、权威冒充、冲突注入）并构建了包含20个攻击提示的基准，在3种物理场景布局和3种命令表述下对3个前沿VLM（GPT-4o、Gemini 2.5 Flash、Qwen3-VL-32B）进行了5,670次试验，攻击成功率分别为27.0%、29.4%和5.0%。研究发现成功攻击几乎总是"有意识"的（99.9%的承认率），不同模型采用结构不同的防御机制。评估了三种缓解措施：基于提示的防御（75-100%有效）、两阶段验证（85-100%）和预处理文本掩蔽（100%），但防御可能损害需要读取场景内标签的任务能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLMs越来越多地被部署为机器人系统中的规划器，将自然语言命令转化为基于视觉场景理解的执行动作。这种感知与指令跟随的紧密耦合引入了新的攻击面：放置在机器人视野中的对抗性文本可作为对VLM推理栈的间接提示注入。作者旨在系统性地研究和量化这一物理提示注入攻击威胁，并评估防御措施。

Method: 提出了四分类攻击分类法（间接标识、任务重定义、权威冒充、冲突注入），构建20个攻击提示的基准，覆盖3种物理场景布局和3种命令表述变体（在目的地特定性和规则明确性上变化）。在GPT-4o、Gemini 2.5 Flash和Qwen3-VL-32B三个模型上进行了5,670次试验，并分析推理痕迹以理解攻击机制。评估了三种缓解措施：基于提示的防御、两阶段验证和预处理文本掩蔽。

Result: 攻击成功率分别为GPT-4o 27.0%、Gemini 2.5 Flash 29.4%、Qwen3-VL-32B 5.0%。权威冒充和否定类攻击可跨所有三个模型迁移。成功攻击中有99.9%的推理痕迹显示模型"有意识地"承认了攻击指令。模型通过不同机制防御：Gemini采用显式拒绝，GPT-4o则通过感知性忽视。三种缓解措施有效性为：基于提示的防御75-100%（依赖模型）、两阶段验证85-100%、预处理文本掩蔽100%。防御措施在基准测试中保留了通用任务能力，但可能损害需要读取场景内标签的任务。

Conclusion: VLM控制的操作系统对可读的物理标识存在有意义的脆弱性，简单防御能显著降低风险，但防御选择涉及权衡（如可能影响需要读取场景内标签的任务）。研究表明这是一个现实且值得关注的攻击向量，同时提示了可落地的防御方向。

Abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are increasingly deployed as planners in robotic systems, where they translate natural-language commands into executable actions grounded in visual scene understanding. This tight coupling between perception and instruction-following introduces a new attack surface: adversarial text placed within the robot's visual field can act as an indirect prompt injection into the VLM's reasoning stack. We present a systematic study of physical prompt injection attacks against VLM-controlled sorting, introducing a four-category taxonomy, indirect signage, task redefinition, authority impersonation, and conflict injection, instantiated as a benchmark of 20 attack prompts evaluated across three physical scene layouts and three command formulations that vary in destination specificity and rule explicitness. Across 5,670 trials on three frontier VLMs (GPT-4o, Gemini 2.5 Flash, Qwen3-VL-32B), attacks succeed at 27.0%, 29.4%, and 5.0% respectively, with authority-impersonating and negation attacks transferring across all three models. Analysis of reasoning traces reveals that successful compromise is nearly always conscious (99.9% acknowledgment rate), and that models defend through structurally different mechanisms, explicit rejection for Gemini, perceptual inattention for GPT-4o. We evaluate three simple mitigations: prompt-based defense (75-100% effective, model-dependent), two-stage verification (85-100%), and pre-processing text masking (100%). Our findings show that VLM-controlled manipulation is meaningfully vulnerable to human-readable physical signage, and that simple defenses substantially reduce risk, though defense choice involves trade-offs. The defenses preserve general task capabilities in our benchmark, but they may impair tasks that require reading in-scene labels.

</details>


### [223] [ATP: Anatomical Torque with Passivity-based Control Framework for Safe Upper-Limb Exoskeleton Assistance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.05723)
*Yu Chen,Gong Chen,Xiang Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出ATP（Anatomical Torque with Passivity-Based Control）框架，用于上肢外骨骼的安全辅助。通过可扩展的肌肉骨骼仿真框架训练统一的强化学习肌肉控制器生成解剖参考扭矩，结合在线扭矩精炼方案抑制肌腱引起的力矩尖峰，并利用基于能量罐的交互扭矩控制器实现被动性保障。仿真与实物实验验证了长时程运动跟踪和实时人类运动泛化能力，EMG研究显示目标肌肉活动最多降低48%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有解剖学辅助主要集中于下肢外骨骼，其周期性、承重运动对扭矩精度要求较低；将类似方法推广到复杂、非周期的上肢运动仍具挑战。本文旨在实现安全、舒适且能跨任务泛化的上肢外骨骼辅助。

Method: 1) 可扩展的肌肉骨骼仿真框架训练统一RL肌肉控制器，跨上肢运动泛化并生成解剖参考扭矩；2) 在线扭矩精炼方案适应多样运动、抑制肌腱诱发力矩尖峰，引入学习异常分数保障安全舒适；3) 通过缆绳驱动柔顺外骨骼的交互扭矩控制器传递辅助，无需限定预定义轨迹，用能量罐保证被动性并提供扭矩跟踪的理论保证。

Result: 仿真与实物实验显示对长时程运动序列的精确跟踪及对实时人体运动的泛化能力；控制器在保持被动性的同时实现精确扭矩跟踪，并在能量罐补充后恢复跟踪。5名受试者的EMG研究表明，与重力补偿和开环辅助相比，静态和动态任务中靶肌活动均降低，在多关节动态任务中较无外骨骼状态减少高达48%。

Conclusion: ATP框架成功将解剖知识驱动的辅助从下肢扩展到复杂上肢运动，在保持系统被动性与安全性的同时实现跨任务泛化的精准辅助，并通过实验验证了减轻肌肉负担的有效性。

Abstract: Providing assistance across diverse movements is a central objective of exoskeletons, and anatomical knowledge can enable responsive support that generalizes across tasks. However, anatomical assistance has mainly been studied for lower-limb exoskeletons, where periodic, weight-bearing motions impose lower demands on torque precision. Extending such assistance to complex, nonperiodic upper-limb movements remains challenging. This paper proposes Anatomical Torque with Passivity-Based Control (ATP) for safe upper-limb exoskeleton assistance. First, a scalable musculoskeletal simulation framework trains a unified reinforcement-learning muscle controller that generalizes across upper-limb movements and generates anatomical reference torques without complex biomechanical computations. Second, an online torque-refinement scheme adapts the reference to diverse movements, suppresses tendon-induced spikes, and incorporates a learned anomaly score for safe and comfortable assistance. Third, an interaction torque controller delivers assistance through a cable-driven compliant exoskeleton without constraining motion to predefined trajectories, while an energy tank preserves passivity with theoretical guarantees on torque tracking and system passivity. Simulations and real-world experiments show accurate tracking of long-duration motion sequences and generalization to real-time human movements. The controller achieves accurate torque tracking while preserving passivity and resumes tracking after energy-tank replenishment. An EMG study with five participants further shows reduced target-muscle activity during static and dynamic tasks compared with gravity compensation and open-loop assistance, with reductions of up to 48% relative to movement without the exoskeleton in a dynamic multi-joint task.

</details>


### [224] [Near-sensor Computing for Rapid Visuotactile Perception](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.05725)
*Zhengying Zhu,Ruilin Zhang,Runze Hu,Chenxi Xiao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种近传感器计算框架，将光谱泊松求解器实现为全流式硬件流水线，用于视觉触觉传感器的接触几何重建。该系统功耗约347 mW，运行频率166 MHz，固定延迟0.211 ms，重建精度为峰值接触深度的0.17%，并将机器人保护反射回路缩短至28.3 ms，相比宿主机方案的169.9 ms大幅提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉触觉传感器通过测量表面梯度重建稠密接触几何，但依赖宿主机进行数据处理会导致功耗增加、数据传输延迟和可变调度延迟，限制了机器人系统的感知与响应速度。

Method: 采用近传感器计算框架，将光谱泊松求解器实现为全流式硬件流水线。该流水线无数据依赖分支和迭代收敛过程，提供确定性延迟，并支持基于重建结果的片上决策。

Result: 计算核心功耗约347 mW，166 MHz下首帧首个深度值在35,107周期（0.211 ms）内产生；15种接触几何的重建深度与双精度参考相差峰值深度的0.17%；机器人保护反射回路闭合时间28.3±4.9 ms，远优于宿主机方案的169.9±27.8 ms。

Conclusion: 近传感器重建能够在适合快速机器人接触响应的时标上提供准确、节能且确定性的触觉几何信息，验证了该方法的有效性与实用性。

Abstract: Visuotactile sensors reconstruct dense contact geometry from measured surface gradients, but host-based processing increases power consumption and introduces data-transfer delays and variable scheduling latency, limiting the sensing and response speed of robotic systems. To address these limitations, we implement a near-sensor computing framework that includes a spectral Poisson solver as a fully streaming hardware pipeline. The computational core logic has an estimated power consumption of 347 mW and achieves high throughput without data-dependent branching or iterative convergence, thereby providing deterministic latency. Operating at 166 MHz, the pipeline produces the first depth value of each 128x128 frame 35,107 cycles after receiving the first input pixel, corresponding to a fixed latency of 0.211 ms. Across 15 contact geometries, the reconstructed depths differ from a double-precision reference by 0.17 % of the peak contact depth. On-chip decisions based on these reconstructions close a robot protective reflex loop in 28.3 +/- 4.9 ms, compared with 169.9 +/- 27.8 ms for an equivalent host-based loop using the same actuator. These results demonstrate that near-sensor reconstruction can provide accurate, energy-efficient, and deterministic tactile geometry on timescales suitable for rapid robotic contact responses.

</details>


### [225] [In-Context VLA: Endowing Vision-Language-Action Models with Language via In-Context Post-Training and Agentic Tool Use](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.05738)
*Jiarui Yang,Wen Huang,Jiale Zhang,Maowei Hu,Hang Guo*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一个名为\ourmethod{}的框架，指出自由形式的文本思维链(CoT)会降低VLA模型的低级控制性能——原因是推理未接地、延迟破坏闭环时序、推理与动作token目标冲突。该框架通过上下文后训练（注入结构化感知证据并仅监督动作）和智能体工具接口（查询检测器、深度和VLM主动获取信息）赋予VLA语言理解而非语言生成能力，在多个仿真基准和8个真实机器人任务中取得SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的VLA模型几乎都基于行为克隆训练，缺乏显式推理。一个自然的补救方案是注入文本思维链(CoT)，但作者发现自由形式的文本CoT实际上会损害低级控制：生成的推理缺乏接地性，推理延迟破坏闭环控制的实时性，且推理token与动作token的优化目标相互冲突，导致策略学会"叙述"而非"行动"。因此，VLA真正需要的不是生成语言的能力，而是消费（理解）接地语言的能力。

Method: \ourmethod{}框架包含两个核心部分：(i) 上下文后训练——将感知证据作为结构化上下文注入，模型仅对动作进行监督；(ii) 智能体工具使用接口——策略主动查询开放词汇检测器、单目深度和视觉语言模型以获取任务相关信息。数据引擎不生成单一模板字幕，而是产生多样化、意译化且由证据条件化的空间描述，使策略学会解释从未逐字见过的语言。

Result: 在RoboCasa-GR1、SimplerEnv和LIBERO仿真基准以及8个真实世界机器人操作任务上，与基于CoT的方法在匹配配置下比较，该方法在性能和效率上均一致取得SOTA结果。

Conclusion: 作者从理论和实证两个层面证明了文本CoT对VLA低级控制的负面影响，并提出VLA应具备"消费语言"而非"生成语言"的能力。通过上下文后训练和工具接口，策略能够主动获取任务相关信息并理解多样化的接地语言描述，在仿真和真实任务中都超越了CoT方法。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have become the dominant recipe for generalist manipulation, yet they are almost universally trained by behavior cloning: a policy imitates expert action chunks conditioned on a static image and a fixed instruction. A natural remedy is to inject explicit reasoning through textual chain-of-thought (CoT). We show, both empirically and analytically, that free-form textual CoT degrades low-level control: the reasoning it produces is ungrounded, its latency breaks closed-loop timing, and, crucially, the reasoning and action tokens are optimized against conflicting objectives so that the policy learns to narrate rather than to act. We argue that what a VLA needs is not the ability to generate language, but the ability to consume grounded language. To this end we introduce \textbf{\ourmethod{}}, a framework that endows a VLA with language competence through (i) in-context post-training, in which perceptual evidence is injected as structured context and the model is supervised only on actions, and (ii) an agentic tool-use interface, in which the policy queries open-vocabulary detectors, monocular depth, and a vision--language model to actively acquire task-relevant information. Rather than emitting a single templated caption, our data engine produces diverse, paraphrased, and evidence-conditioned spatial descriptions, so that the policy learns to interpret language it has never seen verbatim. Across the RoboCasa-GR1, SimplerEnv, and LIBERO simulation benchmarks, together with 8 real-world robot manipulation tasks, our method consistently achieves SOTA results in both performance and efficiency when compared with CoT-based approaches under matched configurations.

</details>


### [226] [Acoustic-driven millimetric helical robot: ultrasonic synergistic manipulation in confined fluidic environment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.05746)
*Hanlin Wang,Xin Wang,Xinwei Wei,Jiaxu Liu,Le Wang,Shengze Cai,Chao Xu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种协调多声场方法，利用声辐射力与声学流场的协同作用，实现了毫米级螺旋机器人的可控运动，突破了声学操控技术从微纳米尺度向毫米尺度的扩展瓶颈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 声场驱动操控为微纳米物体的非接触、非侵入式控制提供了策略，但因其在受限生物环境中推进效率不足，难以扩展到毫米级机器人。本研究旨在解决这一尺度跨越难题。

Method: 通过多物理场仿真捕捉毫米级螺旋机器人在组合声场下的动力学行为，并进行实验验证其运动能力，包括平面导航、斜面攀爬和垂直运动；进一步开展半自主导航实验及猪静脉血管内的体外实验。

Result: 实验证实协调声场实现了毫米级螺旋机器人的可控运动，包括平面导航、倾斜攀爬及垂直运动；半自主导航显示超声协同显著提升了机动性；猪静脉血管内体外试验验证了在生物受限环境下单向和往复运动的可行性。

Conclusion: 研究为声学微操控向毫米尺度扩展提供了机理洞见，并支持需要灵活可控机器人移动性的生物医学应用。

Abstract: Acoustic field-driven manipulation provides a non-contact and non-invasive strategy for controlling microscale and nanoscale objects, yet its extension to millimeter-scale robots was limited by insufficient propulsion efficiency in confined biological environments. Here, a coordinated multi-acoustic-field approach is introduced, which harnesses the synergistic action of acoustic radiation forces and acoustic streaming flows to enable controlled locomotion of millimeter-scale helical robots and enhance propulsion. Multiphysics simulations captured the dynamics of millimeter-scale helical robots under combined acoustic fields, and experimental validation demonstrated their locomotion capabilities, including planar navigation, inclined climbing, and vertical motion. Semi-autonomous navigation experiments further confirmed that ultrasonic synergy substantially improved maneuverability. In vitro tests in porcine venous vessels demonstrated that coordinated acoustic fields supported both unidirectional and reciprocating motion under biologically relevant confinement. These findings provide mechanistic insight into scaling acoustic micromanipulation to the millimetre regime and support biomedical applications requiring versatile and controllable robotic mobility.

</details>


### [227] [XEWorld: Can Action-Conditioned World Models Generalize to Unseen Robot Embodiments?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.05799)
*Yixiang Chen,Jiabing Yang,Yuan Xu,Qisen Ma,Keji He,Peiyan Li,Kai Wang,Ziheng He,Xiangnan Wu,Jing Liu,Nianfeng Liu,Yan Huang,Liang Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出XEWorld测试基准，系统性地揭示当前动作条件世界模型在跨实体（cross-embodiment）泛化中的根本缺陷：模型本质上是2D视觉模式匹配器，其泛化受视觉相似性而非物理运动学相似性驱动，无法将学习到的物理动力学迁移到未见过的机器人外观上。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有世界模型仅在训练机器人上评估，无法判断模型真正学习了物理动力学还是仅仅记忆了视觉模式。为了回答"模型能否忠实渲染从未见过的机器人"这一问题，需要一种能够隔离实体、在物理相同场景中评估未见实体的受控测试基准。

Method: 提出了XEWorld——一个受控的跨实体世界模型测试基准，通过评估物理相同场景中的保留（held-out）实体来隔离实体因素。在系统分析中，该方法考察了当前模型在数字关节动作到视觉轨迹的转换能力、从静态初始观测预测动态视觉变化的能力，以及通过零样本和少样本适应两种路径的泛化表现。

Result: 发现当前模型普遍存在架构性瓶颈：其泛化由视觉相似性而非物理运动学相似性驱动；难以将抽象数值关节动作转化为连贯的视觉轨迹；无法从静态初始观测预测动态视觉变化。零样本渲染未见实体严格依赖像素空间动作和显式时空对齐等高度接地线索；少样本适应虽能绕过零样本障碍，但强制的外观恢复会引发对已见实体的灾难性遗忘。

Conclusion: 这些失败揭示了模型将学到的物理动力学应用于新颖视觉外观时的根本性无能，说明实现真正的跨实体泛化需要架构层面的创新，将视觉外观与底层物理动力学解耦。

Abstract: Action-conditioned world models are promising learned simulators for robotic manipulation, yet evaluating them exclusively on training robots fails to reveal whether they capture physical dynamics or merely memorize visual patterns. To answer whether a model can faithfully render a robot it has never seen, we introduce XEWorld, a controlled cross-embodiment testbed for world models that isolates embodiments by evaluating held-out robots within physically identical scenes. Our systematic analysis uncovers a shared architectural bottleneck: current models act primarily as 2D visual pattern matchers whose generalization is governed by visual similarity rather than physical kinematic similarity. Driven by this limitation, they struggle to translate abstract numeric joint actions into coherent visual trajectories, and fail to predict dynamic visual changes from static initial observations. Consequently, successfully rendering an unseen embodiment zero-shot strictly requires heavily grounded cues, specifically pixel-space actions and explicit spatial-temporal alignment. Even when bypassing this zero-shot barrier via few-shot adaptation, the forced appearance recovery triggers catastrophic forgetting of seen embodiments. Together, these failures expose a critical inability to apply learned physical dynamics to novel visual appearances, highlighting that achieving true cross-embodiment generalization requires architectural innovations that decouple visual appearance from underlying physical dynamics.

</details>


### [228] [Coordinated Multi-Robot Disassembly for Makespan Optimization of Large-Scale Assemblies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.05830)
*Niklas Hargus,Andreas Orthey,Marc Toussaint*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出CoMuDi方法，用于多机器人拆卸任务中的任务与运动规划，通过创建复合任务、传播时间约束并集成ST-RRT*规划器，在狭小工作空间中协调多机器人运动，最小化总完工时间并提高成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多机器人拆卸任务需要在受限工作空间中运行，同时协调各机器人的运动。现有的规划方法难以同时处理任务规划和运动规划之间的耦合，尤其是在狭小空间中多机器人共存时，容易出现碰撞且完工时间不理想。

Method: CoMuDi方法包含以下关键要素：(1)输入为机器人团队、物体装配体和依赖图，基于这些信息创建拾取、放置和退出运动等复合任务；(2)通过传播时间约束，确保每个机器人能尽早开始和结束任务同时避免与邻近机器人碰撞；(3)集成空间-时间RRT*（ST-RRT*）规划器，使单个任务最小化到达时间，从而有助于最小化整体完工时间。

Result: 实验对比了CoMuDi分别使用ST-RRT*和RRT*规划器在不同时间限制下的性能，结果表明CoMuDi与ST-RRT*的组合获得更高的成功率并最小化完工时间。在最多49个零件和9个机器人的六个装配体上评估，CoMuDi返回的机器人路径具有较低的空闲时间，能够可靠解决大规模装配体拆卸问题。

Conclusion: CoMuDi能够在大规模装配体的多机器人拆卸任务中可靠地生成低空闲时间的机器人路径，通过结合ST-RRT*在成功率和完工时间上均表现优异，是多机器人拆卸任务与运动规划的有效解决方案。

Abstract: Multi-robot task and motion planning for disassembly tasks requires robots to operate in confined workspaces while coordinating their motions with other robots. To tackle this problem, we propose a planning method called coordinated multi-robot disassembly (CoMuDi). CoMuDi coordinates a team of robots for disassembly tasks. The input is a team of robots, an assembly of objects, and a dependency graph. Based on this information, we create compound tasks for pick, place, and exit motions. By propagating temporal constraints, we ensure that each robot can start and end their tasks as early as possible while avoiding collisions with nearby robots. By integrating the space-time RRT* planner (ST-RRT*) into CoMuDi, we ensure that individual tasks minimize arrival time and thereby help us minimize overall makespan. We compare the performance of CoMuDi using both ST-RRT* and RRT* planners with varying time bounds, demonstrating that the combination of CoMuDi and ST-RRT* leads to a higher success rate while minimizing makespan. Finally, we evaluate CoMuDi on six assemblies with up to 49 pieces and up to 9 robots. In those scenarios, we show that CoMuDi returns robot paths that exhibit low idle times, thereby demonstrating that CoMuDi can reliably solve large-scale assemblies.

</details>


### [229] [SkillMemo: Expert-guided Skill Memory Framework for Compositional Embodied Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.05970)
*Changyuan Wang,Chubin Zhang,Zhenyu Wu,Runhao Li,Angyuan Ma,Ke Chao,Yinan Liang,Xiuwei Xu,Ziwei Wang,Yansong Tang,Jiwen Lu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出SkillMemo框架，通过隐式分解长程演示为潜在原子技能并集成到动态情节记忆库中，增强具身视觉运动模型（DP和VLA）的组合泛化能力，在仿真和真实世界任务中达到SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的具身视觉运动模型（如Diffusion Policy和VLA模型）在机器人操作基准上表现良好，但其性能受限于大规模具身轨迹数据集的稀缺，导致在分布外（OOD）场景下组合泛化能力不足，难以捕获可复用的技能结构。

Method: SkillMemo框架包含两个核心组件：(1) 基于Mixture-of-Experts (MoE)架构的专家引导轨迹分割模块，通过学习门控系数隐式地将长程轨迹划分为不同的原子技能原语；(2) 技能级情节记忆架构，以可检索的键值对形式存储紧凑的技能表示。推理时，记忆库检索最相关的技能原语并与当前门控分布融合，提供鲁棒的上下文先验以优化动作预测。

Result: 在仿真基准和真实世界操作任务上的大量实验表明，SkillMemo能够一致性地增强DP和VLA骨干模型的性能，达到最先进的水平，并超越π_0.5，展现出对未见任务配置的强组合泛化能力。

Conclusion: SkillMemo通过隐式技能分解和动态情节记忆的结合，有效地解决了具身数据稀缺导致的组合泛化瓶颈，为增强各类视觉运动模型提供了统一的、即插即用的框架。

Abstract: Embodied visuomotor models, including Diffusion Policy (DP) and Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, have demonstrated promising performance on robotic manipulation benchmarks. However, their potential remains fundamentally constrained by the scarcity of large-scale embodied trajectory datasets, leading to insufficient compositional generalization in out-of-distribution (OOD) scenarios with limited capability to capture reusable skill structures. To address this limitation, we propose Skill-Based Memory (SkillMemo) framework that implicitly decomposes long-horizon demonstrations into latent atomic skills and integrates skill-level features into a dynamic episodic memory bank for solving compositional tasks. Specifically, we first introduce an expert-guided trajectory segmentation module built upon a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture, which implicitly partitions trajectories into distinct skill primitives represented by learned gating coefficients. We further design a skill-level episodic memory architecture that stores compact skill representations as retrievable key-value pairs. During inference, the memory bank retrieves the most relevant skill primitives which are subsequently fused with the model's current gating distribution, providing a robust contextual prior to refine action predictions.
