Result: Letta取得最高进化分数（91.65）和最少的合规问题（每任务0.09）；Codex取得最大自我进化增益（+19.37）。所有框架中，进化条件提升分数9.33-19.37分，每任务合规问题减少0.12-0.44。场景内排名4-6的配对得分增益比排名1-3高6.10-8.70分。技能单独进化优于记忆单独进化和记忆-技能联合进化；评分标准反馈优于参考答案反馈。

Conclusion: FinEvo-Bench能够有效衡量专业性能和自我进化能力，即智能体如何将先前经验转化为后续改进。

Abstract: Most agent benchmarks evaluate tasks independently and cannot measure whether experience from one task helps with later tasks. Existing self-evolution benchmarks do not jointly cover professional workflows, open-ended deliverables, and multi-aspect evaluation. We introduce FinEvo-Bench, a longitudinal benchmark with 120 real-case-grounded tasks, 20 business scenes across six financial domains. Institution-provided professional procedures define the required operations and constraints. Eligible institution-provided and publicly documented cases supply the task facts. Each scene contains six related but substantively distinct cases that share a professional procedure and a manually reviewed rubric for task quality and financial compliance. We compare four self-evolving agent scaffolds using the same Qwen3.7-Max backbone and three independently shuffled, globally interleaved task streams. Paired non-evolving controls estimate each scaffold's self-evolution gain from retained experience, while an independent Claude Code scoring agent backed by Claude Opus 4.6 evaluates all outputs. Letta achieves the highest evolved score (91.65) and fewest compliance issues (0.09 per task); Codex achieves the largest self-evolution gain (+19.37). Across scaffolds, the evolving condition raises scores by 9.33-19.37 points and reduces compliance issues by 0.12-0.44 per task. Paired score gains at within-scene ranks 4-6 exceed those at ranks 1-3 by 6.10-8.70 points. In Claude Code, skill-only evolution produces higher task quality and fewer compliance issues than memory-only and combined memory-skill evolution. Across all four scaffolds, rubric feedback also yields higher scores and fewer compliance issues than reference-answer feedback. FinEvo-Bench measures both professional performance and self-evolution ability: how effectively an agent turns prior experience into later improvement.

</details>


### [328] [PaDoc: Layout-Grounded Parallel Decoding for Document Parsing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.06146)
*Hao Yu,Jiabo Zhan,Kang Liu,Linnan Zhao,Dongxu Yue,Rui Chen,Jinglin Wang,Chong Sun,Chen Li,Jing Lyu,Chun Yuan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: PaDoc提出了一种布局锚定的端到端文档解析器，将预测的布局视为共享页面表示上的分支结构，通过前缀条件因子分解使布局流和区域内容分支并发推进，从而将解码深度缩减为最长布局-内容路径，在OmniDocBench Full上实现91.1的布局F1和94.24的总体分数，并在吞吐量和延迟上显著优于基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的端到端文档解析器将页面布局和区域内容序列化为单一自回归序列，导致独立区域强制进入随总内容增长而变长的解码路径；而基于裁剪的两阶段解析器虽能实现区域级并行，但需要重复的视觉预填充和碎片化的页面上下文。核心矛盾在于如何在保留完整页面上下文的同时消除解码依赖。

Method: PaDoc将预测的布局作为共享页面表示上的分支结构。在区域充分性假设下，推导出前缀条件因子分解，使布局流和区域内容分支并发推进，解码深度降至最长布局-内容路径。实现在单一多模态大语言模型（MLLM）中：通过打包的可变长度祖先注意力在标准next-token训练下保持可见性；通过掩码并行解码创建分支，由vLLM后端作为并发请求提供缓存驻留的共享前缀复用。

Result: 在OmniDocBench Full上，PaDoc达到91.1的总体布局F1；在端到端解析器中取得顶级总体得分94.24，同时取得最佳文本编辑距离（0.038）和公式CDM（95.59）。在384页子集和单张A800 GPU上，在五个并发级别下是最快的端到端解析器，有效页面吞吐量提升67.4-118%，P95延迟相对同骨干的Sequential SFT基线降低39.2-54.9%。

Conclusion: PaDoc成功证明了在端到端文档解析中，通过将布局视为分支结构并利用前缀条件因子分解，可以在保留完整页面上下文的同时实现区域级并行，显著提升吞吐量并降低延迟，同时保持甚至超越现有方法的解析质量。

Abstract: End-to-end document parsers provide a unified interface, but serialize page layouts and regional contents into one autoregressive sequence. This formulation forces independent regions onto a decoding path whose length grows with the total content, whereas crop-based two-stage parsers expose region-level parallelism at the cost of repeated visual prefills and fragmented page context. To retain full-page context while removing dependencies, we propose PaDoc, a layout-grounded parser that treats the predicted layout as a branching structure over a shared page representation. Under a region-sufficiency assumption, we derive a prefix-conditioned factorization in which the layout stream and regional content branches advance concurrently, reducing the decoding depth to the longest layout-content path. We realize this factorization within a single MLLM: packed variable-length ancestor attention preserves the visibility under standard next-token training, while masked parallel decoding creates branches that the evaluated vLLM backend serves as concurrent requests with cache-resident shared-prefix reuse. On OmniDocBench Full, PaDoc attains an Overall layout F1 of 91.1 and, among end-to-end parsers, a top-tier Overall score of 94.24 together with the best Text Edit (0.038) and Formula CDM (95.59). On a 384-page subset and one A800 GPU, it is the fastest end-to-end parser at five concurrency levels, improving valid-page throughput by 67.4-118% and reducing P95 latency by 39.2-54.9% relative to a same-backbone Sequential SFT baseline. Code is available at https://github.com/Longin-Yu/Padoc

</details>


### [329] [Schema-Guided Hierarchical Information Extraction and Semantic Evaluation Using Generative AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.06167)
*Modhurita Mitra,Jan-Willem Versteeg,Maarten D. Schermer,Shiva Nadi Najafabadi,Marie L. De Bruin,Lourens T. Bloem*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于模式的框架，利用生成式AI从非结构化文本中提取复杂结构信息，并通过路径语义匹配算法对提取结果与金标准进行自动化评估。在NICE健康技术评估文档上，12/14个属性的F1分数超过90%，提取速度比人类专家快约30倍，并展示了跨模型、跨组织和跨语言的泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从非结构化文本中提取复杂、嵌套的结构化信息（如层级关系、可变基数的属性）是传统信息提取方法的难点，且缺乏对生成式AI提取结果进行自动化语义评估的标准化方案。

Method: 提出一个基于模式（schema）的提取与评估框架：1）利用编码领域知识的信息模型（schema）在零样本单次调用中完成层级嵌套信息的提取；2）引入路径式语义匹配算法对齐嵌套的可变基数属性；3）使用生成式AI对属性值进行语义比较，并依据领域特定规则将匹配结果分类为精确匹配、语义匹配、有用匹配或非匹配。

Result: 在NICE发布的健康技术评估（HTA）文档上，使用Claude Opus 3模型在14个属性中成功提取12个且F1分数超过90%；单文档提取时间比人类领域专家快约30倍；该框架在不同生成式AI模型、不同HTA组织和不同语言间均表现出良好的泛化性与可迁移性。

Conclusion: 该基于模式的生成式AI框架为复杂结构化信息提取和自动化语义评估提供了统一、系统且可扩展的解决方案，在效率上显著优于人工方式，并具备跨模型、跨领域和跨语言的广泛适用性。

Abstract: We present a schema-based framework for extracting complex, structured information from unstructured text documents using generative AI, followed by automated semantic evaluation of the extracted information against a gold standard. The schema, serving as an information model encoding domain knowledge, provides a unified, systematic, and consistent framework for extraction of hierarchical, nested information, with attributes of variable cardinality, and subsequent evaluation of the results. Information extraction from a document is performed in a single call to the model, in zero-shot mode.
  In the evaluation step, we introduce a path-based semantic matching algorithm to align the nested, variable-cardinality attributes in the extracted results with those in the gold standard. We use generative AI for semantic comparison of the extracted and gold standard values of an attribute, and introduce a rubric to classify the result of the comparison, according to domain-specific considerations, as an exact, semantic, useful, or non-match.
  We were able to extract 12 out of 14 attributes with an F1 score of $>$90\% from documents published by the health technology assessment organisation NICE, using the generative AI model Claude Opus 3. The time needed to extract the attributes from a document was $\sim$30 times lower than the time taken by a human domain expert. We further demonstrate generalisability of this framework across different generative AI models and transferability across different HTA organisations and languages.

</details>


### [330] [CogVis: Must Open-Vocabulary Change Detection Perceive the Scene Anew for Every Query?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.06150)
*Zijie Wang,Chen Zhong,Wei He*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: CogVis是一个认知记忆引导的开放词汇变化检测框架，将OVCD重构为感知-记忆-验证范式，通过场景变化感知器、语义记忆校准器和自适应区域过滤器三个模块解耦时间感知、语义判别和区域验证，在七个基准数据集上达到SOTA性能并将推理吞吐量提升28.50%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有开放词汇变化检测方法将时间感知、语义判别和区域验证纠缠在一起，导致结果不稳定和冗余计算。受人类视觉变化感知机制的启发，作者希望将时间证据与语义类别决策解耦，提高检测稳定性和推理效率。

Method: CogVis包含三个核心模块：(1) 场景变化感知器(SCP)从冻结的双时相特征中提取可复用的、类别无关的变化先验，解耦时间证据与语义类别决策；(2) 语义记忆校准器(SMC)通过动态估计图像-查询特定的决策阈值，补偿类别相关的分数偏移；(3) 自适应区域过滤器(ARF)利用学习到的语义、时间和结构可靠性过滤连通候选区域。

Result: 在涵盖语义变化检测、二元变化定位和建筑物损毁评估的七个基准数据集上，CogVis在所有数据集上均达到最先进(SOTA)性能。通过共享场景级变化感知，避免了跨查询重复的类别无关时间感知计算，推理吞吐量提升28.50%。

Conclusion: CogVis通过将OVCD重构为感知-记忆-验证范式，实现了稳定且高效的开放词汇变化检测，验证了认知记忆引导方法在地表监测中的有效性，并为后续研究提供了统一框架。

Abstract: Earth-surface monitoring requires change detection models capable of recognizing arbitrary semantic categories. Open-Vocabulary Change Detection (OVCD) addresses this need. However, existing methods often entangle temporal perception, semantic discrimination, and region verification, causing unstable results and redundant computation. Inspired by human visual change perception, we propose CogVis, a cognitive memory-guided framework that reformulates OVCD as a perception-memory-verification paradigm. CogVis first employs a Scene Change Perceptron (SCP) to extract a reusable, category-agnostic change prior from frozen bi-temporal features, thereby decoupling temporal evidence from semantic category decisions. A Semantic Memory Calibrator (SMC) then compensates for category-dependent score shifts by dynamically estimating an image-query-specific decision threshold. Finally, an Adaptive Region Filter (ARF) filters connected candidates using learned semantic, temporal, and structural reliability. Experiments on seven benchmarks spanning semantic change detection, binary change localization, and building-damage assessment show that CogVis achieves state-of-the-art performance across all evaluated datasets. By sharing scene-level change perception, CogVis further avoids repeating category-agnostic temporal perception across queries and improves inference throughput by 28.50%.

</details>


### [331] [HarnessOpt-Bench: Evaluating LLMs at Harness Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.06301)
*Varun Ursekar,Apaar Shanker,Yash Maurya,Shehab Yasser,Vijay S. Kalmath,Veronica Chatrath,Yuan Xue*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出HarnessOpt-Bench，一个用于评测前沿大语言模型在自动化harness优化任务中表现的基准。该基准在昂贵且随机的评估条件下，衡量优化器（LLM+编码harness）对目标agent的harness进行迭代改进的能力，并通过受信任执行环境确保评估边界与审计可追溯性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着LLM在agentic系统中的部署日益广泛，其能力不仅取决于模型权重，还取决于周围的harness（提示词、工具、控制流、记忆和编排代码）。自动化harness优化因此变得重要，但社区缺乏统一的协议来衡量前沿LLM在此任务上的表现。

Method: 设计了HarnessOpt-Bench基准：优化器（LLM与编码harness配对）接收目标agent的种子harness、分级评估反馈和固定预算，通过编辑harness并提交最终候选来优化性能。使用受信任执行环境强制执行评估边界、计量资源使用并保留版本审计。评估了5个前沿LLM作为优化器，在共享编码harness和各自原生harness下执行4个下游任务，共111次评分运行。

Result: 实验结果表明：优化器模型之间的能力差异大于编码harness之间的差异；原生harness并未一致性地优于共享harness；收益在不同任务和种子设置下差异显著。这些结果表明harness优化是一个可测量且具有区分度的能力，且仍有大幅改进空间。

Conclusion: Harness优化是一个可以被量化评估的、具有判别力的AI能力维度，当前前沿LLM在此任务上表现仍有很大提升空间，这为未来AI系统自主改进自身基础设施开辟了重要的研究方向。

Abstract: As LLMs are increasingly deployed within agentic systems, their capabilities depend not only on the model weights but also on the harness: the prompts, tools, control flow, memory, and orchestration code surrounding them. This makes automated harness optimization -- the iterative and evaluation-guided improvement of a harness by an AI system -- both an important route to improving AI systems and a demanding capability for AI systems themselves. Yet the community lacks a common protocol for measuring how well frontier LLMs perform at this task. We introduce HarnessOpt-Bench, a benchmark for end-to-end harness optimization under expensive and stochastic evaluation. An optimizer, an LLM paired with a coding harness, receives a target agent's seed harness, graded evaluation feedback, and a fixed target-evaluation budget. It edits the harness and nominates a final candidate, which is scored by its normalized gain over the seed on a held-out test partition that remains inaccessible throughout search. A trusted execution environment enforces the evaluation boundary, meters target-agent resource use, and preserves candidate versions for audit. We evaluate 5 frontier LLMs as optimizers both under a shared coding harness and under their native harnesses across 4 downstream tasks, over 111 scored runs. Experiment results show that optimizer models separate more than the coding harnesses they act through, native harnesses are not consistently superior, and gains vary substantially across tasks and seed regimes. These results establish harness optimization as a measurable and discriminative capability with large space for improvement.

</details>


### [332] [iARCS: Iterative Agentic RL for Controllable 3D Scene Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.06161)
*Saugat Adhikari,Ashok Prasad Neupane,Pramish Paudel,Ajad Chhatkuli,Danda Pani Paudel*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: iARCS是一个迭代式代理强化学习框架，将预训练的场景生成器适配到自然语言任务需求上，通过通用奖励预训练和基于LLM生成奖励程序的任务特定微调两阶段策略，提升合成3D场景在可行走性、可达性和间距等任务关键约束上的保真度，并作为实用的合成数据生成工具增强基础生成器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的合成3D场景生成器往往只优化感知真实感，而无法可靠满足任务关键的功能性约束（如可及性、可穿越性、空间规则合规性），这限制了合成数据在下游训练中的实用价值。

Method: iARCS采用两阶段策略：(1) 通用奖励预训练，提升场景的物理合理性与布局质量；(2) 任务特定微调，使用LLM生成的奖励程序，并从训练反馈中迭代精炼这些奖励程序。

Result: 实验表明iARCS在可行走性、可达性和间距等重要任务上提升了约束保真度，实现了有效的任务特定约束优化，同时保持了具有竞争力的场景多样性；此外，iARCS生成的数据还能改善基础生成器的性能。

Conclusion: iARCS不仅是一种可控的场景编辑方法，更是一个实用的合成数据生成工具，能够使合成3D场景满足任务关键约束，从而更好地服务于计算机视觉和具身AI的下游训练。

Abstract: Synthetic 3D scene generation is increasingly used as a data source for computer vision and embodied AI, but existing generators often optimize perceptual realism without reliably satisfying task-critical functional constraints. This mismatch limits the usefulness of synthetic data for downstream training, where accessibility, traversability, and spatial rule compliance are often essential. We present iARCS, an iterative agentic reinforcement learning framework that adapts a pretrained scene generator to natural-language task requirements. iARCS uses a two-stage strategy: universal-reward pretraining to improve physical plausibility and layout quality, followed by task-specific fine-tuning with LLM-generated reward programs that are iteratively refined from training feedback. Experiments show improved constraint fidelity on walkability, reachability, and clearance-focused tasks, effective task-specific constraint optimization, and competitive scene diversity. We further show that data generated by iARCS improves a base generator, supporting its value as a practical synthetic data generation tool rather than only a controllable scene editing method.

</details>


### [333] [Beyond Top-K: Replacing Black-Box Retrieval with Interpretable Agentic Operations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.06305)
*Sagar Tamang,Ayush Vyas,Tabarakul Hazarika*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文论证了传统"切块-嵌入-取top-k最近邻"的检索增强生成设计在处理财务报表、审计报告等表格密集型长文档时存在结构性缺陷：数值与单位标签（如lakh/crore）常被切块边界分离，导致数量级错误。作者提出READ（Reliable Embedding-free Agentic Document-search）系统，通过MCP协议暴露规范化词法搜索、结构导航和有界span读取三种确定性操作，让智能体以可回放的审计轨迹方式读取原始文档。在51个验证问题上，READ达到58.8%准确率，远超稠密检索的15.7%和基于top-k工具的智能体能达到的27.5%，差距来自接口设计而非迭代本身。但实验也显示BM25与READ在统计上无显著差异，说明增益来自"免嵌入"而非"智能体"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的稠密检索RAG设计（chunk-embed-top-k）在处理表格密集型长文档（如财务报表、审计报告、监管申报）时结构性不健全：8600+行内容中包含大量表行，近似的数值在同一嵌入空间竞争，且数值的单位信息常继承自上方数十行的表头，切块边界会隔离数值与其单位（如lakh与crore相差两个数量级）。作者希望用可测量的证据证明这一缺陷，并提出改进方案。

Method: 首先用780页政府财务报告量化传统设计的缺陷：86.8%内容行为表行、单位继承跨度中位数为13行、表感知切块仍无法解决27-30%数值块缺失财年表头的问题。然后提出READ系统：智能体通过三种确定性操作（规范化词法搜索、结构导航、有界span读取）读取原始文档，这些操作通过Model Context Protocol（MCP）暴露，使每次查询轨迹成为可回放的审计轨迹而非不可解释的相似度分数。通过与稠密检索、基于top-k工具的同循环智能体、BM25进行对照实验来验证。

Result: 在51个验证问题上：READ达到58.8%准确率，稠密检索仅15.7%（p_Holm=2×10^-5）；READ调优后为35.3%（经Holm校正对比），仍领先密集检索23.5个百分点（p_Holm=0.017）；使用相同循环但top-k工具的智能体仅达27.5%，证明增益来自接口设计而非迭代过程；BM25与READ在统计上不可区分，说明结果分离的是"嵌入vs免嵌入"而非"智能体vs词法搜索"。

Conclusion: 对于表格密集型长文档，免嵌入的确定性文档搜索接口优于稠密检索，且优于将top-k检索嵌入同一智能体循环的方案。证据不支持"智能体迭代本身带来增益"的解释，而支持"设计良好的确定性接口是关键"的结论。此外，BM25的表现说明这一结论本质上是关于嵌入表示在此类文档上的失效，而非智能体架构的优势。

Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation over long documents is dominated by one design: chunk the text, embed the chunks, and surface the top-k nearest neighbours of the query. We argue that for an important class of documents -- financial statements, audit reports, regulatory returns -- this design is structurally unsound, and we make the argument measurable. On a 780-page government financial report, 86.8% of content lines are table rows, thousands of near-identical figures compete in one embedding space, and a figure inherits its unit from a header a median of 13 lines above it -- so a chunk boundary routinely separates a number from whether it is in lakh or crore, an error of two orders of magnitude. A table-aware chunker built as a steelman fixes the unit problem but leaves 27-30% of numeric chunks with no fiscal-year header at every chunk size we tried. We propose READ (Reliable Embedding-free Agentic Document-search), in which an agent reads the raw document through three deterministic operations -- normalized lexical search, structural navigation, and bounded span reads -- exposed over the Model Context Protocol, so a trajectory is a replayable audit trail, not an opaque similarity score. On 51 verified questions READ answers 58.8% against dense retrieval's 15.7% (p_Holm = 2 x 10^-5) -- or 35.3% tuned, which READ still leads by 23.5 points (p_Holm = 0.017). An agent given the same loop but a top-k tool reaches only 27.5%, locating the gain in the interface rather than in iteration. We also report what the evidence does not support: BM25 is statistically indistinguishable from READ, so our result separates embedding-based from embedding-free retrieval, not agentic from lexical search.

</details>


### [334] [MicroEvo: Knowledge-Guided LLM Sampling for Efficient Microarchitecture Design Space Exploration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.06183)
*Jia Xiong,Runkai Li,Chenxu Niu,Guangyuan Gao,Changwen Xing,Yifan Zhang,Xinlai Wan,Jieran Cui,Chen Bai,Yusheng Hua,Ying Wang,Ming Ling,Xi Wang,Tao Xie*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出MicroEvo框架，将LLM与蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）结合，用于多目标微架构设计空间探索，通过知识驱动的进化算子、Pareto感知的树策略、主动知识积累机制和状态感知指令，在有限仿真预算下实现高效的Pareto前沿优化，相比NSGA-II提升前沿质量最高36.2%，搜索效率提升10.6倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 微架构设计空间探索面临搜索空间庞大和PPA评估昂贵的双重挑战，仿真预算极为有限。现有方法在搜索时是盲目的，没有考虑微架构间的依赖关系，也无法从迭代搜索中有效学习，导致评估资源浪费、Pareto收敛性差。

Method: MicroEvo由四个核心组件构成：1）LLM驱动的进化算子，利用大语言模型的先验知识生成和变异架构配置；2）Pareto感知的树策略，在搜索中平衡Pareto贡献与解的多样性；3）主动知识积累机制，从迭代搜索中提取并复用优化洞见；4）状态感知指令，在搜索过程中在线自适应调整搜索行为。

Result: 实验表明MicroEvo在Pareto前沿质量上相比NSGA-II最高提升36.2%，搜索效率提升10.6倍，并在复杂的工业级核心上展现出强大的可扩展性。

Conclusion: 将LLM的先验知识与MCTS的系统性搜索相结合，能够有效解决微架构设计空间探索中评估昂贵与搜索空间庞大的矛盾，显著优于传统进化算法，并具备工业级规模的可扩展性与实际部署价值。

Abstract: Microarchitecture design space exploration suffers from expansive search spaces and expensive PPA evaluation, leaving only a small simulation budget for design decision-making. Existing methods perform blind search without considering microarchitectural dependencies and fail to learn from the iterative search effectively, leading to wasted evaluations and weak Pareto convergence. In this paper, we propose MicroEvo, a knowledge-guided framework that couples off-the-shelf LLMs with Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) for multi-objective microarchitecture optimization. MicroEvo combines LLM-driven evolutionary operators, a Pareto-aware tree policy that balances Pareto contribution and diversity, an active knowledge accumulation mechanism that extracts and reuses optimization insights, and state-aware directives that adapt the search behavior online. Experiments show that MicroEvo improves Pareto-front quality by up to 36.2% over NSGA-II and achieves 10.6x higher search efficiency, and also demonstrates strong scalability to a complex industrial-scale core. The code repository is available at: https://github.com/GEAR-SEU/MicroEvo-ICCAD-26.

</details>


### [335] [Comparative Approaches to Agent Retrieval over Large Skill Libraries](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.06196)
*Indivara Kolluru,Nathan Sportsman*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文研究大型技能库中技能加载与排序问题，通过对比混合排序器（词法和稠密嵌入检索）与类型化知识图谱（编码工作流关系）在690个技能库和117个真实查询上的表现，发现混合排序器hit@5达73.5%，而知识图谱不仅未提升性能（-11.2分），其LLM生成的边层也无增益，98.6%的图边与排序器已覆盖的嵌入邻域重叠，无法扩展检索范围。此外，作者还发现基于作者撰写查询评估会高估hit@5多达44个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型技能库驱动的智能体需要决定加载哪些技能及顺序，但将完整技能库加载到上下文成本高昂且缺乏自主排序的结构。作者旨在研究两类系统（混合排序器与知识图谱）在这类问题上的优劣，并解释为何额外结构化信息未能改善检索性能。

Method: 研究基于690个技能的语料库，构建两种系统进行对比：(1) 混合排序器，结合词法检索与稠密嵌入检索进行稀疏按需加载；(2) 类型化知识图谱，编码前提条件、数据流和排序等工作流关系。使用117个真实非回显查询评估，同时在匹配token预算下用图谱邻居替换排序结果，并对作者编写查询与真实查询的评估差异进行分析。

Result: 混合排序器在top-5内找回正确技能的比例为73.5%±8.0，约四分之一查询未获服务。知识图谱在按设计意图使用时显著更差（-11.2点，p=0.0007），其LLM生成的边层相对免费嵌入邻域无新增价值，且73%的排序器错失查询在图谱中完全不可达。98.6%的类型化边连接的是排序器已同时浮现的技能。基于作者编写查询的评估会高估hit@5达44个百分点，这足以掩盖上述失败结果。

Conclusion: 知识图谱虽能丰富关系语义，但因候选边源于排序器已搜索的相同嵌入邻域（预过滤拓扑约束），无法扩展检索覆盖范围。文章贡献在于对"额外结构无法改善强排序器检索"的机制性解释，并识别了在何种条件下将结构化相互依赖引入检索是最优的。

Abstract: Agents backed by large skill libraries must decide which skills to load and in what order. Loading the entire library into context is expensive and provides no structure for autonomous sequencing. We study two systems for this problem over a corpus of 690 skills: a hybrid ranker combining lexical and dense-embedding retrieval for sparse, on-demand loading, and a typed knowledge graph encoding workflow relations such as prerequisites, data flow, and ordering. On a set of 117 realistic, non-echoing queries, the hybrid ranker retrieves the correct skill within the top five in 73.5% +/- 8.0 of cases, leaving roughly a quarter of queries unserved. When used as the design intended (substituting graph neighbours for additional ranked results at matched token budget), the graph is significantly worse (-11.2 points, p = 0.0007). Its LLM-generated edge layer adds nothing over neighbours obtained free from a local embedding pass, and 73% of the queries the ranker misses are not reachable through the graph at all. We attribute this to a pre-filter topology bound. Because the graph's candidate edges are drawn from the same embedding neighbourhood the ranker already searches, 98.6% of typed edges connect skills the ranker had already surfaced together. The graph can enrich relation semantics but cannot extend retrieval reach. We further show that evaluating on author-written queries overstates hit@5 by up to 44 points, which would have hidden these results entirely. Our contribution is a mechanistic account of why added structure does not improve retrieval over a strong ranker, and identify the conditions under which adding structural interdependence into the retrieval is optimal.

</details>


### [336] [EnvACE: Internalizing Environment Dynamics via World Rehearsal for Agentic Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.06197)
*Zishan Xu,Zhiyuan Yao,Yuxin Chen,Yifu Guo,Zhengxi Lu,Yuquan Lu,Jinyang Huang,Yan Xu,Yasheng Wang,Weinan Zhang,Xingshan Zeng,Weiwen Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: EnvACE提出了一种名为"世界排练"（world rehearsal）的智能体强化学习方法，训练过程中用策略自身模拟环境响应来替代真实或合成环境的交互，端到端联合优化行动与环境角色，使策略内化行动-响应关系，在多个基准上超越传统环境扩展方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 训练大语言模型智能体用于长时程工具使用通常依赖真实或合成可执行环境的交互，但这类环境的构建和验证成本高昂；外部模拟器又难以与真实世界对齐。作者希望摆脱对外部环境的依赖，探索一种新的训练范式。

Method: EnvACE采用行动-排练交替的训练模式：策略先生成工具调用（acting），然后扮演环境角色生成该行动诱导的响应（rehearsal），后续决策基于排练出的响应。两个角色通过任务成功奖励进行端到端联合优化，使策略参数内化行动与环境响应之间的映射关系，形成内嵌的智能体世界模型。

Result: 在BFCL-v4、tau^2-Bench、VitaBench和FinMCP-Bench四个基准上，EnvACE取得了强且可迁移的性能，在总体评估中优于环境扩展基线。受控实验表明世界排练在不同模型尺度下一致地提升策略学习。测试阶段，内化的世界模型支持私有排练，在中等排练预算下无需外部交互即可获得进一步性能增益。

Conclusion: 工作确立了一种超越外部环境约束的LLM智能体训练新路径：通过世界排练让策略在参数中内化环境动态，从而独立于外部环境进行训练和推理，为大规模智能体训练提供新的方向。

Abstract: Training large language model agents for long-horizon tool use typically relies on interactions with real or synthesized executable environments, whose construction and verification are costly, or on external simulators that are difficult to ground. We introduce EnvACE, an agentic reinforcement learning method that replaces external environment interaction during training with world rehearsal. The policy alternates between acting and rehearsal: it first generates a tool call, then plays the role of the environment to produce the response induced by that action, and conditions subsequent decisions on the rehearsed response. Both roles are jointly optimized end-to-end using task-success rewards. Through world rehearsal, the policy internalizes the relationship between actions and their environment responses in its parameters, yielding an agent world model that directly supports decision making. Across BFCL-v4, tau^2-Bench, VitaBench, and FinMCP-Bench, EnvACE achieves strong and transferable performance, outperforming environment-scaling baselines in the overall evaluation. Controlled studies further show that world rehearsal consistently improves policy learning across model scales. At test time, the internalized world model enables private rehearsal before committed execution, yielding further gains under a moderate rehearsal budget without additional external interaction. Our findings establish world rehearsal as a new path toward scaling LLM agent training beyond the constraints of external environments. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/Within-yao/EnvACE.

</details>


### [337] [TS-RAG: Retrieval Augmented Generation for Time Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.06223)
*Yixiong Xiao,Congxi Xiao,Jingbo Zhou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出TS-RAG框架，将检索增强生成(RAG)引入时间序列预测领域，通过设计专门的参考token来融合输入序列与检索到的相似序列的信息，从而在多个真实世界预测基准上取得一致的最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管基于Transformer的深度学习模型在时间序列预测中表现出色，但RAG在该领域的应用仍然有限。RAG已被证明能通过引入相关外部信息增强大语言模型能力，检索相似时间序列作为参考也可能提升预测精度。然而，多数时间序列模型受限于训练数据规模小、参数规模小、缺乏大语言模型的生成能力，简单地像语言模型那样将参考序列拼接到prompt中可能无法达到预期效果。因此需要专门设计适用于时间序列预测的RAG框架。

Method: 提出TS-RAG框架，核心创新在于设计了专门的参考token（reference tokens），用于有效融合输入序列与检索到的相似序列的信息，使模型能够更稳健地捕获复杂的时间动态特征。该方法针对时间序列模型的特点进行定制，而非简单复制语言模型中的RAG拼接方式。

Result: 在多个真实世界的时间序列预测基准数据集上，TS-RAG取得了持续的最优性能（consistent state-of-the-art），验证了该方法的有效性和泛化能力。

Conclusion: TS-RAG证明了检索增强方法在时间序列预测中的可行性，通过专门设计的参考token机制克服了时间序列模型规模小、生成能力有限的局限，为时间序列预测领域引入RAG提供了有效路径。

Abstract: While deep learning models, particularly transformer-based architectures, have shown impressive performance in time series forecasting, the application of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) in this domain remains limited. Since RAG has proven effective in enhancing the capabilities of large language models by incorporating relevant external information, retrieving similar time series sequences as references might also improve accuracy in time series forecasting tasks. However, most time series models are constrained by limited training data, smaller parameter scales, and a lack of the extensive generative capabilities found in large language models. Simply concatenating reference sequences into the prompt, as done in language models, may not yield the expected results. To address these challenges, we propose a novel approach, TS-RAG, which leverages RAG to enhance forecasting performance. The framework introduces specially designed reference tokens to effectively fuse information from the input sequence with that from retrieved similar sequences, enabling a more robust capture of complex temporal dynamics. Experimental results demonstrate that TS-RAG achieves consistent state-of-the-art performance across several real-world forecasting benchmarks.

</details>


### [338] [DASH: Divergence-Adaptive Supervision Horizons for On-Policy Self-Distillation of Reasoning Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.06243)
*ZhiYan Hou,Xinyu Tang,Hongyan An,Jianjin Zhang,Weizhen Wang,Yunyun Han,Gengsheng Li,Xiangzhao Hao,Haiyun Guo,Wenbin Hu,Jinqiao Wang,Yafeng Deng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出DASH（Divergence-Adaptive Supervision Horizons），针对RLVR中标准OPSD方法无法区分不同时间上下文的局部散度这一问题，通过将局部蒸馏信号与序列级均值的差距映射为自适应传播门控，并控制反向多步聚合，实现了对token级监督权重的时序自适应调整。在三个数学推理基准和三种模型规模上，DASH均优于匹配的vanilla OPSD基线，且不增加额外的teacher/student前向开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RLVR使用序列级稀疏奖励信号，OPSD通过privileged teacher在student访问的prefix处提供稠密的token级分布监督来缓解信号稀疏性。然而标准OPSD存在缺陷：它对所有局部散度赋予相同的系数，忽略了散度在rollout中出现的位置及其所在散度序列的上下文。在自回归生成中，相同大小的局部散度可能对应不同的teacher-student错配演化历史，而标准OPSD无法利用这些时序上下文来调整token级权重。

Method: DASH的核心思想是将每个局部蒸馏信号与序列级均值之间的差距映射为一个自适应传播门控（propagation gate），随后利用这些门控控制反向多步聚合过程。通过这种机制，DASH能够根据生成过程中局部散度的演化动态调整token级监督权重。该方法直接复用OPSD已计算的teacher和student分布，无需额外的模型前向传播。

Result: 在三个数学推理基准（三个模型规模）上，DASH在每一个基准和每一个规模上都优于匹配的vanilla OPSD重跑结果。增益不引入额外的teacher或student前向开销。

Conclusion: DASH通过引入对散度时序演化的自适应感知，有效克服了标准OPSD在稠密token级监督中忽略时序上下文的问题，在数学推理任务上取得了全基准、全规模的一致改进，且计算开销为零增量。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) improves the reasoning capabilities of large language models using automatically verifiable outcome signals, but these signals are typically sparse and at the sequence-level. On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) mitigates this sparsity by querying a privileged teacher at student-visited prefixes and providing dense token-level distributional supervision. Although this dense supervision alleviates signal sparsity, we find that standard OPSD still underexploits the temporal structure of the rollout. It assigns every local divergence the same coefficient, regardless of its position or the divergence sequence in which it occurs. In on-policy autoregressive generation, the same divergence magnitude can follow different discrepancy histories, reflecting different evolutions of the mismatch between the teacher and student. Since the local scalar alone cannot distinguish these temporal contexts, standard OPSD cannot adapt its token-level weights to the realized discrepancy sequence. To address this limitation, we propose Divergence-Adaptive Supervision Horizons (DASH). DASH maps the gap between each local distillation signal and the sequence-level mean to an adaptive propagation gate and then uses these gates to control backward multi-step aggregation. By doing so, DASH adjusts token-level supervision weights according to how local divergences evolve during generation. Experiments on three mathematical reasoning benchmarks across three model scales show that DASH improves over our matched vanilla OPSD reruns on every benchmark at all three scales. DASH reuses the teacher and student distributions that OPSD already computes, so the gains require no additional teacher or student forward pass.
  Code: https://github.com/DBtxy/DASH-OPSD

</details>


### [339] [Improving the Realism of Synthetic Clinical Benchmarks Under Utility Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.06265)
*Omid Bazgir,Md Nasir,Jacob Hoffman,Yang Yang,Manu Agrawal,Anusua Trivedi,Vinay Rao Dandin,Chris Gibbons,Christine Swisher*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究如何在保留现有实用性检验的前提下，提升合成临床基准测试的真实性。提出"受实用性约束的真实性改进"框架，在Synthea生成的护理缺口基准上测试两种确定性修订方法，显著改善缺失结构、简洁性、结构合理性和人群对齐等真实性指标，同时维持现有实用性下限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 合成临床基准可能通过现有的实用性检查却在结构上不真实，尤其在隐私敏感的医疗场景中，运营数据难以获取。仅依赖实用性检查不足以保证基准质量，需要显式优化真实性指标。

Method: 将基准修订形式化为受实用性约束的真实性改进问题：数据集修改需在提升真实性的同时保持在运营实用性下限之上。在基于Synthea生成的护理缺口基准上实现该想法，该基准经电子健康记录工作流演示和与运营数据相同的下游流水线处理。从缺失结构、简洁性、结构合理性和人群对齐四个维度测量真实性，并与朴素密度化对照进行了比较。

Result: 基线基准极度单薄：采样对缺失率79.44%，仅12.75%行可操作，38.94%患者无可操作指标，前三个token集中度达100.0%。两种确定性修订在维持当前实用性下限的同时改善上述指标，而朴素密度化对照仍保留不真实的模板化。此外发现内部基准真实性与对聚合运营参考的源保真度是相关但不同的目标。

Conclusion: 合成基准质量应被显式优化，实用性仅作为一个约束条件而非真实性的充分证据。

Abstract: Synthetic clinical benchmarks for enterprise AI agents can pass existing utility checks and still remain structurally unrealistic, especially in privacy-sensitive healthcare settings where operational data are hard to access. We study how to improve such benchmarks without breaking the downstream utility checks already used in practice.
  We formulate benchmark revision as utility-constrained realism improvement: dataset changes should increase realism while staying above an operational utility floor. We instantiate this idea on a care-gap benchmark derived from Synthea-generated patients exercised through demonstration electronic health record workflows and then processed by the same downstream pipeline as operational data. Realism is measured through missingness structure, simplicity, structural plausibility, and population alignment.
  The baseline benchmark is extremely thin: sampled-pair missingness is 79.44%, only 12.75% of rows are actionable, 38.94% of patients have zero actionable measures, and top-three token concentration reaches 100.0%. Two deterministic revisions improve these panels while remaining above the current utility floor, whereas a naive densification control preserves unrealistic templating. We further show that internal benchmark realism and source fidelity to an aggregate operational reference are related but distinct objectives. These results suggest that synthetic benchmark quality should be optimized explicitly, with utility treated as one constraint rather than as sufficient evidence of realism.

</details>


### [340] [The Illusion of Visual Tool-Use: A Causal Audit of Thinking with Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.06270)
*Zhiheng Wang,Bo Peng,Lai Wei,Chaochao Lu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文对多模态大语言模型的"with-images思考"（如裁剪和缩放等主动视觉操作）范式进行因果审计。通过将视觉工具使用形式化为因果图，并在策略、轨迹和步骤三个层级进行干预，作者发现视觉工具使用存在"幻觉"现象：尽管总体上获得精度提升，但其因果有效性仅集中于少数已校准的轨迹中，多数情况下返回的观察结果对答案没有因果影响，或调用计划不连贯。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态LLM使用裁剪和缩放等视觉操作（thinking-with-images范式）时，往往只带来边际甚至负面的精度提升，同时增加大量token成本。模型可能反复裁剪无关区域，甚至在直接推理能正确回答的问题上失败。作者质疑返回的视觉证据是否真正因果性地影响答案，而非仅通过捷径产生表面上的精度提升。

Method: 将视觉工具使用形式化为因果图，区分观察介导路径和行动诱导捷径。在三个层级进行干预审计：(1) 策略层：比较工具使用与直接推理；(2) 轨迹层：在rollout过程中破坏所有观察；(3) 步骤层：在固定前缀下反事实替换单个观察。提出了步骤级估计量——视觉证据增益（Visual Evidence Gain），用于隔离每个返回观察的因果贡献。实验覆盖6个代表性模型和5个细粒度感知基准。

Result: 揭示了策略层校准不良的两种失败模式：一是"无看调用"（Calling Without Looking），返回的观察对答案无因果影响；二是"无规划观察"（Looking Without Planning），观察含有信息但调用时间表不连贯。轨迹级诊断将策略级精度增益分解，发现增益集中在一小部分"已校准"的轨迹中，其余大部分rollout中视觉工具使用并非因果有效。

Conclusion: 视觉工具使用存在"幻觉"现象：尽管聚合精度显示增益，但在广泛的rollout范围内视觉工具使用并非因果有效。这种"视觉工具使用的幻觉"表明现有基于聚合指标的评估可能高估了工具使用策略的真实有效性，需要对视觉工具使用进行更严格的因果审计。

Abstract: The "thinking-with-images" paradigm equips multimodal LLMs with active visual operations such as crop-and-zoom. However, models using these operations often achieve only marginal or negative gains over direct inference at substantially higher token cost. They may also repeatedly crop irrelevant regions and fail on questions that direct inference answers correctly. We ask whether the returned visual evidence causally affects the answer. To answer this question, we formulate visual tool-use as a causal graph that separates observation-mediated paths from action-induced shortcuts. We then audit it through interventions at the three levels: policy (comparing tool-use with direct inference), trajectory (corrupting all observations during rollout), and step (counterfactually replacing one individual observation under a fixed prefix). Our step-level estimand, Visual Evidence Gain, isolates the contribution of each returned observation. Across six representative models and five fine-grained perception benchmarks, we uncover policy miscalibration with two failure modes. In Calling Without Looking, returned observations have no causal effect on the answer. In Looking Without Planning, observations are informative but the call schedule is incoherent. A trajectory-level diagnostic decomposes the policy-level accuracy gain and shows that the gain is concentrated in a Calibrated minority. We term this discrepancy the illusion of visual tool-use: despite aggregate accuracy gains, visual tool-use is not causally effective across a broad range of rollouts. The code is available at https://github.com/OpenCausaLab/CauAudit.

</details>


### [341] [QuanTiMedAI: Quantum-Enhanced Time-Series Model guided by Agentic AI for Cardiac Arrest Mortality Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.06294)
*Mutasim Fuad Sarker,Adiba Rahman Namira,Wafa Binte Alam,Md Adnan Arefeen,Mahzabeen Emu,Sumaiya Tabassum Nimi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出QuanTiMedAI框架，结合代理式大语言模型（LLM）进行临床特征发现和紧凑量子循环网络进行时序感知的心脏骤停死亡率预测。在MIMIC-IV队列上仅用605个参数即达到0.852的AUROC，比现有最优基线提升约2.9%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有心脏骤停死亡率预测研究主要依赖入院早期的静态汇总数据，忽略了患者在ICU住院期间生理恶化和恢复的时间动态变化，限制了预测性能。

Method: QuanTiMedAI框架包含两个核心组件：(1) 代理式大语言模型（agentic LLM），用于临床知情特征发现与选择；(2) 紧凑量子循环网络，利用量子非线性特征增强实现时序感知的死亡率预测。通过结构化消融实验验证各架构设计选择的贡献。

Result: 在MIMIC-IV心脏骤停患者队列上，QuanTiMedAI实现AUROC 0.852，仅使用605个参数，较当前最优基线提升约2.9%。代理式LLM引导的特征选择优于传统特征选择方法，量子架构在极低参数量的情况下达到竞争性预测性能。

Conclusion: 量子增强的序列建模能够在参数数量大幅减少的情况下超越经典循环网络，为ICU心脏骤停患者死亡率预测提供了一种高效且准确的解决方案。

Abstract: Cardiac arrest remains one of the most lethal conditions encountered in intensive care units. Despite the growing availability of electronic health record data, existing mortality prediction studies in this population largely depend on static summaries derived from early admission. Such approaches ignore the temporal progression of physiological deterioration and recovery that unfolds throughout a patient's ICU stay. To address this limitation, we introduce QuanTiMedAI, a quantum-agentic framework developed for cardiac arrest mortality prediction using agentic AI guided quantum enhancement time series model. The proposed system combines an agentic large language model (LLM) for clinically informed feature discovery with a compact quantum recurrent network for temporality aware mortality prediction. Our findings demonstrate that agentic LLM-guided feature selection consistently outperforms conventional feature selection approaches, and the proposed quantum architecture achieves competitive predictive performance through nonlinear feature enhancement while keeping the number of parameters very low. Through extensive experimentation on a MIMIC-IV cohort of cardiac arrest patients, QuanTiMedAI's quantum-enhanced architecture attains an AUROC of 0.852 using only 605 parameters, an improvement of approximately 2.9\% over a current state-of-the-art baseline for this task. A structured ablation study systematically validates the contribution of each architectural design choice. These results show that quantum-enhanced sequential modeling can exceed classical recurrent networks while using substantially fewer parameters.

</details>


### [342] [Bias Analysis of L2 Speaking Assessment Systems Using Concept Activation Vectors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.06300)
*Arya Labroo,Mengjie Qian,Kate Knill*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文扩展了基于概念激活向量（CAVs）的公平性分析方法，用于检测两个神经语音评估系统（文本BERT评分器和基于Whisper的多模态评分器）中是否存在对无关说话者属性（如母语L1或年龄）的偏见。研究发现概念的可恢复性取决于被探测的表示和架构而非概念本身，SAEs虽然使概念更线性可恢复，但会减弱原始激活空间中的敏感性，强调了审计时需区分概念可恢复性与概念影响力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动语音评分系统在高风险场景中越来越多地用于评估二语学习者的口语考试，其分数必须取决于口语能力而非无关的说话者属性（如母语或年龄）。然而，基于Transformer的基础模型虽然提高了评分准确性，但其黑箱表示使得公平性和可解释性分析变得更加困难，需要开发有效的方法来审计这些系统中可能存在的偏见。

Method: 基于先前在特征型评分器中使用概念激活向量（CAVs）检测对不需要属性偏见的工作，本文将其扩展到两个神经语音评估系统：文本BERT评分器和基于Whisper的语音文本多模态评分器。CAVs将人类可解释的概念表示为模型激活空间中的方向，通过基于梯度的敏感性度量区分概念是否被编码在内部表示中及是否影响预测分数。同时，由于CAVs依赖线性可分性，在复杂神经嵌入空间中不太可能成立，本文还研究了稀疏自编码器（SAEs）是否能在稀疏潜空间中学习更清晰的概念方向并将其映射回激活空间。

Result: 分析表明概念的可恢复性强烈依赖于被探测的表示和架构，而非仅取决于概念本身。对概念的敏感性也是架构相关的。SAEs使概念更线性可恢复，但会减弱原始激活空间的敏感性，尤其在低维层中。

Conclusion: 研究结果强调了在审计语音评估系统的偏见时，需要明确区分概念可恢复性与概念影响力，这两个指标可能产生不一致的信号，单独依赖任一指标都可能导致偏差判断错误。

Abstract: Automatic speaking assessment systems are increasingly deployed in high-stakes settings to mark second language (L2) learners' speaking tests, making it critical to show that their scores depend on speaking proficiency rather than irrelevant speaker attributes such as first language (L1) or age. Transformer-based foundation models have improved the accuracy of these L2 speaking graders, but their black-box representations make fairness and interpretability analysis more difficult. Building on prior work that used Concept Activation Vectors (CAVs) to detect bias towards unwanted attributes (`concepts') in feature-based graders, we extend CAV-based analysis to two neural speaking assessment systems: a text-based BERT grader and a speech-and-text multimodal grader based on Whisper. CAVs represent human-interpretable concepts as directions in a model's activation space, allowing us to distinguish between whether a concept is encoded in a model's internal representations and whether it influences the predicted score, the latter quantified using a gradient-based sensitivity metric. Since CAVs rely on linear separability, which is less likely in complex neural embedding spaces, we also investigate whether sparse autoencoders (SAEs) provide cleaner concept directions by learning CAVs in a sparse latent space and mapping them back to activation space. Our analysis shows that concept recoverability depends strongly on the representation and architecture being probed, rather than on the concept alone. Sensitivity to concepts is also architecture-dependent. SAEs make concepts more linearly recoverable, but attenuate the original activation-space sensitivity, especially in low-dimensional layers. These findings highlight the need to distinguish concept recoverability from concept influence when auditing bias in speaking assessment systems.

</details>


### [343] [TRAJDEBUG: Tracing Error Lifecycle to Identify Critical Failures in Long-Horizon Agent Trajectories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.06346)
*Yunjia Qi,Zehua Yin,Xintong Shi,Hao Peng,Songyuanyi Lu,Yixian Liu,Richeng Xuan,Yuhong Liu,Zhichao Hu,Xiaozhi Wang,Lei Hou,Bin Xu,Juanzi Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出TrajDebug，一个基于错误生命周期追踪的框架，用于在LLM智能体系统的长轨迹中定位导致最终失败的关键错误步骤；同时构建了包含486条人工标注失败轨迹的基准TrajErrBench，实验表明该方法优于现有基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体系统在复杂领域表现优异，但存在级联错误和调试困难的问题。关键错误检测旨在定位导致最终失败的最早错误步骤，但面临两大挑战：一是长轨迹中判断单个步骤错误的证据可能分散在远距离的指令、观察和上下文中；二是失败轨迹常包含多个局部错误，具有不同的下游影响，只有部分错误对最终失败负责。

Method: 提出TrajDebug框架，包含两个核心模块：1) 采用多粒度历史压缩和基于证据的错误识别来解决长轨迹中的错误发现；2) 通过追踪每个错误的解决状态和最终影响来实现关键错误归因（error-lifecycle tracing）。同时构建TrajErrBench基准，包含486条来自Tau2Bench和SWE-Bench Pro的人工标注失败轨迹。

Result: 在多个智能体基准上的实验表明，TrajDebug在整体性能上优于现有基线；下游应用研究进一步证明其诊断结果能为改进智能体成功率提供可操作的反馈。

Conclusion: TrajDebug能够有效识别长失败轨迹中的关键错误步骤，并提供可操作的调试反馈以提升下游智能体系统性能。代码和数据将公开发布以促进后续研究。

Abstract: LLM-based agentic systems have shown remarkable capabilities in complex domains, while suffering from cascading errors and difficulty in debugging. Critical error detection aims to locate the earliest error step in a failed trajectory that is responsible for the final failure. However, progress faces two main challenges. First, long trajectories make it difficult to identify individual errors, since the evidence for judging a step may be scattered across distant instructions, observations, and prior context. Second, failed trajectories often contain multiple local errors with different downstream effects, only some of which remain responsible for the final failure. In this work, we propose TrajDebug, an error-lifecycle tracing framework that addresses long-trajectory error discovery with multi-granularity history compression and evidence-based error identification, and supports critical attribution by tracing each error's resolution status and terminal impact. We further construct TrajErrBench, a benchmark of 486 manually annotated failed trajectories from Tau2Bench and SWE-Bench Pro, covering realistic tool-use and coding scenarios. Experiments across diverse agent benchmarks show that TrajDebug achieves the best overall performance over existing baselines, and application studies further demonstrate that its diagnoses provide actionable feedback for improving downstream agent success. We will release the codes and data to facilitate further research.

</details>


### [344] [Challenges in Evaluating Explanation Methods for Static and Evolving Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.06351)
*Jerzy Stefanowski*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文探讨了可解释人工智能（XAI）在评估不足方面的局限性，通过DetoxAI图像识别系统（用于偏见检测和概念遗忘）加以说明，并提出了面向图像分类解释方法的人类接地评估示例，以及适应概念漂移数据流的解释自适应方法（包括反事实调整），最终关联到数据、模型和解释共演化的跟踪挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有XAI方法缺乏充分的评估机制，特别是在偏见检测、概念遗忘以及动态环境（概念漂移）下的可解释性表现存在明显不足，需要系统性地探讨这些问题。

Method: 本文采用案例研究方式，以DetoxAI图像识别系统为例说明XAI评估不足的问题；提出人类接地评估方法用于图像分类解释的评估；并探讨了将反事实解释方法适配到概念漂移数据流中的策略。

Result: 通过具体案例展示了XAI评估不足的局限性，提出了用于图像分类解释的人类接地评估框架，并讨论了反事实解释在概念漂移场景下的适配经验。

Conclusion: XAI领域需要更系统的评估方法，特别是在动态数据环境下，解释方法必须能够适应概念漂移，并需关注数据、模型与解释三者之间的共演化关系。

Abstract: This paper addresses the limitations of Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) with respect to insufficient evaluation. They are illustrated through the DetoxAI image recognition system for bias detection and concept unlearning. Then, an example of a human-grounded evaluation of methods for explaining image classification is presented. The paper further explores methods for adapting explanations to evolving data streams with concept drift. Experiences with adapting counterfactuals for this problem are discussed. Finally it is related to the challenges of tracking the co-evolution of data, models, and explanations.\footnote{This paper has been accepted for a publication in J.Nalepa (ed) Explainable AI in Space. Proceedings of EASi 2026 Workshop at IJCAI-ECAI 2026 Bremen, Springer CCIS vol 3107 (2016).}

</details>


### [345] [The Low Frequency Trap: Video Language Models Fail at Simple Event Bookkeeping](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.06361)
*Sarvesh Baskar,Zikui Cai,Shayan Shabihi,Anirudh Satheesh,Muhammad R. Islam,Udari Madhushani Sehwag,Tom Goldstein,Furong Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出基于可执行事件轨迹（trace-grounded）的参数化剖析方法，在2190个受控视频中系统评估事件计数能力，揭示模型存在阶段性的时间推理失败，且事件表征类型决定了模型能否初步获取证据，高频高计数区间仅有0.2%最终计数正确、仅恢复18.1%真实事件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实世界视频基准虽然覆盖面广，但其固定片段将事件数量、速率、持续时间和视觉复杂度纠缠在一起，难以隔离失败模式；现有程序化基准仅对最终答案打分，无法将报告的事件与可执行的ground truth进行逐条审计。需要一种既能精确控制参数又能对事件级细节进行评估的方法。

Method: 提出trace-grounded参数化剖析方法，在三个受控视频任务（弹跳球碰壁、视觉眨眼、类别状态转换）中，生成2190个视频，独立变化事件数量N和频率F（渲染固定）。每个视频关联一个可执行的ground truth事件轨迹，用于能力表面估计和时间戳级评估。此外还通过提高采样率、改变提示策略等实验检验视觉访问是否为瓶颈。

Result: 在80%可靠性阈值下，Gemini 3.6 Flash可靠计数持续状态转换最多12个事件（0.5和1.0 Hz），但瞬态眨眼事件无可依赖的正计数区间。高计数高频区仅0.2%最终计数正确，仅恢复18.1%真实事件。提高采样率将Bounce Ball准确率从19.6%提升至29.3%，但报告序列与ground truth仅3.7%一致；不同提示策略收益有限；真实视频评估同样集中在小事件数场景。

Conclusion: 事件表征类型决定了模型能否初步获取证据，这一限制随着计数和频率增加而加剧。额外帧可能抬高最终分数却不产生忠实的逐事件恢复。trace-grounded剖析将视频评估从聚合准确率指标转向对时间推理失败机制的细粒度诊断。

Abstract: Real-world video benchmarks provide broad coverage, but their fixed clips entangle event count, rate, duration, and visual complexity, making failure modes hard to isolate. While existing programmatic benchmarks offer better control, they score only the final answer rather than auditing reported events against executable ground truth. To bridge this gap, we introduce trace-grounded parametric profiling for event counting in three controlled video tasks: bouncing-ball wall contacts, visual blinks, and categorical state transitions. Across 2,190 videos, we vary event count N and frequency F while holding rendering fixed. Each video includes an executable event trace for capability-surface estimation and timestamp-level evaluation. Our results reveal a staged temporal failure. At an 80% reliability threshold, Gemini 3.6 Flash reliably counts persistent state transitions up to 12 events at 0.5 and 1.0 Hz, yet demonstrates no reliable positive-count region for transient blinking events. Thus, event representation dictates whether a model initially accesses evidence -- a limitation that compounds as count and frequency increase. In the high-count, high-frequency regime, only 0.2% of final counts are correct and the model recovers just 18.1% of true events. To test if visual access is the primary bottleneck, we increase sampling rate. Although this boosts Bounce Ball accuracy from 19.6% to 29.3%, the reported sequence agrees with ground truth only 3.7% of the time. Extra frames can therefore inflate final scores without producing faithful event recovery. Different prompting strategies yield similarly limited gains, and real-world video evaluations show the same concentration of success at low event counts. Ultimately, trace-grounded profiling shifts video evaluation from aggregate accuracy metrics to a detailed diagnostic of where temporal reasoning fails.

</details>


### [346] [Tracing the Heart: An Evidence-Linked Pipeline for Heart-Failure Feature Engineering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.06366)
*Soorya Ram Shimgekar,Michelle Hu,Dorisa Shehi,Daniel Kang,Roy Ka-Wei Lee,Koustuv Saha,Christian Poellabauer,Christopher Lee,Sajeev Singh,Piyum Zonooz,Navin Kumar,Zeeshan Ahmed,Priyadarshini Kachroo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出Nimblemind多智能体系统（nMAS），一个基于证据链接和rubric评分规则的自动化心衰电子病历（EHR）特征工程流水线，在500条虚拟患者记录上生成132个结构化及70个rubric评分的聚合特征，将HFrEF表型分类AUROC从0.895提升至0.963（HFpEF从0.870提升至0.910），并通过独立LLM评估获得81.5%的最高分，验证了自动化、可审计特征工程的可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: EHR特征工程是临床研究和AI中的主要瓶颈，占数据科学家39-45%的工作量。这一问题在心衰领域尤为突出（影响约670万美国成年人），因为需要整合碎片化的EHR数据并融入疾病特异性的循证临床推理。现有基于规则和LLM的方法仅能实现部分自动化，且可维护性和证据可追溯性有限。

Method: 开发了Nimblemind多智能体系统（nMAS），这是一个基于证据链接、rubric评分导向的自动化心衰特征工程流水线。系统从九个EHR源表中提取数据，生成结构化特征和rubric评分的聚合特征，并通过受限LLM进行结构完整性、rubric合规性、来源可追溯性验证及审计。评估在500条虚拟患者记录上进行，并利用独立LLM进行rubric评估。

Result: nMAS生成132个结构化特征和70个rubric评分聚合特征，均通过结构完整性、rubric合规性和来源验证。加入聚合特征后，held-out AUROC在HFrEF表型分类中从0.895提升至0.963，HFpEF从0.870提升至0.910。独立LLM基于rubric的评估显示证据支持和方法学健全性得分达到最高分的81.5%。

Conclusion: 研究证明了针对复杂心血管EHR数据进行自动化、可审计特征工程的可行性。然而，评估仅限于单一机构队列，需要外部验证来进一步确认系统的泛化能力。

Abstract: Electronic health record (EHR) feature engineering is a major bottleneck in clinical research and AI, accounting for 39-45% of data scientists' workload. This is especially pronounced in heart failure, which affects an estimated 6.7 million U.S. adults and requires integrating fragmented EHR data with disease-specific, guideline-based clinical reasoning. Existing rule-based and large language model (LLM)-based approaches offer only partial automation with limited maintainability and evidence traceability. We developed the Nimblemind Multi-Agent System (nMAS), an evidence-linked, rubric-grounded pipeline for automated heart-failure feature engineering, and evaluated it on 500 dummy patient records from nine EHR source tables. nMAS generated 132 structured and 70 rubric-scored aggregated features, verified for structural integrity, rubric compliance, and provenance, and audited by a restricted LLM. Adding the aggregated features improved held-out AUROC from 0.895 to 0.963 for HFrEF and 0.870 to 0.910 for HFpEF phenotyping, and an independent LLM-based rubric assessment of evidence support and methodological soundness scored the features at 81.5% of maximum points. These results demonstrate the feasibility of automated, auditable feature engineering for complex cardiovascular EHR data, though evaluation was limited to a single-institution cohort and external validation is needed.

</details>

### [347] [CLARA: Clarification of Language Ambiguity through Result Analysis for Natural-Language Cancer Genomics Queries](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.05195)
*Pratyush Kumar Shukla,Manveer Singh Tib,Siddhant Garg*

Main category: q-bio.GN

TL;DR: CLARA是一个用于癌症基因组学数据库自然语言查询的框架，通过将问题表示为类型化的科学查询规范、执行多种可能解释并在结果分歧时请求澄清，来区分有意义的歧义与无关紧要的歧义。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自然语言接口虽然能让癌症基因组数据库更易使用，但即使问题表述流畅，其科学含义仍可能存在歧义。需要一种机制来识别并处理这种模糊性。

Method: CLARA将问题表示为类型化的科学查询规范，考虑多个可能的解释，执行这些解释，当结果估计出现分歧时要求用户澄清。评估使用TCGA PanCancer Atlas数据集，对比8个队列和30个基因面板的突变患病率，共330个可执行对比，并采用预先注册的相对分歧（>0.10）或绝对分歧（>5个百分点）标准。

Result: 独立的pandas执行引擎完美复现了SQLite引擎的全部660个结果。在120个LLM生成且人工审核的语言压力测试中，CLARA识别出全部60个结果敏感对比，对13/60个稳定对比进行了不必要澄清（准确率89.2%，敏感度100%，特异度78.3%）。独立机器学习方法总体准确率更高（97.5%）但漏掉了一个关键对比。

Conclusion: 通过下游执行可以区分有意义的歧义与无关紧要的歧义，揭示了安全性与用户负担之间明确的权衡。

Abstract: A natural language interface can be used to make cancer genomics databases easier to use, but even if a question is perfectly fluent, its scientific meaning can be ambiguous. We propose CLARA, a framework that represents a question as a typed scientific query specification, considers a few possible interpretations, executes them, and asks for clarification when the estimates diverge. CLARA was assessed on mutation-prevalence contrasts among eight TCGA PanCancer Atlas cohorts and a 30-gene panel. This benchmark consisted of 330 unique executable contrasts varying in mutation scope, assay denominator, and sample context; 115 contrasts were result-sensitive and 215 were result-stable, per the preregistered definition of relative divergence greater than 0.10 or absolute divergence greater than 5 percentage points. An independently implemented pandas execution engine perfectly replicated all 660 results from the SQLite engine. In a separate 120-question LLM-generated, manually vetted language stress test, CLARA recognized all 60 result-sensitive contrasts and needlessly clarified 13 of 60 stable contrasts (accuracy 89.2%, sensitivity/recall 100%, specificity 78.3%). Standalone machine learning had superior overall accuracy (97.5%) but missed one critical contrast. This demonstrates that downstream execution can distinguish consequential from inconsequential ambiguity and reveal an explicit trade-off between safety and burden.

</details>


### [348] [Frozen but Not Always Accessible: A Representation Analysis of Genomic Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.05329)
*Nirjhor Datta,Swakkhar Shatabda,M. Sohel Rahman*

Main category: q-bio.GN

TL;DR: 本文对五种基因组基础模型（DNABERT-2、Nucleotide Transformer、HyenaDNA、GENERATOR-v2和Omni-DNA）的冻结表示进行了可访问性分析，跨越调控、表观遗传、启动子、剪接位点和变异效应预测等多个下游任务，发现冻结探针在启动子任务上可恢复95-100%的微调性能，但剪接位点任务恢复率仅60-88%，表明局部生物学信号并非总能通过最终池化嵌入访问。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基因组基础模型越来越多地被作为冻结特征提取器复用于下游序列预测，以替代计算成本高的全量微调。然而，这些模型编码的生物学信息在无需任务特定适配时是否真正可访问仍不清楚，因此需要系统的表示可访问性分析来指导实践。

Method: 作者提出了统一的冻结探针协议，将诊断性读头分析与验证集选择的检查分离。评估了DNABERT-2、Nucleotide Transformer、HyenaDNA、GENERATOR-v2和Omni-DNA五种模型，覆盖调控、表观遗传、启动子、剪接位点和变异效应预测任务。分析手段包括逐层探针（layer-wise probing）、计算机模拟诱变（in-silico mutagenesis）、变异效应预测和嵌入几何分析。

Result: 冻结探针在启动子任务上可恢复95-100%的微调性能，但剪接位点任务平均恢复率降至60-88%。冻结嵌入在编码区和物种判别等广泛基因组基准任务上表现竞争力，但在部分调控和开放染色质区（OCR）任务上差距较大。局部生物学信号部分存在于冻结表示中，但并非总能通过最终池化嵌入访问。

Conclusion: 冻结基因组基础模型的能力呈现任务依赖性：某些任务（如启动子预测）中冻结表示几乎完全可访问，而其他任务（如剪接位点预测）则存在显著的表示可访问性差距，需要通过任务特定适配来释放其完整潜力。

Abstract: Genomic foundation models are increasingly reused as frozen feature extractors for downstream sequence prediction, offering a compute-efficient alternative to full fine-tuning. However, it remains unclear when biological information encoded by these models is accessible without task-specific adaptation. We present a representation-accessibility analysis of frozen genomic language models across regulatory, epigenetic, promoter, splice-site, and variant-effect prediction tasks. We evaluate DNABERT-2, Nucleotide Transformer, HyenaDNA, GENERATOR-v2, and Omni-DNA under unified frozen-probing protocols, while separating diagnostic readout analyses from validation-selected checks. Our results reveal a consistent task-dependent pattern: frozen probes recover 95-100 % of fine-tuned performance on promoter tasks, but average splice-site recovery drops to 60-88 %. Frozen embeddings are also competitive on broad Genomic Benchmark tasks such as coding-region and species-discrimination classification, but show larger gaps on some regulatory and OCR tasks. Layer-wise probing, in-silico mutagenesis, variant-effect prediction, and embedding geometry show that local biological signal is partially present in frozen representations, but is not always accessible through final pooled embeddings.

</details>


<div id='cs.DC'></div>

# cs.DC [[Back]](#toc)

### [349] [Hierarchical Server Architecture for Agentic Science](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.05332)
*Vanessa Sochat,Daniel Milroy*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种用于智能体科学的分层动态资源发现架构，能够跨云、边缘和HPC系统自动发现和调度计算资源，通过秘书智能体实现并发、异步的协商、选择与任务分派，在51个真实和模拟提供方上进行了大规模仿真验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体科学的工作负载需要跨机构、跨环境的专用硬件资源，而评估工作负载需求与环境匹配是调度的前提，因此自动化资源发现成为必不可少的步骤。现有方法缺乏跨多样异构环境的动态、可扩展的资源发现能力。

Method: 提出一种分层的动态架构和软件系统，使用秘书智能体（secretary agents）实现并发、异步的协商、选择和任务分派；智能体对7个类别的51个真实及模拟提供方进行资源探测与发现，并通过大量仿真评估决策可靠性。

Result: 进行了19,973次协商模拟和6,952次选择模拟，实现了87.71%的协商准确率，选择成本与传统策略相当，展示了高可靠性和成本效益。该系统已支持Genesis任务。

Conclusion: 该架构证明了智能体、发现工具与基础设施之间精细协调对于智能体科学的重要性，设计具有可扩展性，为跨异构计算环境的自动化资源调度提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Agentic science is transforming the landscape of computational work, extending to scientific pipelines and workload managers. The workloads require specialized hardware within and across institutions. If assessing workload needs against environments is required for scheduling, automated discovery of resources is an essential step. In this paper, we present a hierarchical, dynamic architecture and software to discover resources across diverse cloud, edge, and HPC systems. The design enables concurrent, asynchronous negotiation, selection, and dispatch of requests for work using secretary agents. The agents probe and discover 51 real and simulated providers across 7 categories. We perform 19,973 negotiation and 6,952 selection simulations to assess reliability of decisions, demonstrating high (87.71\%) negotiation accuracy and selection costs comparable to more traditional strategies. Designed for extensibility and currently supporting the Genesis Mission, this architecture exemplifies the importance of careful coordination between agents, discovery tools, and infrastructure for agentic science.

</details>


### [350] [Application Failures and Machine Computational Efficiency](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.05408)
*Carlo Graziani,Bethany Lusch,O. E. Bronson Messer*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出一个评估百亿亿次级（Exascale）科学计算平台在应用故障率显著时的运行效率框架。该框架将故障率和平均故障间隔时间从"时间"改为"使用量"（如节点小时）来定义，扩展了Daly(2006)的最优检查点模型，允许用户指定最小化损耗的最优检查点使用间隔，并推导出机器计算效率（可分配给科学计算资源的期望比例）。论文使用橡树岭国家实验室Frontier超级计算机一年生产运行数据验证了该方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前顶级科学计算平台和大型AI训练设施面临显著的应用程序故障率，现有故障评估框架以"时间"为度量方式不适用于科学计算平台应用的异构性需求，需要新的基于"使用量"的评估框架来准确衡量故障带来的效率损失。

Method: 提出基于使用量（如节点小时）定义故障率和平均故障间隔时间的框架；扩展Daly(2006)的检查点模型，加入故障损失、检查点开销和重启成本三个使用损耗项；推导机器计算效率公式以确定用于科学计算的期望资源分配比例；利用Frontier超级计算机一年的生产运行数据进行实证验证。

Result: 该框架能够更准确地评估Exascale平台在故障率显著条件下的运行效率，通过Frontier超级计算机的生产数据验证了方法的有效性，可帮助用户设定最小化损耗的最优检查点使用间隔。

Conclusion: 科学计算平台的异构应用特性要求故障度量应基于"使用量"而非"时间"，该框架为Exascale级计算系统在故障环境下的效率评估和检查点策略优化提供了系统性方法论。

Abstract: We present a framework for evaluating uptime efficiency of Exascale-class scientific computers when application failure rates are appreciable. This is the situation that confronts current leadership-class scientific computing platforms and large AI training installations. What distinguishes scientific computing platforms is the heterogeneity of their applications. We argue that this diversity requires that failure rates and mean intervals between failures should be specified in terms of \emph{usage} (e.g. node-hours) rather than time, as is currently customary. We consider the usage loss terms due to failures, to checkpointing, and to restart costs, and update the framework of Daly (2006) allowing users to specify optimal checkpointing usage intervals that minimize such losses. We derive the machine computational efficiency, which specifies the expected fractional resource allocation that is available for scientific computation. We illustrate the methodology using one year of production runtime data from the \emph{Frontier} supercomputer at Oak Ridge National Laboratory.

</details>


### [351] [Serverless platform driven CPU loadbalancing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.05633)
*Abdul Rehman*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个基于SchedExt(SCX)的服务端无服务器平台驱动的CPU负载均衡框架，通过自定义Linux调度器让控制平面直接干预CPU调度。该调度器引入可配置调度域和共享接口，基于函数历史到达间隔进行域分配，并在域内采用单队列负载均衡和虚拟时间优先级策略。八域配置下能耗降低约15%，调用成本仅增加5%；重负载下请求延迟相比默认CFS调度器降低高达50%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Serverless平台掌握全局的函数调用和资源利用视图，但现有系统的CPU调度决策仍被限制在操作系统调度器层面，导致控制平面的全局信息无法用于优化调度，造成能效和性能上的损失。

Method: 构建在SchedExt(SCX)之上的自定义Linux调度器：(1)引入可配置调度域；(2)提供共享接口使控制平面根据函数历史到达间隔将函数分配到不同域；(3)每个域内采用单队列负载均衡策略结合虚拟时间优先级策略，改善任务放置并减少忙轮询任务的干扰。

Result: 八域配置达到最佳权衡，系统能耗降低约15%，调用成本仅增加5%；在重负载下请求延迟相比默认Linux CFS调度器降低高达50%。

Conclusion: 将CPU调度决策暴露给serverless控制平面可以在保持调度灵活性的同时改善能效和工作负载性能，验证了平台驱动调度的有效性。

Abstract: Serverless platforms maintain a global view of function invocations and resource utilization, yet existing systems largely restrict CPU scheduling decisions to the operating system scheduler. This paper presents a serverless platform-driven CPU load balancing framework that enables the control plane to directly influence CPU scheduling through a custom Linux scheduler built on SchedExt(SCX). The proposed scheduler introduces configurable scheduling domains and a shared interface that allows the control plane to assign functions to domains based on their historical inter-arrival times. Within each domain, a single-queue load-balancing strategy combined with a virtual-time prioritization policy improves task placement while reducing interference from busy-polling tasks. Results show that an eight-domain configuration achieves the best trade-off, reducing system energy consumption by approximately 15% while increasing invocation cost by only 5%. Under heavily loaded workloads, the proposed scheduler also reduces request latency by up to 50% compared to the default Linux Completely Fair Scheduler (CFS). These results demonstrate that exposing CPU scheduling decisions to the serverless control plane can improve both energy efficiency and workload performance while preserving scheduling flexibility.

</details>


### [352] [RepoOMP: Repository-Aware Hotspot OpenMP Parallelization via Dependency-Aware Context Reduction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.05855)
*Yongjie Qian,Ke Gao,Zhibin Zhang,Shaohui Peng,Ling Li*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: RepoOMP是一个混合框架，通过构建多粒度属性性能图(MAP)和结构化变换上下文(STC)来恢复并行化相关证据，在规则工具和LLM代理之间路由热区，解决成熟代码库中OpenMP并行化因非局部证据而困难的问题。在951个热点上评估，372个被接受（含330个真实仓库热点），NPB和BOTS上分别获得8.23倍和8.96倍平均加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 成熟仓库中热点的OpenMP并行化仍然困难，因为循环安全性和优化收益往往依赖非局部证据。基于规则的工具在合法性无法局部证明时并行化不足，而基于代理的方法在检索遗漏关键依赖或包含无关代码时变得不稳定。

Method: RepoOMP包含三个核心组件：1) 构建多粒度属性性能图(MAP)，在生成前恢复与并行化相关的证据；2) 在确定性规则与LLM代理之间路由热点；3) 构建结构化变换上下文(STC)，暴露依赖事实同时避免用无关仓库文本淹没模型。

Result: 在NPB、BOTS、FFmpeg、NCNN和GROMACS的951个剖分热点上评估。在编译、负载特定检查和正加速的条件下，372个热点被接受，其中330个为真实仓库热点。NPB平均加速8.23倍，BOTS平均加速8.96倍。跨骨干平均5.25倍加速，相对Claude Code基线提升18-28%的加速比，降低47-68%的代理端token成本。330个被接受的真实仓库热点中位数加速为2.25倍。

Conclusion: RepoOMP提供了一个证据引导的热点并行化工作流，在仓库环境中显著优于传统规则工具和无结构的LLM代理基线，同时大幅降低token成本，并通过公开开源仓库促进可复现性。

Abstract: OpenMP parallelization of hotspots in mature repositories remains difficult because loop safety and optimization payoff often depend on non-local evidence. Rule-based tools under-parallelize when legality is not locally provable, while agent-based approaches become unstable when retrieval misses decisive dependencies or includes irrelevant code. We present RepoOMP, a hybrid framework that recovers parallelization-relevant evidence before generation. RepoOMP builds a Multi-granularity Attributes Performance graph (MAP), routes hotspots between deterministic rules and an LLM agent, and constructs a Structured Transformation Context (STC) that exposes dependency facts without flooding the model with unrelated repository text. We evaluate RepoOMP on 951 profiled hotspots from NPB, BOTS, FFmpeg, NCNN, and GROMACS. Under compilation, workload-specific checks, and positive speedup, 372 hotspots are accepted, including 330 real-world repository hotspots. RepoOMP achieves average speedups of $8.23\times$ on NPB and $8.96\times$ on BOTS. For the nine detailed real-world kernels used in matched-backbone and robustness analyses, RepoOMP reaches a cross-backbone mean of $5.25\times$, improves speedup by 18--28\%, and reduces agent-side token cost by 47--68\% relative to the unstructured Claude Code baseline. Across 330 accepted real-world hotspots, median speedup is $2.25\times$. Overall, RepoOMP provides an evidence-guided workflow for hotspot parallelization in repository settings. The open-source repository is available at https://github.com/Qlalq/RepoOMP_Simplified.

</details>


### [353] [Operating Multi-Node Full Fine-Tuning on NVIDIA B300: A Field Report on Telemetry-Based Triage, Negative Results, and Operational Hardening](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.05944)
*Seon Ho Kim,Ui Jeong Jeon,Su Hyeon Kim,Min Tae Hwang*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文报告了在16 x NVIDIA B300（两节点，FSDP/ZeRO-3）上全参微调Qwen3-32B（32.76B参数）的实战经验，不提出新算法，而是提供四项可复用的实践工具体：B300校准的功耗排查表、打破常见优化迷思的负面结果、4/8/16-GPU强扩展基准，以及一个epoch-end NCCL死锁的完整故障案例与其快速检测方案。核心经验是"看功耗而非利用率，启动前验证不变量"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: B300是新硬件，缺乏公开的实际全参微调运行记录；同时现有文献中关于大规模数据并行训练存在不少未经验证的优化直觉（folklore），且常见监控指标（如utilization%）在NCCL挂起时仍显示100%，具有误导性。作者希望通过公开实测数据和故障复盘，为后续从业者提供可依赖的参考基准与排查经验。

Method: 基于Qwen3-32B在16x B300上的全参数微调任务，采用FSDP/Zeo-3。方法上包含：基于板卡瓦数（wattage）构建区分计算/通信/数据饥饿/检查点或死锁/空闲的功率排查表；设计A/B对照实验（NFS逐轮读取 vs 预tokenize本地缓存）以检验存储瓶颈假设；测量4/8/16 GPU强扩展比例与GPU-hour绝对值；针对epoch-end NCCL死锁，实现一个2.7秒的预运行不变量门（invariant gate）加外部监控进程，将小时级静默失败转为即时拒绝。

Result: 四项主要结果：(1) B300功耗排查表可区分各类运行状态，且证实utilization%在NCCL挂起时仍为100%而功耗才是可靠信号；(2) A/B实验显示NFS逐轮读取与本地预tokenize缓存吞吐相当（约53k tok/s），因为语料落在page cache中且任务为计算瓶颈；此前"吞吐崩溃"实为NFS/CPU竞争而非存储介质极限；(3) B300上4/8/16 GPU强扩展近似线性，并给出绝对GPU-hour参考值；(4) 成功复现并定位epoch-end死锁源自各rank token打包不均，与PyTorch文档中的Join/equalize-to-minimum实践一致；该故障消耗了可观的GPU-hours，而所提出的gate与watcher可避免此类损失。

Conclusion: 本文的迁移价值是运维层面而非算法层面：对数据依赖型数据并行任务，应监控板卡功耗而非利用率；在启动前验证不变量——通过的冒烟测试不等于全量运行安全。作者将该死锁及其治理方案与PyTorch既有的Join/equalize-to-minimum实践进行对比定位，提供了在B300这一新硬件上的首个系统化实测参考。

Abstract: We report operational experience full-fine-tuning a 32.76B-parameter dense model (Qwen3-32B) on 16 x NVIDIA B300 (two nodes, FSDP / ZeRO-3) -- among the first published field accounts on this accelerator. We claim no new algorithm. The individual mechanisms we use are established practice; our contribution is the integrated field experience and a set of calibrated measurements on new hardware. Concretely we offer four practitioner artifacts. (1) A B300-calibrated power-draw triage table that distinguishes compute / communication / data-starvation / checkpoint-or-deadlock / idle by board wattage (utilization% reads 100% during an NCCL hang). (2) A set of honest negative results that dispel common optimization folklore at this scale: a controlled A/B in which per-step NFS reading matches a pretokenized local cache (~53k tok/s) because the corpus fits in page cache and the job is compute-bound; and a reconstruction of an earlier "throughput collapse" as NFS/CPU contention rather than a storage-medium limit. (3) Calibrated 4/8/16-GPU strong-scaling and GPU-hour numbers on B300 (near-linear, as expected in this regime; we report absolute values as reference data). (4) A worked failure case -- an epoch-end NCCL deadlock from per-rank token-packing imbalance -- together with a 2.7-second pre-run invariant gate and an external watcher that turn multi-hour silent failures into instant rejections. This deadlock and its remedy correspond to PyTorch's documented Join / equalize-to-minimum practice; we position our instantiation against that prior art and report the GPU-hours the failure cost and the gate saves. The transferable takeaway is operational, not algorithmic: for data-dependent data-parallel jobs, watch power rather than utilization, and verify invariants before launch -- a passing smoke test is not evidence of a safe full run.

</details>


### [354] [TensorCast: The Missing Tensor Management Layer in Large Language Model Infrastructure](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.06007)
*Yuhan Zhou,Yuchu Luo,Hao Nie,Wangrunze Lv,Yu Zhou,Yibo Zhu,Daxin Jiang,Chenren Xu*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出Tensor-as-a-Service (TaaS)抽象层及其实践TensorCast，将张量生命周期管理从计算逻辑中解耦，为LLM基础设施提供统一的分布式张量管理机制，支持模型权重加载、KV缓存管理和检查点同步等任务。与vLLM和SGLang集成后，在各类张量生命周期工作负载中达到与专用系统相当的性能，同时可编程策略在高并发多轮智能体工作负载下将中位TTFT提升高达93.2%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM基础设施将张量作为持久化状态在分布式组件间共享，但系统针对单个任务（如模型权重加载、KV缓存管理、检查点同步）进行深度专用化优化，形成孤立的技术栈，阻碍了张量管理策略在演变中的LLM工作负载中的复用与组合。作者识别到张量生命周期管理是LLM基础设施中缺失的抽象层。

Method: 提出TensorCast分布式张量管理层，提供三类核心能力：(1) 一等公民的张量抽象；(2) 可编程的生命周期原语；(3) 将张量管理策略与执行机制分离的运行时。开发者通过TensorCast API编写张量管理程序，透明地利用分布式执行和数据移动。系统集成到vLLM和SGLang中。

Result: 在与vLLM和SGLang的集成评测中，TensorCast在模型权重物化、权重同步、KV缓存管理和可编程请求路由等多样化张量生命周期工作负载下达到与专用张量管理系统相当的性能；基于TensorCast实现的可编程策略在高并发多轮智能体工作负载下将中位TTFT提升高达93.2%。

Conclusion: 张量生命周期管理是一个值得独立抽象的层面，TensorCast证明了通过将张量状态管理与计算逻辑解耦、分离策略与机制，可以在不牺牲性能的前提下实现跨组件的优化策略组合，为LLM基础设施提供更灵活、可复用的张量管理方案。

Abstract: Modern LLM infrastructure increasingly manages tensors not only as computation data, but also as persistent states shared across distributed components. Existing systems optimize individual tensor management tasks, such as model weight loading, KV cache management, and checkpoint synchronization, by deeply integrating task-specific mechanisms with execution engines, networks, or storage backends. However, this specialization creates isolated silos that hinder the reuse and composition of tensor management strategies across evolving LLM workloads. In this paper, we identify tensor lifecycle management as a missing abstraction layer in LLM infrastructure and propose Tensor-as-a-Service (TaaS), which decouples tensor state management from computation logic. We design and build TensorCast, a distributed tensor management layer that provides first-class tensor abstractions, programmable lifecycle primitives, and a runtime that separates tensor management policies from execution mechanisms. This enables developers to write tensor management programs using TensorCast APIs while transparently leveraging distributed execution and data movement. We integrate TensorCast with vLLM and SGLang and evaluate it across diverse tensor lifecycle workloads, including model weight materialization, weight synchronization, KV cache management, and programmable request routing. Our results show that TensorCast achieves competitive performance with specialized tensor management systems while enabling new cross-component optimization policies. A programmable policy implemented with TensorCast improves median TTFT by up to 93.2% under highly concurrent multi-turn agent workloads.

</details>


### [355] [Routing LLM Inference to the Cleanest Grid in Real Time](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.06188)
*Aleks Bernhard,Arif Baran Yardimci*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文在跨区域的GPU测试台上进行了碳排放感知的LLM推理路由实时验证，使用边际运行排放率（MOER）信号作为生产压力路由器的可逆叠加层，并提出基于GPU遥测的每请求能耗归因方法。在一年的回溯模拟中，碳感知放置相比轮询可将GPU可归属的运行排放减少50.9%（95%CI 48.5-53.3%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM推理是快速增长的电负荷，其边际碳强度在不同电网区域和一天中不同时段可相差一个数量级以上。请求放置不需要重新训练或更换硬件，因此是降低推理碳排放极具吸引力的杠杆。然而以往工作缺乏严格的生产环境盲基线验证、准确的能源归因和基于历史排放的结算。

Method: 在跨区域GPU测试台上进行实时碳感知推理路由验证，使用MOER信号作为调度依据。具体三点特性：(1) 盲基线采用实际生产环境的基于压力的路由器而非均匀放置；(2) 通过NVIDIA DCGM GPU遥测和实测并发曲线（而非额定TDP）归因每请求能耗；(3) 每个请求的碳结算基于历史MOER而非驱动决策的预测值。此外，利用一年的每小时MOER数据在跨区域CONUS机群上回放模拟。

Result: 实时验证表明MOER信号可跨区域引导推理而无调度失败，作为生产路由器的严格可逆叠加层。在回放模拟中，碳感知放置相比轮询减少50.9%模型化GPU可归属运行排放（95% CI 48.5-53.3%）。在会话锁定前，逐小时最低MOER路由相比静态年度平均MOER策略额外贡献约22.4个百分点（约占54.0%放置削减的40%）。实际观察：比较区域时应按绝对MOER排序而非百分位信号指数。

Conclusion: 碳感知推理路由在生产环境中可行且有效，可作为现有压力路由器的严格叠加层部署。但由于回放使用历史MOER而非预测值，50.9%的减排是给定配置下的上界；实际运维中预测误差会降低可实现的节省。结果针对单一机群和特定历史年份，不应视为普适估计。

Abstract: Large-language-model inference is a fast-growing electricity load whose marginal carbon intensity varies by more than an order of magnitude across grid regions and across the day, making request placement an attractive lever: no retraining, no hardware change. We report a live validation of carbon-aware inference routing on multi-region GPU testbeds driven by marginal operating emissions rate (MOER) signals, with three properties uncommon in prior work: a blind baseline that is an actual production pressure-based router rather than uniform placement; per-request energy attributed from GPU telemetry (NVIDIA DCGM) via measured concurrency curves rather than nameplate TDP; and carbon settlement of every request against historical MOER, not only the forecast that drove the decision. The central live result is feasibility: a MOER signal steered inference across regions with no observed dispatch failures, as a strict and reversible overlay on the production router. To size the effect, we replay a year of hourly MOER across a grid-diverse CONUS fleet. In the primary modeled configuration, carbon-aware placement reduces modeled GPU-attributable operational emissions by 50.9% versus round-robin (95% block-bootstrap CI 48.5-53.3%). Because the replay dispatches against historical MOER rather than a forecast, this is an upper bound under that configuration; forecast error would reduce operationally realized savings. Before session pinning, hourly lowest-MOER routing contributes about 22.4 percentage points, roughly 40% of the 54.0% placement reduction, beyond a static annual-mean-MOER policy. These are modeled results for one fleet and historical year, not a universal estimate. We also record a practical observation: when comparing regions, rank by absolute MOER rather than the percentile signal-index, which is normalized within each region and answers a temporal, not a spatial, question.

</details>

### [356] [IL-10 rs1800896 polymorphism predicts biochemical remission in IBD patients undergoing biologic therapy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.05345)
*Michela Helga Falzone,Davide Giuseppe Ribaldone,Martina Buglione,Irene Cottone,Marta Vernero,Demis Pitoni,Angelo Armandi,Francesca Saba,Eleonora Dileo,Alfredo Santovito,Gian Paolo Caviglia*

Main category: q-bio.QM

TL;DR: 本研究调查了197名IBD患者（142名克罗恩病，55名溃疡性结肠炎）中4个细胞因子基因SNP（TNF-alpha rs1800629、TGF-beta rs1800471、IL-6 rs1800795、IL-10 rs1800896）与临床表型及靶向治疗反应的关系。结果显示IL-6 rs1800795 C等位基因与更年轻的诊断年龄相关，TNF-alpha rs1800629 A等位基因在CD患者中更常见，IL-10 rs1800896变异等位基因在12个月时与生化缓解显著相关（校正OR 4.15）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 遗传因素（包括SNP）可能调节炎症性肠病（IBD）的疾病进程和治疗效果，作者旨在探索细胞因子基因SNP与IBD临床表型及分子靶向药物应答之间的关联，为个体化治疗提供依据。

Method: 纳入197名接受靶向治疗的IBD患者，分析4个SNP位点；12个月时以CRP<5.0 mg/L和粪便钙卫蛋白<250微克/g且无激素治疗定义为生化缓解；采用单因素和多因素逻辑回归分析评估SNP与表型及治疗反应的关系。

Result: IL-6 rs1800795 C等位基因与更年轻诊断年龄显著相关（p=0.049）；TNF-alpha rs1800629 A等位基因在CD中较UC更常见（p=0.036）；134名符合方案分析患者中41.0%在T12达到生化缓解；IL-10 rs1800896变异等位基因与缓解相关（OR 2.15），在校正分析后仍显著（aOR 4.15, p=0.007）。

Conclusion: 细胞因子相关SNP的基因分型有助于识别具有不同疾病表型的IBD患者，并支持个体化治疗策略的制定。

Abstract: Background. Genetic factors, including single-nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs), may modulate disease course and therapeutic efficacy in patients with inflammatory bowel disease (IBD). Aim. We investigated the association between four SNPs in cytokine genes and clinical phenotype as well as the response to molecular-targeted drugs in patients with IBD. Materials and Methods. A total of 197 IBD patients (142 Crohn's disease [CD], 55 ulcerative colitis [UC]) undergoing targeted treatment were enrolled. The SNPs analyzed were TNF-alpha rs1800629 (-308 G>A), TGF-beta rs1800471 (codon 10 C>T), IL-6 rs1800795 (-174 G>C), and IL-10 rs1800896 (-1082 G>A). Biochemical response at 12 months (T12) was defined as CRP <5.0 mg/L and fecal calprotectin <250 microg/g at T12, in the absence of ongoing corticosteroid therapy. Results. The IL-6 rs1800795 C allele was significantly associated with a younger age at diagnosis (p=0.049), while the TNF-alpha rs1800629 A allele was more frequently observed in patients with CD than UC (p=0.036). Among 134 patients included in the per-protocol analysis, 41.0% achieved biochemical remission at T12. The IL-10 rs1800896 variant allele was associated with remission (OR 2.15, 95% CI 1.03-4.44; p=0.041), and the association remained significant in multivariable analysis (adjusted OR 4.15, 95% CI 1.49-11.56; p=0.007). Conclusions. Genotyping of cytokine-related SNPs may help identify patients with distinct disease phenotypes and support personalized treatment strategies in IBD.

</details>


### [357] [A Low-Power Wearable Respiratory Sensor for Non-Invasive Stress Monitoring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.05697)
*Mohammad Hosseini,Hamed Khatounabadi,Mohammad Fakharzadeh*

Main category: q-bio.QM

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于力敏电阻（FSR）嵌入腹带的紧凑型非侵入式呼吸传感系统，集成了自定义蓝牙低功耗采集板，无需模拟放大即可通过机械支架将腹部扩张传递至传感器。系统在静态和轻度运动场景下均能捕获稳定的呼吸信号，并通过五阶段应激诱导协议在12名参与者上进行验证，最佳模型达到88.0%的测试准确率，能够区分放松与应激诱导阶段，展示其在情感计算和日常呼吸监测中的潜力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在非受控环境下监测呼吸面临挑战：可穿戴系统需要在保持舒适、低功耗和对姿态及运动变化鲁棒的同时，捕获微小的身体形变。现有系统难以同时满足这些要求，因此需要一个紧凑、非侵入且在实际日常场景中可靠的呼吸感测方案。

Method: 设计了一个基于力敏电阻（FSR）嵌入腹带的呼吸传感系统，配备定制蓝牙低功耗采集板。系统采用简单的压阻式读数电路，并结合机械支架将腹部扩张高效传递至传感器而无需模拟放大。评估覆盖多种呼吸模式和身体姿势；设计了五阶段应激诱导协议，从12名参与者收集呼吸记录，并提取可解释的时域特征，使用标准分类器区分放松与应激诱导阶段。

Result: 静态设置下信号在呼吸动作中呈现一致的幅值变化和重复的峰-峰时序；轻度运动下尽管存在运动引起的基线漂移，信号变化仍然可见。最佳分类模型在区分放松与应激诱导阶段时达到88.0%的测试准确率。

Conclusion: 该平台能够实现跨多种日常生活场景的实时呼吸监测，捕获的呼吸特征可区分应激诱导与放松阶段，展示了其在情感计算应用中的潜力。

Abstract: Respiration provides a continuously available window into physiological state and behavior. However, monitoring it outside controlled settings remains challenging because a wearable system must capture small body deformations while remaining comfortable, low power, and robust to changes in posture and motion. We present a compact non-invasive respiratory sensing system based on a force-sensitive resistor (FSR) embedded in an abdominal belt and integrated with a custom Bluetooth Low Energy acquisition board. The system combines a simple piezoresistive readout with a mechanical holder designed to transfer abdominal expansion to the sensor without analog amplification. We evaluate the complete sensing pipeline across multiple breathing patterns and body positions. In stationary settings, the recorded signals exhibit consistent amplitude changes and recurring peak-to-peak timing across breathing maneuvers; under light movement, these variations remain visible despite motion-induced baseline shifts. We further design a five-phase stress-induction protocol and collect respiratory recordings from 12 participants. Using interpretable time-domain features and standard classifiers, we examine whether the acquired signals distinguish relaxation from stress-induction phases. In this preliminary experiment, the best-performing model achieves 88.0% test accuracy, indicating that the extracted respiratory features distinguish stress-induced phases from relaxation phases in this dataset. Overall, our results show that the proposed platform enables real-time respiratory monitoring across diverse daily-life scenarios and captures respiratory changes that distinguish stress-induction from relaxation phases, supporting its potential for affective-computing applications.

</details>


### [358] [Curriculum Multiple Shooting for Robust Training of Neural and Universal Differential Equations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.05777)
*Sebastian Persson,Giacomo Fabrini,Branwen Snelling,Fabian Fröhlich*

Main category: q-bio.QM

TL;DR: 本文提出课程多重打靶（CMS）训练策略，将课程学习与多重打靶方法相结合，用于拟合神经ODE、通用微分方程（UDE）和机械ODE模型到时间序列数据。在十二个模拟和真实数据基准上，CMS加速并稳定了训练收敛，优于现有最先进的训练策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经ODE和通用微分方程为从噪声时间序列数据学习可解释动力学系统提供了灵活框架，但训练这些模型仍具挑战性，缺乏能够稳健处理稀疏数据、噪声数据和部分观测模型的通用方法。

Method: 提出课程多重打靶（CMS），将课程学习（curriculum learning）与多重打靶（multiple shooting）方法整合为一种通用的ODE时间序列拟合训练策略，通过分阶段由易到难地处理时间序列分段，提升训练的稳定性和收敛性。

Result: 在涵盖NODE、UDE和机械ODE的十二个模拟及真实数据基准上，CMS加速并稳定了训练收敛，优于最先进训练策略，且在泛化性能上位列最佳方法之列。

Conclusion: CMS是一种通用且鲁棒的ODE训练策略，其优异表现可从当代关于时间序列训练挑战的理论视角得到解释，为该领域提供了新的高效训练范式。

Abstract: Neural ordinary differential equations (NODEs) and universal differential equations (UDEs) provide flexible and popular frameworks for learning interpretable dynamical systems from noisy time-series data. However, training these models remains challenging, and versatile methods that robustly handle sparse and noisy data as well as partially observed models are lacking. To address this, we introduce curriculum multiple shooting (CMS), a general-purpose training strategy for fitting ordinary differential equation (ODE) models to time-series data by integrating curriculum learning with multiple shooting. Across twelve benchmarks spanning simulated and real data, and covering NODEs, UDEs, and mechanistic ODEs, CMS accelerates and stabilises training convergence, outperforms state-of-the-art training strategies, and ranks among the best methods in generalisation. Finally, we discuss possible explanations for the strong performance of CMS in light of contemporary theories of what makes training on time-series challenging.

</details>
