Model interpretation further produced biologically meaningful findings in both applications. These results show that domain-specialized language models can organize heterogeneous biochemical knowledge into predictive and interpretable metabolite graph representations.

</details>


### [425] [RxnCLF: Contrastive Transformation-Aware Reaction Foundation Model for Improved Reactivity Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.06259)
*Yiting Zheng,Cheng Fang,Anthony Donofrio,Haote Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出RxnCLF，一种基于反应对比学习的自监督框架，通过构建冷凝反应图（CRG）统一反应物与产物信息，在170万条Pistachio反应上预训练，学习紧凑且连续的潜在空间以捕捉反应中心特征和侧链上下文，从而在多个反应产率预测基准上超越现有图与序列基准方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 反应产率预测面临标注数据稀缺且反应空间组合巨大而稀疏的挑战，现有的字符串、指纹和图反应编码方式只能部分捕捉化学转化信息，对于复杂底物反应难以准确预测，亟需一种能够显式学习反应转化结构的自监督表示学习方法。

Method: RxnCLF采用自监督对比学习框架，基于冷凝反应图（CRG）将反应物与产物信息统一为单一图结构，使模型学习显式且丰富的转化结构而非不连通的图。模型在170万条Pistachio反应数据上进行预训练，学习包含反应中心特征和侧链上下文的紧凑连续潜在空间。

Result: 在多个产率预测基准（包括Buchwald-Hartwig反应、Pd催化的BH偶联反应、专有HTE C-N偶联和酰胺形成数据集）上微调后，RxnCLF一致优于图和序列基准方法，提升了R2指标并取得最佳性能。

Conclusion: CRG-based RxnCLF展现作为可扩展反应基础模型的潜力，能够泛化到更广的反应空间，并支持区域选择性预测、对映选择性预测和反应条件优化等多种下游反应信息学任务。

Abstract: Reaction yield prediction remains challenging because labeled data are scarce and reaction space is both combinatorially large and sparsely populated, limiting the generalization of existing reaction representations. String-, fingerprint-, and graph-based reaction encodings only partially capture chemical transformations, making accurate prediction difficult for reactions with complex substrates. We propose reaction contrastive learning foundation (RxnCLF), a self-supervised contrastive framework for reaction representation learning. RxnCLF is built on a condensed reaction graph (CRG) that unifies reactant and product information into a single graph, enabling the model to learn explicit and enriched transformation structure rather than disconnected graphs. Pretrained on 1.7 million Pistachio reactions, RxnCLF learns a compact and continuous latent space that captures both reaction-center features and broader side chain contexts, making it transformation-aware and chemically interpretable. Fine-tuned on multiple yield prediction benchmarks, including Buchwald-Hartwig, Pd-catalyzed BH coupling, and proprietary HTE C-N coupling and amide formation datasets, RxnCLF consistently outperforms graph and sequence-based baselines, improving R2 and achieving the best performance overall. Our results highlight the promise of CRG-based RxnCLF as a scalable reaction foundation model, with the potential to generalize across broader reaction spaces and support diverse downstream reaction informatics tasks, including regioselectivity prediction, enantioselectivity prediction, and reaction condition optimization.

</details>


### [426] [Hypothesis Testing with Conditional Queries: Learnability and the Value of Interaction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.06262)
*Zonghuan Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究模型评估中自适应测试与非自适应测试之间的查询复杂度差异。在有限结果空间上，证明了可学习性成立当且仅当两类分布间的成对条件概率具有正分离度；当分离度为零时，任何有限查询预算下最坏情况误差恰好为1/2。对于任意T查询自适应策略，构造了使用O(N²(T+log(1/ρ)))个预选配对查询的随机非自适应过程，其模拟转录与自适应转录的总体变差距离在ρ以内。同时构造了自适应查询复杂度为常数但非自适应查询复杂度为Ω_ε(N²)的匹配族，证明最坏情况固定误差自适应差距为Θ_ε(N²)。这表明交互作用可将所需测试数量减少二次因子，但交互式评估的表观指数分支并不会带来指数级查询优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模型评估中一个关键设计问题是：测试选择是固定的（非自适应）还是可以根据先前响应动态调整（自适应）。理解这两种策略之间的性能差距对于模型评估实践和理论理解都至关重要。现有研究缺乏对自适应与非自适应测试查询复杂度之间精确关系的刻画，特别是在有限结果空间下的可学习性边界和查询复杂度差距。

Method: 本文在条件查询模型下，对有限结果空间中的分布类别区分问题进行了系统研究。通过定义成对条件概率分离度来刻画可学习性条件；利用随机化非自适应构造（使用O(N²(T+log(1/ρ)))个预选配对查询）模拟自适应策略的转录过程，并通过总变差距离进行度量；同时构造下界族来确立自适应与非自适应查询复杂度的精确差距。

Result: 研究表明：两类分布可被可靠区分当且仅当其成对条件概率具有正分离度；零分离度时最优最坏情况误差恰为1/2。自适应与非自适应之间的最坏情况固定误差差距为Θ_ε(N²)，即交互可将查询数量减少二次因子，但不会产生指数级优势。

Conclusion: 交互式评估虽然能利用早期响应动态选择后续测试，从而将所需查询数量减少二次因子，但自适应测试的表观指数分支结构并不转化为指数级查询优势。这一结果为模型评估中测试选择策略的设计提供了理论指导，明确了自适应策略的实际收益边界。

Abstract: Model evaluations may fix all tests before observing any responses or select later tests using earlier responses. We study this choice in a conditional-query model on a finite outcome space $\mathcal{X}$ with $|\mathcal{X}|=N$. We first ask which pairs of distribution classes can be reliably distinguished. We then ask how many additional queries are required to match an adaptive tester when all queried events must be fixed in advance. We show that learnability holds if and only if the two classes have positive separation in their pairwise conditional probabilities. When this separation is zero, the optimal worst-case error is exactly $1/2$ at every finite query budget. For any $T$-query adaptive policy and any $ρ\in (0,1)$, we construct a randomized non-adaptive procedure using $O(N^2(T + \log(1/ρ)))$ pair queries chosen before any response is observed. Its simulated transcript is within $ρ$ in total variation of the adaptive transcript, uniformly over all distributions in the model. We also construct a matching family with constant adaptive query complexity and $Ω_\varepsilon(N^2)$ non-adaptive query complexity. Consequently, the worst-case fixed-error adaptivity gap is $Θ_\varepsilon(N^2)$. Thus interaction can reduce the required number of tests by a quadratic factor, but the apparent exponential branching of an interactive evaluation does not yield an exponential query advantage.

</details>


### [427] [The Tamed Subgradient Unadjusted Langevin Algorithm beyond Convexity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.06283)
*Iosif Lytras,Nikolaos Makras,Sotirios Sabanis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出SG-TULA（次梯度驯化非调整Langevin算法），用于处理势函数同时非光滑、超线性梯度增长且非凸的目标分布采样问题。算法直接作用于次梯度，无需计算昂贵的平滑过程，并采用驯化技术获得稳定的显式格式。作者推导了Wasserstein-2距离下的非渐近收敛界，所有常数均显式关联维度和逆温度，优于现有次梯度Langevin算法的已知速率，并提供了相应优化问题的超额风险估计。最后在GPT-2系列LLM的正则化预训练势上验证了假设和算法性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实中的许多采样问题（如大规模语言模型的正则化预训练）涉及的目标分布势函数同时具有非光滑性、超线性梯度增长和非凸性，这三者叠加使得现有的Langevin算法难以高效收敛。已有的次梯度Langevin算法要么依赖昂贵的平滑预处理，要么在超线性梯度区域不稳定，且收敛速率不够理想。作者希望设计一种直接在次梯度上操作的显式稳定算法，并在理论上给出更好的非渐近收敛保证，同时在实际LLM预训练任务中验证其有效性。

Method: 提出SG-TULA算法，其核心思路包括：（1）直接用次梯度而非平滑后的梯度操作Langevin扩散的离散化，避免计算昂贵的平滑程序；（2）采用驯化（taming）技术处理超线性梯度增长导致的数值不稳定问题，构造稳定的显式格式；（3）理论分析方面，在Wasserstein-2距离下推导非渐近收敛界，所有常数显式跟踪为维度和逆温度的函数；同时给出优化问题的超额风险估计；（4）在验证层面，为GPT-2系列LLM的正则化预训练势函数验证假设并显式计算常数，还提出一个增强的坐标式变体（boosted coordinate-wise variant）用于预训练，与微调后的AdamW和Muon进行竞争性比较。

Result: 理论结果为：SG-TULA在Wasserstein-2距离下的非渐近收敛界优于现有次梯度Langevin算法的已知速率，且常数均以维度和逆温度显式表示；相应的优化问题获得了超额风险估计。实验结果为：增强的坐标式SG-TULA变体在GPT-2系列LLM预训练中表现与微调后的AdamW和Muon相当甚至更具竞争力，而后者目前没有可比较的非渐近理论保证。

Conclusion: SG-TULA为同时具有非光滑、超线性梯度增长和非凸性质的势函数提供了一种理论上有保证、实际中高效的Langevin采样方案。该算法不仅改进了次梯度Langevin算法的收敛速率，还在实际LLM预训练中展示了竞争力的性能，表明其在实际大规模机器学习优化任务中具有实用价值，弥补了目前流行优化器（如AdamW、Muon）缺乏非渐近理论保证的不足。

Abstract: We study the problem of sampling from target distributions whose potentials are simultaneously non-smooth, subject to superlinear gradient growth, and non-convex. We introduce the Subgradient Tamed Unadjusted Langevin Algorithm (SG-TULA), a discretisation of the Langevin diffusion that operates directly on subgradients, without relying on computationally demanding smoothing procedures. To handle the superlinear regime, taming techniques are employed to produce a stable, explicit scheme. We derive non-asymptotic convergence bounds in Wasserstein-2 distance, with all constants tracked explicitly in terms of dimension and inverse temperature, improving upon the currently known rates for subgradient-based Langevin algorithms. We further provide excess risk estimates for the associated optimisation problem. We verify the assumptions, with explicit constants, for the regularized pretraining potential of a LLM in the GPT-2 lineage and the boosted coordinate-wise variant of SG-TULA pretrains the former competitively against finetuned AdamW and Muon, for which no comparable non-asymptotic guarantees are presently available.

</details>


### [428] [Surv-IPTB: An Attention-Based Model for Estimating Individual Probability of Treatment Benefit with Survival Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.06288)
*Lev V. Utkin,Stanislav K. Kogan,Andrei V. Konstantinov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Surv-IPTB，一个基于注意力机制的新框架，用于在生存分析中估计个体治疗获益概率（IPTB）。该方法将IPTB估计重构为二分类问题，通过患者间成对比较实现，并利用不精确概率表示来处理右删失观测。实验表明该模型在多种非线性合成数据集上优于元学习基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在生存分析中，准确估计个体患者接受治疗相较于对照组的生存获益概率是精准医疗的关键需求，但现有的元学习基线方法（如T-learner、S-learner）在非线性场景下表现不佳，特别是在处理右删失数据时缺乏原则性的处理方式。

Method: Surv-IPTB框架包含以下核心组件：(1) 将IPTB估计重构为二分类问题，利用治疗组与对照组的患者成对比较；(2) 通过不精确概率表示（区间值概率）原则性处理右删失观测；(3) 采用具有可学习查询-键变换的注意力机制，实现灵活的、数据驱动的成对比较聚合，同时为删失样本学习软类别概率。

Result: 在具有复杂非线性结构的合成数据集（螺旋形、钟形、圆形特征空间）上，Surv-IPTB在不同删失率和治疗效果强度下均保持了稳健性能，持续优于配备随机生存森林、Cox比例风险模型和Beran估计器的元学习基线方法，尤其在传统方法显著退化的非线性场景中优势明显。

Conclusion: 所提出的基于注意力的框架是生存环境中个性化治疗获益评估的可扩展且统计上原则性的解决方案，代码已公开。

Abstract: This work presents a novel attention-based framework for estimating the Individual Probability of Treatment Benefit (IPTB) in survival analysis contexts. The proposed model, called Surv-IPTB, directly quantifies the probability that a specific patient will experience extended survival time under treatment versus control. We reformulate IPTB estimation as a binary classification problem, leveraging pairwise patient comparisons across treatment and control cohorts. The framework incorporates a principled handling of right-censored observations through imprecise probability representations, where uncertain treatment effects are characterized by interval-valued probabilities. An attention mechanism with learnable query-key transformations enables flexible, data-driven aggregation of pairwise comparisons, while simultaneously learning soft class probabilities for censored cases. Through extensive experiments on synthetic datasets with complex nonlinear structures, including spiral, bell-shaped, and circular feature spaces, we demonstrate that our approach maintains robust performance across varying censoring rates and treatment effect strengths. The model consistently outperforms meta-learner baselines (T-learner and S-learner) equipped with random survival forests, Cox proportional hazards, and Beran estimators, particularly in challenging nonlinear scenarios where conventional methods exhibit significant degradation. The results establish the proposed attention-based framework as a scalable and statistically principled solution for personalized treatment benefit assessment in survival settings. The code implementing the model is publicly available.

</details>


### [429] [BaKron: Efficient Quantization with Kronecker-Factored Hessians](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.06291)
*Johann Birnick,Rayan Saab*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了BaKron，一种高效的神经网络量化求解器，通过结合反对角线并行与递归分治构造，加速基于Kronecker分解Hessian近似信息的双边自适应舍入算法，将计算复杂度从O(m²n²)降至O(mn(m+n))，并匹配GPTQ的三次方缩放。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GPTQ式自适应舍入通常仅利用输入激活的单边信息，而双边Kronecker分解Hessian近似能捕捉输出坐标间的相关性，但在向量化权重域直接应用GPTQ计算开销极大，亟需高效求解器。

Method: BaKron结合了反对角线并行与递归分治构造策略，基于BoA和YAQA的双边自适应舍入公式，对于m×n权重矩阵仅需O(m+n)顺序步骤，将总工作量从O(m²n²)降至O(mn(m+n))，同时支持模块化替换基础量化器和Hessian估计器。

Result: BaKron在保持与GPTQ相同的三次方计算规模的同时利用了更丰富的曲率信息，并在多种Hessian变体上进行了实际基准测试，找到了高效计算Hessian的技术，并进行了实验评估。

Conclusion: BaKron成功将双边Kronecker分解Hessian信息用于自适应舍入的代价降低至与GPTQ相当的水平，为神经网络量化提供了一种兼顾曲率丰富性与计算效率的求解方案。

Abstract: We accelerate a family of algorithms for neural network quantization whose geometry is informed by any Kronecker-factored approximation of the Hessian. GPTQ-style adaptive rounding typically uses one-sided information derived from input activations. Two-sided Kronecker-factored Hessian approximations can additionally capture correlations across output coordinates, but applying GPTQ directly in the vectorized weight domain is computationally expensive. Building on the two-sided adaptive-rounding formulation used by BoA and YAQA, we introduce BaKron, an efficient solver that combines anti-diagonal parallelism with a recursive divide-and-conquer construction. For an $m\times n$ weight matrix, BaKron uses $O(m+n)$ sequential steps while reducing the total work from $O(m^2n^2)$ to $O(mn(m+n))$. Thus, it matches the cubic scaling of GPTQ while exploiting richer curvature information. Moreover, BaKron is modular with respect to both the base quantizer and the Hessian estimator. We also provide practical benchmarks, consider a range of Hessians that BaKron can be called with, find an efficient technique to compute these Hessians, and evaluate the algorithm experimentally.

</details>


### [430] [On-Policy Self-Distillation without Any Supervision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.06296)
*Yijiang Li,Bingyang Wang,Yijun Liang,Yunjie Tian,Di Fu,Nuno Vasconcelos*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出U-OPSD（无监督在线策略自蒸馏），仅利用模型自身生成结果通过内部一致性实现真正的自蒸馏，无需外部监督信号。该方法通过多数投票构建伪解，并基于最短伪解蒸馏到模型最长错误补全的前缀上，实现精准自我纠错。在多个基准和训练设置下，U-OPSD一致优于基础模型，并在多数场景下匹配或超越使用真值标签的监督方法（如OPSD和GRPO）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有在线策略（自）蒸馏方法（OPD/OPSD）虽在LLM后训练中展现出潜力，但严重依赖外部监督信号——包括真值标签、环境反馈或更大模型的指导——因此无法实现真正的"自"蒸馏。作者旨在探索仅依靠模型自身生成和内部一致性即可完成自蒸馏的可能性，消除对外部监督的依赖。

Method: U-OPSD包含两个核心步骤：(1) 对同一问题采样多条rollout，在自一致性阈值下通过多数投票构建伪解（pseudo-solution）；(2) 将教师分布条件化到最短伪解上，蒸馏到模型最长错误补全（longest incorrect completion）的前缀中，使模型在"自信但错误"的位置进行精准自我纠错。整个过程无需真值标签、环境反馈或外部模型指导。

Result: 在AIME24、AIME25、HMMT25、MATH500和AMC23等基准上：在Qwen3非思考模式下，U-OPSD相比基础模型在4B和8B规模分别提升8.5%和10.7%，并平均超越OPSD 3.2%和2.3%；在思考模式下，U-OPSD与OPSD持平（4B规模超越0.9%，8B规模持平），且分别超越GRPO 0.7%和1.1%。

Conclusion: U-OPSD证明了仅依赖模型自身生成和内部一致性即可实现有效的在线策略自蒸馏，完全去除外部监督依赖，且性能一致优于基础模型，在多数情况下匹配甚至超越依赖真值标签的监督方法。这表明"真正的自蒸馏"在LLM后训练中是可行的，且具有更广泛的适用性。

Abstract: On-policy (Self-)Distillation (OPD / OPSD) has shown strong potential for post-training large language models (LLMs). However, existing methods still rely heavily on external supervision, including ground-truth signals, environmental feedback, or guidance from larger models, and therefore fall short of genuine "self"-distillation. In this study, we show that on-policy self-distillation can be achieved using only a model's own generations via internal consistency. We propose Unsupervised On-Policy Self-Distillation (U-OPSD). U-OPSD first samples multiple rollouts and constructs a pseudo-solution by majority vote under a self-consistency threshold. It then conditions a teacher distribution on the shortest pseudo-solution and distills it into prefixes of the model's longest incorrect completion, allowing the model to correct itself precisely where it is confidently wrong. Across diverse benchmarks, base models, and training settings, U-OPSD consistently improves over the base models and matches or surpasses supervised methods with ground truth (GT), such as OPSD and GRPO. On AIME24, AIME25, HMMT25, MATH500, and AMC23, U-OPSD improves over the base model by 8.5% and 10.7% on Qwen3 non-thinking mode at the 4B and 8B scales, respectively, and outperforms OPSD by an average of 3.2% and 2.3%. In thinking mode, U-OPSD remains on par with OPSD, outperforming it by 0.9% at 4B and matching it at 8B, while surpassing GRPO by 0.7% and 1.1%, respectively.

</details>


### [431] [RRC: Unlocking Generative Reward Models in LLM Reinforcement Learning via Ranking-Based Reward Construction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.06310)
*Chenglong Wang,Ziming Zhu,Yifu Huo,Bei Li,Qiaozhi He,Yan Ding,Xiaoyang Hao,Yuxin Gao,Tianhua Zhou,Xiaojia Chang,Tongran Liu,Jingbo Zhu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出基于排序的奖励构建（RRC）方法，弥合生成式奖励模型与现有RL算法标量奖励范式之间的不匹配，通过自我竞争排序和锚点引导排序两种策略，从相对偏好排序中推导有效奖励信号，实验证明在开放对话和推理基准上显著提升RL训练效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式奖励模型在响应排序上表现强大，但在强化学习（RL）中未能发挥其潜力。分析表明这是因为生成式奖励建模的比较性本质与现有RL算法采用的标量评分范式之间存在不匹配，需要一种方法将生成式奖励模型的比较能力转化为有效的RL学习信号。

Method: 提出Ranking-based Reward Construction（RRC）方法，包含两种互补策略：(1) 自我竞争排序（self-competitive ranking）：利用采样响应之间的相互比较来构建奖励；(2) 锚点引导排序（anchor-guided ranking）：使用少量参考响应实现可扩展的基于排序的奖励构建。

Result: 在开放对话和推理基准上的实验表明，RRC方法显著改善了生成式奖励模型的RL训练效果，相比现有奖励构建方法取得了一致的性能提升。

Conclusion: RRC通过从相对偏好排序中推导奖励，成功实现了生成式奖励模型在RL中的潜力，验证了基于排序的奖励构建范式是弥合生成式奖励模型与RL之间差距的有效途径。

Abstract: Recent advances in reward modeling show a paradigm shift from discriminative reward models to generative reward models. However, despite their strong capabilities in response ranking, generative reward models have not realized their potential in reinforcement learning (RL). Our analysis reveals that this limitation arises from a mismatch between the comparative nature of generative reward modeling and the scalar scoring paradigm adopted by existing RL algorithms. To bridge this gap, we propose a Ranking-based Reward Construction (RRC) approach, which enables generative reward models to provide more effective RL learning signals by deriving rewards from relative preference rankings. RRC introduces two complementary strategies: self-competitive ranking, which exploits comparisons among sampled responses, and anchor-guided ranking, which enables scalable ranking-based reward construction with a small set of reference responses. Experiments across open-ended chat and reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that RRC substantially improves RL training with generative reward models, achieving consistent gains over existing reward construction approaches. Our code can be found at https://github.com/wangclnlp/RRC.

</details>


### [432] [CalibForge: Adversarial Solver Calibration for Scaling Learnable Terminal Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.06352)
*Fanzhe Meng,Guoxin Chen,Jiale Zhao,Shuang Sun,Zhiyu Lin,Wayne Xin Zhao,Ruihua Song,Ji-Rong Wen,Kai Jia*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出CalibForge，一个自主的终端任务合成系统，通过对抗性求解器校准（多求解器校准和对比求解器校准）来修订候选任务，使其从"可执行"升级为"对指定求解器适当具有挑战性"的校准任务。系统构建了5,431个校准终端任务，在Terminal-Bench 2.0上达到32.58%和47.57%的成绩，相比基准模型最大提升24.71到30.04个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 训练终端智能体需要既可执行、又可验证的任务，但仅满足可执行性验证并不能揭示任务相对于给定求解器设置的行为表现。换句话说，任务不能只是"可解"，还需要对学习过程"适当具有挑战性"。现有方法缺乏将任务难度与求解器能力对齐的机制，因此需要一种能基于求解器实际行为来校准任务难度的方法。

Method: CalibForge采用两种对抗性求解器校准策略：(1) 多求解器校准——利用异构求解器池中的分歧来定位学习区域；(2) 对比求解器校准——针对"强求解器通过、弱求解器失败"这一指定的对比关系进行优化。两种策略都基于已证明的可解性（demonstrated solvability）来锚定一个求解器相对的"可学习区间"（learnable zone），并通过迭代修订候选任务来实现校准。

Result: CalibForge构建了5,431个校准终端任务。消融实验表明两种校准策略比仅靠作者编写和验证、或普通单求解器反馈产生更有效的监督信号。在完整集合上训练的模型在Terminal-Bench 2.0上达到32.58%和47.57%。最大提升幅度为：Terminal-Bench 2.0上24.71个百分点，SWE-bench Pro上27.68个百分点，Doc2Repo上30.04个百分点。

Conclusion: 实验结果表明，求解器相对的可学习性（solver-relative learnability）是构建有效且可迁移的智能体训练数据的实用目标。通过将任务难度校准到与目标求解器能力相匹配的区间，可以显著提升训练数据的监督质量和模型的跨任务泛化能力。

Abstract: Training terminal agents requires executable and verifiable tasks that are not merely solvable, but appropriately challenging for learning. Executable validation establishes feasibility, yet does not reveal how a task behaves relative to a given solver setting. In this paper, we present CalibForge, an autonomous terminal-task synthesis system that uses verified solver behavior to revise candidate tasks through adversarial solver calibration. Multi-solver calibration targets disagreement within a heterogeneous solver pool, whereas contrastive solver calibration targets a designated strong-pass/weak-fail relation; both operationalize a solver-relative learnable zone anchored in demonstrated solvability. Using CalibForge, we construct 5,431 calibrated terminal tasks. Our ablations show that both strategies yield more effective supervision than authoring and validation alone or ordinary single-solver feedback. Models trained on the full collection achieve 32.58% and 47.57% on Terminal-Bench 2.0. The largest improvements over the corresponding base model reach 24.71 percentage points on Terminal-Bench 2.0, 27.68 points on SWE-bench Pro, and 30.04 points on Doc2Repo. Together, these results support solver-relative learnability as a practical target for constructing effective and transferable agent training data.

</details>


### [433] [An Optimal Agnostic PAC Algorithm](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.06363)
*Markus Engelund Mathiasen,Jian Qian,Nikita Zhivotovskiy*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对有限VC维二元分类假设类，构造了一个达到统计最优风险界的PAC学习器，其风险界为L^* + O(√(L^*(d+log(1/δ))/n) + (d+log(1/δ))/n)，解决了agnostic PAC学习的样本复杂度问题（匹配已知下界至绝对常数）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 虽然agnostic PAC学习的上下界长期已知，但此前缺乏一个同时达到最优悲观率和最优乐观率（尤其在L^*较小区域）的单一学习算法。本文旨在构造这样的学习器，使得在固定的每一L^*值下，风险界与Devroye等人给出的下界在绝对常数意义下匹配，从而正式确定该问题的样本复杂度。

Method: 作者构造了一个针对有限VC维二元分类假设类的学习算法，该算法通过某种（具体的）策略实现了对二值损失风险的最优控制，将界分为与√(L^*·d/n)相关的低速项和与d/n相关的线性项，并以绝对常数7×10^8加以统一。

Result: 从n个i.i.d.样本出发，对任意0<δ≤1/2，以至少1-δ的概率，学习器输出的假设ĥ满足L(ĥ)≤L^*+7×10^8(√(L^*(d+log(1/δ))/n)+(d+log(1/δ))/n)。这一界在固定L^*时匹配Devroye、Györfi和Lugosi的下界至绝对常数。

Conclusion: 该结果正式确定了有限VC维二元分类在agnostic PAC学习框架下的样本复杂度（至绝对常数），回答了该问题长期悬而未决的一面。

Abstract: Let $H\subseteq\{-1,+1\}^X$ be a class of finite VC dimension $d\ge1$. Writing $L$ for the binary risk and $L^*=\min_{h\in H}L(h)$, we construct a learner achieving the statistically optimal risk bound: from an i.i.d.\ sample of size $n$, for every $0<δ\le 1/2$, with probability at least $1-δ$, \[
  L(\widehat h)
  \le L^*+ 7\cdot10^8\left(
  \sqrt{\frac{L^*(d+\log(1/δ))}{n}}
  +\frac{d+\log(1/δ)}{n}
  \right). \] This settles the sample complexity of agnostic PAC learning up to universal constants at every fixed $L^*$, matching the lower bounds of Devroye, Györfi, and Lugosi [A Probabilistic Theory of Pattern Recognition, Springer, 1996].

</details>


<div id='cs.AR'></div>

### [434] [EdgeXpert: An Edge Device for Memory-Efficient LLM Inference with Mixture-of-Experts and Speculative Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.05303)
*Sangwoo Ha,Hyunwoo Seo,Yurim Jo,Youngjin Moon,Hoi-Jun Yoo*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: EdgeXpert是一个软硬件协同设计的LLM加速器，通过提示级专家复用和深度感知专家合并两种技术，解决投机解码与混合专家（MoE）结合时的不兼容问题，在Samsung 28nm工艺上实现高达56.3%的延迟降低和44.1%的能耗降低，同时保持接近基线的精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 设备端部署LLM面临前馈网络（FFN）层外部内存访问（EMA）这一主要瓶颈。投机解码和MoE分别通过减少解码阶段数和稀疏专家激活来降低开销，但两者结合时存在不兼容性问题，需要新的解决方案来协同利用这两种技术。

Method: EdgeXpert采用两阶段优化：(1) 预填充阶段，通过提示级专家复用（prompt-wise expert reuse）将逐token独立路由重构为提示级专家复用，使用轻量编码器识别重要token并构建共享专家集，为次要token分配减少的专家预算；(2) 解码阶段，利用深度感知专家合并（depth-aware expert coalescing）利用同深度候选token的上下文相似性和互斥性，仅加载显著通道并应用计算校准恢复精度，避免额外内存访问。

Result: 在Samsung 28nm技术、800MHz频率下综合实现，EdgeXpert相比先前工作实现高达56.3%的延迟降低和44.1%的能耗降低，同时保持接近基线的精度。

Conclusion: EdgeXpert通过软硬件协同设计有效解决了投机解码与MoE之间的不兼容问题，在边缘设备上实现了高效的LLM部署，为未来端侧大模型加速提供了可行的架构方案。

Abstract: On-device deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs) has become essential for personalized edge applications. A primary bottleneck is external memory access (EMA) in feed-forward network (FFN) layers. Speculative decoding and mixture-of-experts (MoE) are promising solutions. Speculative decoding reduces the number of decoding stages by generating multiple tokens per stage, and MoE minimizes per-stage cost through sparse expert activation. However, there is an incompatibility when combining these two techniques. We propose EdgeXpert, a software-hardware co-designed LLM accelerator that resolves this incompatibility. In the prefill stage, the prompt-wise expert reuse reformulates routing as prompt-level expert reuse rather than independent per-token expert selection. It identifies important tokens using a lightweight encoder, constructs a shared expert set from them, and routes less important tokens with a reduced expert budget to lower expert EMA. In the decode stage, depth-aware expert coalescing exploits the contextual similarity and mutual exclusivity of same-depth candidate tokens. Rather than loading the union of all required channels, EdgeXpert loads only salient channels and applies computational calibration to recover accuracy without additional memory access. Synthesized in Samsung 28nm technology at 800 MHz, EdgeXpert achieves up to 56.3% latency reduction and 44.1% energy reduction compared to prior works, while maintaining near-baseline accuracy.

</details>


### [435] [PowerScope: ML-based Intra-Cycle Power Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.05339)
*Jayanth Balasubramanian,Sujay Pandit,Radha Vaidya,Anand Raghunathan*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: PowerScope是首个基于机器学习的周期内（sub-clock-cycle）功耗估计框架，仅依赖RTL仿真轨迹即可实现功耗估计，在达到5.88%中位数和9%平均绝对百分比误差的同时，比商业布局后门级功耗分析工具快约80倍，并能可靠地用于预硅功耗侧信道泄露评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 子时钟周期时间分辨率下的功耗估计对于电源分配网络（PDN）设计、动态电压跌落分析和预硅功耗侧信道安全评估等任务至关重要。现有商业布局后门级功耗分析工具计算开销大且扩展性差，而此前基于机器学习的功耗估计方法仅能处理平均功耗或每周期功耗，无法覆盖周期内功耗估计需求。

Method: PowerScope在推理时仅依赖RTL仿真轨迹运行，消除了每次工作负载都需要进行布局后门级仿真的需求。它通过机器学习模型直接从RTL仿真信号预测周期内的功耗波形。

Result: 在多样化的基准测试集上，PowerScope相对于商业布局后门级功耗估计实现了5.88%的中位数绝对百分比误差和9%的平均绝对百分比误差，同时运行速度约为商业工具的80倍。此外，其预测结果可可靠地用于预硅功耗侧信道泄露评估这一下游任务。

Conclusion: PowerScope证明了基于机器学习的周期内功耗估计是可行且高效的，不仅大幅加速了功耗估计流程，还能在预硅阶段可靠支持功耗侧信道安全评估，为早期功耗敏感的设计决策提供了有力工具。

Abstract: Power estimation at sub-clock-cycle temporal resolutions is critical for tasks such as power delivery network (PDN) design, dynamic voltage droop analysis, and pre-silicon power side-channel security evaluation. Designers commonly rely on commercial post-layout gate-level power analysis tools for these tasks, but these flows are computationally expensive and scale poorly with design size and workload length. Machine learning (ML)-based power estimation frameworks have shown promise in accelerating power estimation, but prior efforts only address average power or per-cycle power estimation. We propose PowerScope, the first ML-based intra-cycle power estimation framework. PowerScope operates purely on RTL simulation traces at inference time, eliminating the need for post-layout gate-level simulation and power analysis per workload. Across a diverse benchmark suite, PowerScope achieves 5.88% median and 9% mean absolute percentage error compared to commercial post-layout gate-level power estimates while running ~80x faster. We further demonstrate that PowerScope's predictions can be reliably used for the downstream task of pre-silicon power side-channel leakage assessment.

</details>


### [436] [PLoRA: An NDP-Enhanced Pooled-Memory System for Cost-Efficient Multi-LoRA Serving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.05483)
*Zhongkai Yu,Ohm Rishabh Venkatachalam,Zheng Wang,Yikai Li,Yichen Lin,Zihao Yu,Yuke Wang,Liu Liu,Xulong Tang,Shuyi Pei,Yangwook Kang,Yufei Ding*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: PLoRA是一个基于近数据处理（NDP）增强的池化内存系统，用于高效的多LoRA服务。它将适配器和KV缓存放在内存池中，仅通过链路返回归约结果，在单块H100上服务1000个适配器时，解码延迟平均比S-LoRA低6.6倍，设备面积仅增加不到3.4%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多LoRA服务将单个基础模型扩展为成千上万个专用变体（每个用户/任务/代理对应一个适配器），但现有系统存在根本性瓶颈：所有已发表系统都通过PCIe从CPU DRAM暂存适配器，每次访问都需支付内核停止和主机运行拷贝的开销，且容量受限于主板的DIMM插槽。同时，CXL和NVLink等内存语义结构正收敛于池化内存，但如何在此类硬件上服务多LoRA工作负载仍未被探索。

Method: PLoRA采用NDP增强的池化内存架构：将适配器和KV缓存保留在池中，通过GPU自身的load/store操作驱动一个"读-计算"接口，仅在链路上返回归约结果。在此架构之上，设计了一个GPU内存管理系统，为每个适配器在四种LoRA和两种注意力执行策略间进行选择，并依据链路参数化成本模型，将最关键的字节缓存到GPU内存中。

Result: 在单块H100上服务1000个适配器时，PLoRA在所有模型和工作负载上取得了最低的解码延迟，平均比真实机器上的S-LoRA低6.6倍，且新增设备面积不到3.4%。短上下文下吞吐在32GB/s（仅为CXL 3.1的四分之一）即饱和，证明链路不再是瓶颈；将部署规模从7B扩展到模拟的1.2T后，每GPU需求随张量并行的适配器流量分片而下降。

Conclusion: PLoRA的设计可无缝运行在从CXL级别到NVLink级别的各种内存结构上，剩余带宽用来购买池化容量而非速度，验证了NDP增强池化内存是成本高效多LoRA服务的可行方向。

Abstract: Multi-LoRA serving is how one base model becomes thousands of specialized variants, one adapter per user, task, or agent, and the deployments can hold 1000-plus adapters. Serving them is hard because the workload inverts what GPUs provide: terabytes of memory against only tens of TFLOPS, and because every published system stages its adapters from CPU DRAM over PCIe, where each access pays a kernel stop and a host-run copy and capacity ends at the motherboard's DIMM slots. Meanwhile, memory-semantic fabrics such as CXL and NVLink are converging on pooled memory that an accelerator addresses with its own loads and stores, and near-data processing (NDP) can place compute beside the pooled data. How to serve multi-LoRA workloads on such hardware remains unexplored.
  This paper introduces PLoRA, an NDP-enhanced pooled-memory system for cost-efficient multi-LoRA serving. PLoRA keeps adapters and KV cache in the pool and returns only reduced results over the link, through a read-compute interface the GPU drives with its own loads and stores. Above this architecture, a GPU memory management system picks among four LoRA and two attention execution strategies for each adapter and caches the most performance-critical bytes in GPU memory, guided by a link-parameterized cost model. On one H100 serving 1000 adapters, PLoRA attains the lowest decode latency on every model and workload we measure, averaging 6.6x below a real-machine S-LoRA at under 3.4% added device area. The link itself stops mattering: throughput saturates at 32 GB/s on short contexts, a quarter of CXL 3.1, and the verdict survives scale: per-GPU demand falls from 7B to a modeled 1.2T deployment once adapter traffic shards with the tensor parallelism. The design runs unchanged from CXL-class to NVLink-class fabrics, and surplus bandwidth buys pooled capacity rather than speed.

</details>


### [437] [Zero-Instruction Sensor Reads: Register-Mapped Peripherals and Hardware PWM on a Five-Stage Soft Processor](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.05638)
*Nathanael Ren*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 本文通过一个"反应轮自平衡自行车"内部控制回路的案例，展示了如何针对应用需求对一款五级流水线软处理器进行专门化定制。作者将两个高频访问的外设输入直接映射为架构寄存器，并四个周期PWM通道卸载至硬件，从而在控制回路中实现了零指令、零周期的传感器读取，将最坏情况循环从91个周期降至43个周期。研究指出，由于20ms的执行框架下余量极大（约7300倍和15000倍），该专门化的价值不在于实时性满足，而在于指令数减少和软件简化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索软件处理器在特定应用驱动下的专门化设计方法，评估通过寄存器级外设映射和硬件卸载PWM来消除控制回路中传感器读取和驱动开销的可行性与实际价值。

Method: 从自定义32位RISC核心（MIPS传统）出发，采用两种专门化手段：(1) 将两个高频访问的外设输入直接映射为架构寄存器状态，由硬件每周期写入，通过寄存器文件写端口结构独占所有权而非仲裁机制管理；(2) 将四个周期PWM通道卸载到硬件，由四个导出寄存器持续驱动，使周期性驱动完全脱离软件。在反应轮自平衡自行车内部控制回路上进行评估并比较两种配置。

Result: 零指令传感器读取使得控制循环中10次传感器读取无需任何专用指令和周期，融入本就执行的算术操作中，相比内存映射方式节省5条额外指令和周期。归档配置最坏循环为91周期，集成配置（含单周期阵列乘法器）为43周期，对应20ms执行框架下分别有约7300倍和15000倍的裕度。

Conclusion: 专门化在实时性上并非必要（因为片上单周期I/O区域已提供足够的确定性），其核心价值在于减少指令数和简化软件。零指令传感器读取这一优势独立于乘法器的选择，因为乘法器无法影响外设读取是否需要独立指令。

Abstract: We present a case study in application-driven specialization of a five-stage soft processor, evaluated on the inner control loop of a reaction-wheel self-balancing bicycle. Starting from a custom 32-bit RISC core in the MIPS tradition, we specialize the design in two ways. First, two frequently accessed peripheral inputs are mapped directly into architectural register state, written every cycle by hardware and owned exclusively through the register file's write-port structure rather than by arbitration. Second, four periodic PWM channels are offloaded to hardware and driven continuously from four exported registers, removing periodic actuation from software entirely. Because peripheral values are addressable as ordinary register operands, all ten sensor reads in the control loop cost no dedicated instruction and no dedicated cycle, folding into arithmetic that executes anyway; the memory-mapped equivalent requires an explicit load per snapshot and costs five extra instructions and cycles. The actuation path likewise removes waveform maintenance from software entirely. We report two configurations, because the extensions and the single-cycle array multiplier they were deployed alongside are not present together in a single archived build: an archived configuration, whose worst-case loop is 91 cycles, and the integrated configuration matching the deployed system, at 43 cycles. Against a 20 ms actuation frame these are margins of roughly 7,300x and 15,000x. The deadline is met by so wide a margin in either case that the specialization was not necessary for real-time compliance; its value lies in instruction count and software simplicity, not in determinism, which an on-chip single-cycle I/O region already provides. The zero-instruction sensor read is independent of that choice: the multiplier cannot affect whether a peripheral read needs an instruction of its own.

</details>


### [438] [An Open-Source Power Measurement Platform for System-Level Semiconductor Testing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.05888)
*Linus Bantel,Sarah Rottacker,Dirk Pflüger*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种紧凑且可扩展的嵌入式设备系统级功耗测量硬件平台，采用Raspberry Pi控制器、精密电流测量设备与单片机DUT集成，通过HTTP接口支持远程固件部署与测量结果获取，实现了自动化基准测试与可复现实验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 准确的功耗测量对于评估现代嵌入式与半导体系统的能效至关重要，且功耗是压力测试中的重要代理指标。然而工业半导体测试设备通常价格昂贵且难以集成到灵活的实验中，现有方案缺乏低成本、易扩展的自动化测量手段。

Method: 该平台由三个核心组件构成：Raspberry Pi作为主控制器、精密电流测量设备负责高分辨率电流采集、基于微控制器的待测设备(DUT)。系统支持自动固件部署、同步设备执行和高分辨率电流采集，并通过轻量级HTTP接口允许远程客户端上传固件二进制文件和检索测量结果。

Result: 平台采用易于获取的硬件组件和开源软件工具实现，能够实现跨多种固件变体的自动化基准测试和可复现实验，适用于固件能耗分析和回归测试等场景。

Conclusion: 该平台为研究、原型开发和教学环境提供了一套低成本、可扩展的自动化系统级功耗测量解决方案，弥补了工业测试设备成本和灵活性方面的不足。

Abstract: Accurate power measurement is not only essential for evaluating the energy efficiency of modern embedded and semiconductor systems, but power draw is an important proxy during stress testing. Industrial semiconductor test equipment, however, is often expensive and difficult to integrate into flexible experimental workflows.
  This paper presents a compact and extensible hardware platform for automated system-level power measurement of embedded devices. The proposed setup integrates a Raspberry Pi controller, a precision current measurement device, and a microcontroller-based Device-under-Test (DUT). The system supports automated firmware deployment, synchronized device execution, and high-resolution current acquisition.
  A lightweight HTTP-based interface allows remote clients to upload firmware binaries and retrieve measurement results. This design enables automated benchmarking and reproducible experiments across multiple firmware variants.
  The platform is implemented using accessible hardware components and open-source software tools, making it suitable for research, prototyping, and educational environments. We describe the architecture of the platform, the automated testing workflow, and potential application scenarios, including firmware energy profiling and regression testing.

</details>


### [439] [Automated Synthesis of Heterogeneous, Hierarchical, Scoped Coherence Protocols](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.05965)
*Fletch Rydell,An Qi Zhang,Nicolai Oswald,Andres Goens,Vijay Nagarajan,Daniel Sorin*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 本文提出ShimGen，一种自动合成引擎，利用shim API将具有不同语义一致性保证的集群级与全局级缓存一致性协议自动组合，支持非SWMR（单写多读）访问模式，并在两个案例中验证了其正确性与性能优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代处理器设计趋向于异构、分层、基于作用域（scope）的缓存一致性模型，如CXL和AMBA CHI作为全局协议与多个集群级协议组合。手动设计两者之间的shim（接口桥接）既精细又易出错，而现有的自动合成方法往往假设SWMR不变量，牺牲性能换取简化与正确性。

Method: 提出一个通用shim API抽象，用于按语义一致性保证对协议事务进行分类。基于此API，构建自动合成引擎ShimGen，能够自动组合同时包含SWMR和宽松（relaxed）访问的协议，利用现代架构优化如作用域内存访问（scoped memory accesses）和惰性失效（lazy invalidation）。

Result: 在两个案例中验证了ShimGen的效果：其一，与AMD APU（基于gem5发布）手动设计的层级协议对比，ShimGen的输出与现有协议相似，但发现手动协议在一个场景下违反复合一致性（compound consistency），而ShimGen不存在此问题；其二，与严格SWMR全局协议的层级协议相比，支持非SWMR访问的全局协议在性能上展现了显著优势。

Conclusion: ShimGen能够自动生成正确且高效的协议组合方案，超越手动设计的正确性并利用非SWMR全局协议带来性能收益，为分层异构缓存一致性协议设计提供了一条可行路径。

Abstract: Processor design is converging on a new model of cache-coherent shared memory characterized by heterogeneity, hierarchy, and scopes. Protocols like CXL or AMBA CHI are used as global protocols to combine multiple clusters, each with its own cluster-level coherence protocols. Manually designing shims to interface between these cluster and global protocols is subtle and error-prone. Automatic synthesis, on the other hand, makes simplifying assumptions like the single-writer multiple-reader (SWMR) invariant, that sacrifice performance for simplicity and guaranteed correctness.
  We present a shim API \textemdash a generic abstraction that enables us to classify protocol transactions by their semantic coherence guarantees. Our automated synthesis engine, ShimGen, uses this shim API to automatically compose protocols with both SWMR and relaxed accesses, taking advantage of modern architectural optimizations like scoped memory accesses and lazy invalidation. We demonstrate ShimGen's efficacy on two case studies. First, we compare its output to a manually-designed hierarchical protocol for the AMD APU released in gem5. ShimGen's output is similar to the existing protocol. However, we identify one scenario where the manually-designed protocol fails to uphold compound consistency, while ShimGen's does. Second, we compare the performance of a hierarchical protocol with a global protocol that exploits non-SWMR accesses to a hierarchical protocol with a strictly SWMR global protocol. The result shows the performance benefits of accommodating global protocols with non-SWMR behavior.

</details>


### [440] [Breaking Memory Bottlenecks in Quantum Control Systems for More Precise Experiments and Higher Throughput Computing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.06318)
*Yicheng Guang,Neel Vora,Yilun Xu,Yueqi Chen,Gang Huang*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: Ant-Q是一种存储层次设计，将DRAM与BRAM集成以支持流水线化量子电路执行，同时保证电路间时序的确定性，从而解决量子控制系统中因片上BRAM容量有限和DRAM非确定性延迟导致的存储瓶颈。在26个真实电路上的评估显示，Ant-Q支持深电路实验并将电路加载与读出上行开销从执行时间的22.90%-1417.05%降至接近零。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着量子计算的发展，需要更精确的实验和更高的电路吞吐量来验证更多领域应用，但这一需求受到量子控制系统层存储瓶颈的阻碍——片上BRAM容量有限且DRAM延迟不确定，导致无法高效加载和调度电路。

Method: 提出Ant-Q存储层次设计，将DRAM与BRAM结合，形成层次化存储架构，支持流水线化量子电路执行，并通过设计确保电路间时序的确定性，从而在不牺牲时序可预测性的前提下突破存储容量瓶颈。

Result: 使用26个真实实验和计算电路进行评估。Ant-Q支持1Q和2Q随机基准测试（Randomized Benchmarking）的深电路，并将电路加载和读出上行相对于执行时间的开销从22.90%-1417.05%降至接近零。

Conclusion: Ant-Q已集成到QubiC 3.0中，部分功能已可用，表明该存储层次设计在实际量子控制系统中的实用性和可部署性。

Abstract: As quantum computing continues to demonstrate promise and attract growing attention, there is an increasing need for more precise experiments to advance the development of quantum devices, as well as higher circuit throughput to validate more domain applications. However, this need is hindered by a memory bottleneck at the quantum control system layer, arising from limited on-chip BRAM capacity and the non-deterministic latency of DRAM. To break this bottleneck, we present Ant-Q, a memory hierarchy design that integrates DRAM with BRAM to support pipelined quantum circuit execution while ensuring deterministic inter-circuit timing. We evaluated Ant-Q using 26 real-world experimental and computing circuits. The results show that Ant-Q supports deep circuits for 1Q and 2Q Randomized Benchmarking and reduces the overhead of circuit loading and readout uplink relative to execution time from 22.90%-1417.05% to near zero. Ant-Q is being integrated into QubiC 3.0, with part of its functionalities already available.

</details>
